God Almighty has said about His believing servants: “You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day being friendly with those who oppose God and His Messenger.” And if it were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred, those were He who wrote faith in their hearts and supported them with a spirit from Him.} [Al-Mujadila: 22].

The Holy Spirit is not specific to Christ - peace be upon him - but rather what is used to explain the name of the Son and the name of the Holy Spirit, and other things by which it has been described. Christ is shared between him and other messengers, and if they explain the solutions as the appearance of God’s light, knowledge, and guidance in the prophets, then this is It is true and it is shared between Christ and others.
As for the soul of God, it has not resided in any human being.

And the Muslims, despite their testimony to Christ that he is the servant of God and His Messenger, say: He is a supporter and a victor, may God protect him from his enemies. He purified him of them, and did not make them dominate him.

The Christians claim that the name of Christ is the name of divinity and humanity, and that he is a perfect God and a perfect human being, and this is impossible according to Islamic law and reason. They describe him with contradictory characteristics. They describe him as a group of evil Jews putting thorns on his head and spitting in his face. They insulted him, crucified him, and did to him what is not done to the most vile of people, and they say along with this: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

chapters.title: Chapter on abrogating the law of the Torah and that what Christ brought is true
paragraphs: [Chapter: Abrogating the law of the Torah and that what Christ brought is true]

They said, “Then our offerings and sacrifices are attested that they are holy and acceptable to God from the writings of the Jews that are in their hands this day.” Revealed from God on the mouths of the prophets and messengers.
Isaiah said: (God said:

I know the children of Israel and their hard, wicked hearts. When I appear to the nations, they will look at my honor, and I will raise up prophets from it. And I will send up saviors from among them, who will save the nations from distant lands, who have not heard my hearing, nor known before my honor; and my name will be And they will bring their brethren from all the nations, and bring offerings to God on animals and chariots to a holy mountain, the Holy House. Then they will bring offerings to me with semolina, as the children of Israel did before, and so are the rest of the nations. And you will offer the offerings before me, and they and their seed. forever, and they perform Hajj every year, and every month, and from year to year, to the Holy House, the House of God, and they offer sacrifice to God their Lord therein. Pure and pure offerings, they look upon the evil and rebellious nation:
Children of Israel, her grief will never fade away or end, her affliction will last forever.)

And Daniel the Prophet - peace be upon him - said: (And seventy weeks will come upon your people and your holy city, and transgressions will be abolished, and sins will be consumed. And the forgiveness of sin, and the truth that was not revealed before will be brought, and the prophecies of the prophets and the writings of the apostles will be fulfilled, and the city of Jerusalem will be destroyed. It will be destroyed with the coming of the Messiah, and the old covenant with the people will be destroyed, and after a week and a half the Jewish sacrifices and offerings will be nullified. And it will remain at the end of impurity and corruption until the end of time.)

The Prophet Micah, peace be upon him, said: (God said, “At the end of time, when the Messiah comes, He will call together the scattered nations, make them one people, and abolish The fight against the children of Israel, and their weapons and their offerings, will last forever.)

And the prophet Amos said: “Do not slaughter calves any longer, for the Lord will come to Zion and establish a new and pure commandment of pure bread and wine.” Pure, and the children of Israel will be driven out.)

The answer is in a number of ways: One of them is that what they use as evidence of transmission from the prophets - may God’s prayers be upon them - they need four Introductions: Until the prophecy of the one from whom it was transmitted is known, and until the word he spoke is known, and until what they mentioned is known in translation. It is correct for him, because those prophets did not speak Arabic, nor did they speak Romans, Syriac, and Greek. Rather, they spoke In Hebrew, like Christ - peace be upon him -.

Fourth: It should be known that what they mentioned from the words of the prophets is evidence of what they claimed regarding the acceptance of their offerings in this time, and we are in In this context, we will confine ourselves to their dispute in this introduction, as there is no evidence in what they mentioned of praising their offerings and sacrifices after the change. Abrogation, but its purpose is to indicate its praise before abrogation and alteration, and this is something that Muslims do not dispute.
The second aspect:

These descriptions mentioned about “Isaiah” and other prophets do not agree with what Christians do, because Christians do not offer sacrifices. with semolina, as the children of Israel did before, and they do not make the pilgrimage every month or from year to year to the Holy House, the House of God, and they offer To God their Lord therein are pure and pure offerings, and they only perform Hajj for garbage outside the House of God, which the prophets intended. And you pray in it, for the prophets only prayed in the Holy House, and they visited the Holy House itself, and as for garbage, it has no It was mentioned in the books of the Prophets - peace be upon them -. Rather, rubbish appeared in the time of King Constantine, when his mother Helena showed it to her. When the Harranite woman came to Jerusalem, she chose three Jews from among the Jews and asked them to show her where the cross was, but they refused. So she punished them with imprisonment and hunger, so they showed her where it was in a dunghill, so they took it out, and she put it in a golden envelope and carried it, and she built The rubbish church in his place, as Ibn Penguin mentioned in his history, and others, as will come, and that was more after Christ. Three hundred years ago.

From that time on, they made the cross visible, and made “the Feast of the Cross,” and neither Christ nor the Apostles prescribed that. This is mentioned in their books. It is agreed upon among their scholars, as has been mentioned in another place, and they do not bring offerings to God on animals and chariots to the Holy Mountain of Bethlehem. Holy God.

The third aspect: What they mentioned about “Daniel” does not include praising their religion after abrogation and alteration, but rather includes that God will send Christ - peace be upon him - with the truth that has not disappeared before, and it is the religion with which the messengers were sent before him, and it is the worship of God alone and that The Holy House will be destroyed with the coming of Christ, and the ancient covenant will be annihilated, meaning what was abrogated from the law of the Torah, and it nullifies the sacrifices of the Jews. And their offerings.

All of this indicates the abrogation of the law of the Torah, the invalidity of the Jewish state, and indicates that Christ brought the truth, and whoever follows Christ He was on the truth, and this is something that Muslims do not dispute, for they agree that whoever adheres to what Christ commanded is one of the servants of God bless the righteous, but whoever brought a law that Christ did not bring or wanted to follow his law after it was abrogated, then he is in the same position as the Jews who abrogated God did not abolish their law and remove their state, and so He did to the Christians when God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - He removed Their country covers the middle and best parts of the earth, and where the prophets were sent, like the land of the Levant and Egypt.

And the island, and Iraq, and Armenia, and Azerbaijan, and evacuated them to the two ends of the land, to the north and south, and those in The best of their conditions on earth is if they do not submit to paying the tax by hand while they are young.

Likewise, what they mentioned about “Micah” and “Amos” only indicates the coming of the Messiah - peace be upon him - and the invalidity of what God has abolished and abolished. The law of the Jews and their rule does not indicate the validity of the religion of the Christians, which Christ - peace be upon him - did not legislate, nor its validity after it was abrogated by law. Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - abrogating is more effective than abrogating some of the law of Moses with the law of Christ - peace be upon him -.
This is if the Sharia calls the temporary copy “abrogation” for an unknown purpose, then the first does not herald the second.

But if the first preached good news about the second, and the law of the first was temporary until the coming of the second, this would not be called abrogation, then Christ and Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace May God bless them and grant them peace - they did not abrogate anything, rather it was the law of Moses leading to the coming of the Messiah, and the law of Christ leading to the coming of Muhammad - may God bless them and grant them peace.

As for what was narrated on the authority of Isaiah about God, he said: If you appear to the nations, this may be used as evidence by Christians and people like him. The words of the prophets - peace be upon them - regarding the solutions they invented, and they are false, for such language is mentioned in the books of the People of the Book in There is no place, and none of it is meant by the presence of God in any human being, as it was mentioned in the Torah that God Almighty was revealed to Abraham. And others, and that God comes from Mount Sinai, and emerges from Seir, and is revealed from the mountains of Paran.

It is known to all people of religion that God, Glory be to Him, the Most High, did not make it lawful for Moses or anyone else when He spoke to him, and He is not lawful for any of the mountains. Varan told him that he had learned from her.
And God Almighty said: {It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions} [At-Tawbah: 33].

So he made it clear with knowledge, argument, and explanation, and made it clear with the hand and the teeth, as God Almighty said: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth, like His light is like a niche in which is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as if it were a pearly star, kindled from a blessed olive tree. East or West, its oil would almost shine even if no fire touched it. Light upon light. God guides to His light whomsoever He wills.} [An-Nur: 35].
Ubayy ibn Ka’b and others said: like his light in the heart of the believer.
And God Almighty said: {O you who have believed, fear God and believe in His Messenger. He will give you two measures of His mercy and make for you a light by which you may walk.} [Al-Hadid: 28].

And God Almighty said: {And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Book or faith is, but We have made it a light by which we guide those who We choose from among Our servants} [Al-Shura: 52].

And in Al-Tirmidhi, on the authority of Abu Sa’id Al-Khudri, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “Fear the eyes of a believer, for he sees with the light of God, then he recited: “Indeed, in that are signs for those who seek success” [Al-Hijr: 75].

Al-Tirmidhi said: A good hadith, and it came from some of the predecessors that the hearts of believers illuminate for the inhabitants of the heavens just as the planets illuminate for the inhabitants of the heavens. The earth.

And the creature whose love, remembrance, and obedience appear in some country, it is said that so-and-so has appeared in this land. If a male appears God, and He mentioned His names, His attributes, His monotheism, His signs, and His worship, until the hearts were filled with that, after they had been filled with darkness. Disbelief and polytheism, this was what he was informed about during his appearance, and this is the greatest thing that happens in his homes where he is worshiped and where his name is mentioned.

For this reason, when He - the Almighty - mentioned the verse of light and said: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is like a niche in which is a lamp. The lamp is in a bottle. The bottle is as if it were a pearly star lit from a blessed olive tree, neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost shine even if you did not touch it. Fire, light upon light. God guides to His light whomsoever He wills, and God sets forth examples for the people. And God is All-Knowing of all things. [An-Nour: 35]

He said after that: {In houses which God has permitted to be raised, and in which His name is mentioned. Therein He is glorified in the mornings and the evenings, men who are not distracted by commerce. There is no trade other than the remembrance of God, the establishment of prayer, and the paying of zakat. They fear a day when hearts and eyes will be turned, so that God may reward them with the best. They worked, and He increases them of His bounty. And God provides for whomever He wills without reckoning.} [An-Nour: 36].

Likewise, what is in the scriptures about his appearance in the Holy House is like his appearance in Mount Sinai and Mount Paran, and despite this neither Moses saw him nor Other than Him, neither abstractly nor in a situation other than Him, and Christ told that no one saw Him, as He told others, and that is a general denial that requires that He is not seen Not merely, nor at any time in this world, as this has been explained in another place, and it is known that being exposed to something is more eloquent than seeing it. The Lord - the Almighty - was not seen by a human being, since no human being would be clothed with him, in a way that is better and more likely, and the Christians claim that he was united with Him. And humanity, and this is greater than vision.

chapters.title: A chapter on the testimony of the Jewish books to Jesus regarding his prophecy as a testimony to Muhammad
paragraphs: [Chapter: The testimony of the Jewish books to Jesus about the prophecy is a testimony to Muhammad]

They said: What can be greater proof and stronger testimony than this, since these are the writings of our enemies who oppose our religion, and they acknowledge Thus, they read it in their churches, and they did not deny a single word or a single letter from it.

The answer is: If the matter is according to what they said, and these words are proven from some of the prophets, then there is no praise in them for their religion anymore. Substitution, so what about after copying and substitution? Rather, it contains information about the demise of the rule of the Children of Israel, and the abrogation of what was abrogated from their law with the coming of the Messiah - peace be upon him -, and this is evidence of The prophecy of Christ and his truthfulness, and this is what the Muslims agreed upon.

And the Messiah - peace be upon him - is among them, as God told about him, when He - the Most High - said to Mary: {Indeed, God gives you good tidings of a word from Him, and His name is the Messiah. Jesus, son of Mary, will be distinguished in this world and the hereafter, and among those brought near - and he will speak to people in the cradle, and at old age, and among the righteous.} [Al Imran: 45-46].
As for their saying: This and others are found in the books of our Jewish enemies.

It will be said to them, “There is no doubt that the Jews differ from you in interpreting the Scriptures. You interpret them in one way, and they interpret them in another way.” Both interpretations will be false, and then it will be said to you, “Just as the books of the prophets are a witness to Christ and his religion, even if the Jews differ from you in Its interpretation, so it is a witness for Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation, even if he differs from the People of the Book in interpreting it, as has been shown. God is in the books of the prophets a description of Muhammad and his nation in more than one place.

What is obligatory in the books, if the nations dispute over their interpretation, is to make clear the truth on which the legal and rational evidence is based, and in that case it will be made clear. That you have interpreted the books of God with things that contradict God’s will regarding the matter of the Trinity and the union and other things, just as the Jews did by interpreting the books, as It was spread elsewhere.

chapters.title: A chapter rejecting the Christians’ claim that Muhammad was not sent to them despite his doubts about what he brought
paragraphs: [Chapter: Rejecting the Christians’ claim that Muhammad was not sent to them despite his doubts about what he brought.]

They said: And also in what this man said in his book, where he followed the statement that it was not sent to us despite his doubts about what he brought in it. This book is in Surat Saba, where it says: {And indeed we or you are upon guidance or in clear error} [Saba: 24].
Also in Surah Al-Ahqaf, he says: {And I do not know what will be done to me or to you} [Al-Ahqaf: 9].

The answer is: Their quotation from him is that he said: No apparent lie was sent to them, for his book is filled with their supplications. He commanded them to believe in him and follow him, and even to generalize his message to all people, even to the jinn and mankind, and there was never a time in it that he did not It is sent to the People of the Book, but rather it contains a declaration to call the People of the Book in more than one place, as He - the Most High - says:

{Say, O People of the Book, come to a common word between us and you: that we shall worship none but Allah, and not associate anything with Him, and not take lords other than Allah. But if they turn away, then say, “Bear witness that we submit.” [Al Imran: 64].

The Prophet wrote with this verse to Caesar, the king of the Christians, whose name is Heraclius, in the Levant. This was mentioned before, and it was also mentioned that His saying - the Almighty -: {That you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, for they are heedless} [Yasin: 6].
It implies that he did not warn the illiterate, and it does not mean that he does not warn anyone else, just as his saying: {And warn your closest kindred} [Al-Shu’ara’: 214].

He requires that he warn his people, and it does not contradict that he should warn other Arabs, just as what he said about the Quraysh: “So let them worship the Lord of this house, which He fed them against hunger and secured them from fear” [Quraysh: 3].

It does not prevent anyone other than the Quraysh from being commanded to worship the Lord of this House. Rather, God commanded all the two creatures: the jinn and mankind, to worship the Lord of this House. The house.

If it is said: He was silent about anything except the illiterate in this matter, then it would be denied as evidence of the discourse called the concept of dissent. It was said This only indicates that there is no benefit in the specification other than specificity in the ruling, and there is no statement here that the ruling that is not heard is the same as the ruling What is operative, and here is when God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - He ordered him to warn his closest family first, then warn the Arabs. The illiterate, then the People of the Book, the Magians, and others. This has already been explained.

chapters.title: God Almighty dismissed all forms of polytheism in Him
paragraphs: [Chapter: God Almighty has denied all forms of polytheism in Him]

As for their saying, despite his doubt about what he brought, it is an obvious lie, for He - the Most High - said: {Say, “Call upon those whom you claim other than God. They possess an atom’s weight in the heavens or in the earth, and they have in them no partner, nor has He among them any supporter.} [Saba: 22] (22) {And it will not benefit. Intercession with Him is only for those to whom He permits, until, when it has departed from their hearts, they say, “What has your Lord said?” They say, “The truth, and He is the Most High, the Great.” [Saba: 23] (23) {Say, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah. And indeed we or you are upon guidance or in clear error.” [Saba:

24] (24) {Say, “You will not be asked about what we have committed, nor will we be asked about what you do.” [Saba: 25] (25) {Say, “Our Lord will bring us together, then He will open between us with the truth, and He is Al-Fattah, the All-Knowing} [Saba: 26].

When he called them to monotheism and made clear that whatever they call upon besides God does not possess the weight of an atom in the heavens or on the earth, nor is He He is a partner, and He is not a supporter, and no intercessor is of benefit except with His permission. Thus, He denied all forms of polytheism, for whatever He associates with Him either has dominion. Or a partner in the kingdom, or a helper. If the three are not present, all that remains is intercession, which is a supplication for you and a request, and that is of no benefit. With him, except for whom he gives permission.

Then he mentioned after this that there is no provider of sustenance from the heavens and the earth except Allah. He indicated by this and that to monotheism, as in his saying: {And what Whatever blessing you have, it is from God; then, when adversity touches you, you resort to it.} [An-Nahl: 53] (53) {Then, when adversity is removed from you, behold, a party of you They associate partners with their Lord} [An-Nahl: 54] (54) {That they may disbelieve in what We have given them, so enjoy; for you will surely know} [An-Nahl: 55].

When he mentioned what indicated the necessity of his monotheism, and made clear that the people of monotheism are on guidance, and the people of polytheism are on the path of error, he said: {And indeed, we Or beware of you, perhaps upon guidance or in clear error} [Saba: 24].
He says: One of the two groups is the people of monotheism who worship none but Allah, and the people of polytheism, whether on guidance or in clear error.

This is a matter of fairness in the speech that everyone who heard it from a friend or an enemy said to the one who was proposed to him, “Your friend has been fair to you,” as the just person says. Whose justice was revealed to the oppressor whose injustice became apparent: The oppressor is either me or you, not to doubt the apparent matter, but to show that one of us An oppressor who is clearly unjust, and he is you, not me.

For when it is said: The people of monotheism are those who worship God following guidance or in clear error, and the people of polytheism are those who worship that which does not harm or does not harm. يَنْفَعُ عَلَى هُدًى أَوْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ.

It has become clear that the people of monotheism are on guidance, and the people of polytheism are on error, and this is what all sects of Islam and Jews know. And the Christians know that the people of monotheism are on guidance, and the people of polytheism are on error.

And in the Qur’an, in a statement like this, there is nothing to be counted except as a cost. Rather, the core of the Qur’an and all the other books and their focus is on the worship of God alone. How can it be said that the Messenger had doubts as to whether the guided people were the people of monotheism or the people of polytheism? Would anyone say this except someone who is extremely ignorant and stubborn?
(Then the verse is an address to the polytheists, not an address to the Christians in particular.)

chapters.title: The Messenger was a human being who did not know the unseen and did not say that he was an angel
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Messenger is a human being who does not know the unseen and does not say that he is an angel]
As for His saying - the Most High -: “Say, ‘I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I follow only what is revealed to me, and I am nothing but a clear warner.” [Al-Ahqaf: 9].

And this is after his saying: {Or do they say, “He fabricated it?” Say, “If I fabricated it, then you do not possess anything for me from Allah. He knows best what you disclose. He is sufficient as a witness therein.” between me and you and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful} [Al-Ahqaf: 8].

The equivalent of this is His saying: {Say, “I do not tell you that I have the treasures of God, nor do I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me.” Say, “Are the blind and the seeing equal? Will you not consider?” [Al-An’am: 50].

This was said by Noah - peace be upon him - the first of the messengers, and Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - the last of the messengers was commanded to say it, and like his saying: {Say: Indeed, I I have no power over you to harm you nor to guide you.} [Al-Jinn: 21] (21) {Say: Indeed, no one will give me protection from God, nor will I find anyone besides Him alone} [Al-Jinn: 22] (22) {Except a notification from God and His messages, and whoever disobeys God and His Messenger - for him is the fire of Hell, wherein they will abide forever.} [Al-Jinn: 23].

This and the like includes his recognition that he is a servant of God and a messenger from God, who does not go beyond the limit of the message and does not claim to share in divinity. As the Christians claimed about the Messiah, and for this reason God Almighty said: “The Messiah, the son of Mary, is no more than a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother is a truthful one.” They were eating food} [Al-Maeda: 75].

So it becomes clear that it does not go beyond the limit of the message, and it is like His - the Most High - saying: And Muhammad is no more than a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him. So, if he dies or Killed, you turned on your heels.

For this reason, he said - may God bless him and grant him peace - and in the hadith that is agreed upon as authentic: “Do not praise me as the Christians praised Jesus, son of Mary, for I am only Abdul, so say, “Abdullah and His Messenger.”
Then He Almighty said: {Say: I am not an innovator among the messengers, and I do not know what will be done to me or to you} [Al-Ahqaf: 9].

He says, “I am not the first to be sent, or to claim the message. Rather, messengers have come before me: {And I do not know what will be done to me or to you. If I follow except what is revealed.” To Me, and I am only a clear warner} [Al-Ahqaf: 9].

He says, “I do not claim knowledge of the unseen. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner. I warn you with what God has commanded me to warn you with.” I tell you that I have the treasures of God, and I do not know the unseen, nor do I say that I am a king. This is from the perfection of his honesty, justice, servitude to God, and obedience to Him. And distinguishing what the Creator alone deserves from what the servant deserves, because knowledge of the consequences of matters in detail is what God has influenced. With his knowledge, no close angel or sent prophet knows him.
It is not a requirement for the Messenger to know everything that will happen, as God Almighty says: {And I do not know what will be done to me or to you} [Al-Ahqaf: 9].

Denying his knowledge of everything that is done to him and to them, and this is known only to God - Blessed and Most High - and this does not deny that he is knowledgeable. That he is happy among the people of Paradise, even if he does not know the details of the tribulations and deeds that will happen to him in this world, and the new things that will befall him. laws, and the types of bliss that he will be honored with in the Hereafter, for it has been proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: (He says God Almighty:
“I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear heard, nor has entered the heart of mankind.” And this is also a narration from others. The Prophets - peace be upon them -.

Nor is it a requirement for the Prophet to know the condition of those he is addressing: who believes in him and who disbelieves, and the details of what they will become, if it is said that he did not After this verse, he knows what was denied in it, and if it is said that he knew that, then it is known that God did not teach him everything in general, but rather I teach him things, little by little.

And he said to him after that: “Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest” (1) “so that God may forgive you for your past sins and those that will follow, and that it may be completed.” His blessings be upon you and guide you to a straight path” (2) “And God will grant you victory, mighty.”

And He - the Almighty - said: {It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions. And God is sufficient as a witness} [Al-Fath: 28].

And in the Qur’an and the hadiths about it - may God bless him and grant him peace - there is many times more information about what will happen in this world and in the hereafter than there is. On the authority of the prophets before him, so much so that he foretells of the thing that will happen after a number of years, with more complete information than the information of those who witnessed it. Such as his saying - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - in the authentic hadith: “The Hour will not come until you fight the Turks with small eyes, wrinkled noses, and red cheeks. They wear hair, as if their faces are like hammered shields. Who has seen these Turks whom the Muslims fought since the time Genghis Khan came out? Their eldest king, his children, and his children’s children, like Hulagu and other infidel Turkish kings whom the Muslims fought, did not It would be better to describe them with something better than this.”
He announced this more than six hundred years before its appearance, and he said:

May God’s prayers and peace be upon him: “The Hour will not come until a fire emerges from the land of Hijaz, illuminating the necks of camels in Busra,” and this fire appeared. In the year six hundred and fifty-five in the land of Hijaz, it burned the stones and did not cook the meat, and the people of Busra saw the necks of camels from... The light of that fire, and it was a warning of what would happen after it. In the year six hundred and fifty-six, Hulagu, the king of the infidels, entered Baghdad. He killed a great and famous person in it (and there will come - God willing - some news that people witnessed it happen, as we reported when we mentioned His miracles).

chapters.title: The chapter on rejecting the Christians’ claim is that they are the ones whom God has bestowed
paragraphs: [Chapter: Refuting the Christians’ claim that they are the ones whom God has bestowed]

Then they said: In addition to the command for him in the opening of the Book to ask for guidance to the straight path, the path of those whom God has bestowed, without “Those upon whom wrath is incurred, nor those who go astray.” He meant when he said: “the bestowed upon them, and those who are angry, and those who went astray,” the three nations who were in his time. They were: Christians, Jews, and idol worshipers, and there were no other nations in his time other than these three nations.

So those who have been blessed are we Christians, and those who have been angry with - there is no doubt - are the Jews, against whom God was angry in the books of the Torah. And the prophets and this book, and the misguided are the idol worshipers who have gone astray from God. This is a clear and evident matter evident to everyone. One, especially among those with intellects, knowledge, and the path: it is the doctrine, meaning the path, and this word is Roman, because the path In Roman Astrata.

The answer: As for their saying: We, the Christians, are blessed, it is one of the wonders that indicate the extreme ignorance of its owner, and it is even more astonishing than that. They say that this is something clear and obvious to everyone, especially to those with reason and knowledge, so Glory be to God!

Did not the general and the specific know a necessary and indisputable knowledge of the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and the religion of his nation which they received? About him declaring Christians infidels, making them ignorant, misleading them, deeming their jihad permissible, taking their harems captive, and taking their money, which contradicts all The contradiction is that Muhammad and his nation said in every prayer: O God, guide us to the path of the Christians.

Is it attributed to Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation that in every prayer they ask God to guide them to the path of the Christians? Who is the most deceitful of liars and the most slanderous, impudent, ignorant and misguided?

If they had asked God for guidance on the path of the Christians, they would have entered the religion of the Christians, and not declared them unbelievers and fought them, and imposed a tax on them. Which they performed by hand while they were young, and they did not bear witness against them that they are from the people of Hell, and his nation all took that from him, narrated. According to the Mutawatir narration, according to their consensus, they did not innovate that, just as the Christians invented beliefs and laws that he did not permit. God, so Muslims are not to be blamed for following the Messenger of God, who came with clear proofs and guidance.

And Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - if he was a truthful messenger, then he declared the Christians unbelievers, ordered their jihad, and disavowed them and their religion, even if He was a liar and nothing of what he narrated from God Almighty was accepted.
The Almighty’s saying has been mentioned more than once: “Indeed, those who say, ‘Indeed, Allah is the third of three’ have disbelieved.” [Al-Ma’idah: 73].
{Indeed, those who say that God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have disbelieved} [Al-Maeda: 17].

{And the Christians said, “The Messiah is the Son of God.” That is what they say with their mouths, imitating the words of those who disbelieved before. God will fight them. How will they be defeated? [Al-Tawbah: 30] (30) {They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, son of Mary, and they were not commanded except to worship one God, no There is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him.” [At-Tawbah: 31].
Who says such things about the Christians? Does he command his nation in every prayer to say: Show us their way?
Then it is said: Anything in the verse that indicates that his saying: The path of those whom You have bestowed are the Christians.

Indeed, those who have been bestowed with blessings are those whom God has mentioned in His saying - the Most High -: {And whoever obeys God and the Messenger - those are among those whom God has bestowed. Upon them are the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and those are good companions.} [An-Nisa: 69].
These are the ones whom God commanded His servants to ask for guidance on their path.

As for the Christians who were following the religion of Christ before abrogation and alteration, they were among those blessed, just as the Jews who were following the religion Moses, before the abrogation and alteration, were among those who were favored.

As for the Christians after abrogation and alteration, they are among those who have gone astray, not among those who have been favored by God and His Messenger, as God Almighty said: {Say O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the desires of a people who went astray before, and they misled many, and they went astray from the same path. The path} [Al-Maeda: 77].
And He - the Almighty - said: {Listen to them and see on the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error} [Maryam: 38].

Idol worshipers are among the misguided people who are subject to anger, and the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: The Jews are subjected to anger and the Christians are astray. It was narrated by Imam Ahmad and Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Adi bin Hatim, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and Al-Tirmidhi said: This is an authentic hadith.

The reason for this is that the Jews know the truth but do not act upon it, and the Christians worship without knowledge. God has described the Jews with deeds, And the Christians with deeds. He described the Jews as arrogant, miserly, cowardly, cruel, concealing knowledge, and following the path of wrongdoing, which is The path of desires and aggression.

And He mentioned about the Christians the extremism and innovations in worship, polytheism, misguidance, and the permissibility of the prohibitions of God, and He - the Most High - said: {O People of the Book Do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about God anything but the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, is only the Messenger of God, and His word which He conveyed to Mary, and a spirit from Him. So believe in God and His Messengers, and do not say, “Desist from three things. It is better for you.” God is only one God. Glory be to Him to have a son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the heavens. on earth, and Allah is sufficient as a disposer of affairs.} [An-Nisa’:

171] (171) {The Messiah will not refrain from being a servant of God, nor will the angels who are brought near, nor will anyone who refrain from worshiping Him and be arrogant. Then He will gather them all to Himself.} [An-Nisa: 172] (172) {So as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will pay them in full their rewards and increase them of His bounty. Those who disdain and are arrogant - then He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will not find for themselves besides Allah any guardian or helper.} [An-Nisa: 173].

And He - the Almighty - said: {And monasticism which they invented, We did not prescribe it for them except to seek the pleasure of God, but they did not care for it as it should be cared for} [Al-Hadid: 27].

That is, but We prescribed for them to seek the pleasure of God. We did not decree for them monasticism, rather they invented it, and as they invented it, what They cared for it properly, and every heresy is misguidance. They are blameworthy for the innovation of monasticism and for not caring for it properly. Her care.

As for what was decreed for them of seeking the pleasure of God, it will be achieved by doing what God has legislated for them of what is obligatory and desirable, then that is whoever pleases Him, and whoever does what God pleases him has done what was prescribed for him, and God’s pleasure is also obtained simply by performing duties, and this is Which was decreed for the servants, so if nothing was decreed for them except to seek the pleasure of God, then seeking His pleasure is obligatory. What is not obligatory is not It is a condition that they obtain what was prescribed for them.

For this reason, Ahmad ibn Hanbal and others weakened the narrated hadith: The beginning of the time is God’s satisfaction and the end of it is God’s pardon, for whoever prays at the end of The time was as He commanded, so he did what was obligatory, and with that, God is pleased with him, even if doing what is recommended and competing in obedience was attained in him. Pleasing God, and by doing so he obtains God’s pleasure and love that he does not obtain through mere duties.
As Moses - peace be upon him - said.
{And I hastened to you, my Lord, that you may be satisfied} [Taha: 84].

And in the authentic hadith narrated by Al-Bukhari and others on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “God Almighty says:

Whoever is hostile to a friend of mine has fought against me, and my servant will not draw near to me in a manner similar to what I have enjoined on him, and my slave will continue to draw near to me. To me do voluntary deeds so that I may love him. If I love him, I will be his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he strikes. With it, and his leg with which he walks, by me he hears, by me he sees, by me he runs, and by me he walks, so if he asks of Me, I will surely give him, and if he seeks refuge in Me I will seek refuge from Him, and I have not hesitated from anything that I would do as I hesitate to take the soul of My servant.
The believer hates death, and I hate its evening,” and he must say it so that I love him, he wants absolute and complete love.
As for the origin of love: it is achieved by performing the duties, for God loves the pious and the just, and whoever performs the duties is one of the The righteous and the just.

And He - the Almighty - said about them: {And the Christians said, “The Messiah is the Son of God.” That is what they said with their mouths, imitating the words of those who disbelieved before. God has killed them. How can they be destroyed?} [At-Tawbah: 30] (30) {They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, son of Mary, and they were not commanded except That they should worship one God; there is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him.} [At-Tawbah: 31].

And He Almighty said: {Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the desires of a people who had gone astray before, and had misled many.” And they have strayed from the right path} [Al-Maeda: 77].

And He - Glory be to Him - addressed the Christians about this because the Christians depend in their religion on what their elders who set the laws for them say. And the laws, and they allow their elders, who have become great with them in religion, to establish a law for them and abrogate some of what they were doing before. That is, they do not return what they dispute about in their religion to God and His Messengers, as they do not enable anyone to deviate from the revealed books of God. Such as the Torah and the Gospel, and about following what Christ brought, and the prophets before him - peace be upon them -.

For this reason, God Almighty said: {Say, “O People of the Book, you are not upon anything until you uphold the Torah and the Gospel and what has been sent down to you from your Lord” [Al-Ma’idah: 68].

Rather, what their elders established for them in terms of religious laws and Sharia laws, some of which they transmit from the prophets, and some from The disciples, and much of this is not transmitted, neither from the prophets, nor from the disciples, but rather from the fabrication and creativity of their great ones.

They also invented for them honesty, which is the foundation of their belief, and they invented for them prayer facing the east, and they invented for them the analysis of meat. The pig, and all the forbidden things, and they invented for them fasting in the spring time, and they made it fifty days, and they invented for them their feasts, such as the feast of the cross, And other holidays.
Likewise, “the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said to Adi bin Hatim when he heard him reciting this verse: ‘Take their rabbis and monks. lords besides Allah} [Al-Tawbah: 31].

He said: They did not worship them, so the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: They made permissible for them what was forbidden, so they obeyed them, and they made what was forbidden to them what was permissible. So they obeyed them, and that was their worship.” That is why God Almighty said: “And do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before, and had misled many.” And they have strayed from the right path} [Al-Maeda: 77].

For they follow the desires of their elders who went before them, and those went astray before these people and misled their followers. And they are many, and they have strayed from the straight path, and it is the middle of the path, and it is the straight path, so if they and their followers stray from the path The straight one, so how is it permissible for God to command His servants to ask Him to guide them to the straight path, by which He means the path of those who are astray? Those who mislead from the right path, which is the straight path.

And He - Glory be to Him - said: And do not follow the inclinations of these people, because the origin of their invention of this innovation came from themselves with a false belief. So they were among those about whom it was said: “They follow nothing but suspicion and what souls desire. Indeed, guidance has come to them from their Lord” [An-Najm: 23].
And from whom it was said about him.
{And who is more astray than he who follows his own desires without guidance from Allah} [Al-Qasas: 50].

The reason for this is that when the Messiah - may God bless him and grant him peace - was raised to heaven, the Jews became hostile towards him, and they treated his followers with intense hostility, and they went to extremes. By hurting them, humiliating them, and asking to kill them and exile them, hatred for the Jews rose in their hearts, and he demanded unspeakable revenge on them, so when They had a state and a kingdom, just like what had happened to them in the state of Constantine. They began to want to meet the Jews.
As is the custom in such cases between opposing sects disputing over kingship, and disputing over heresies such as the Kharijites and the Shiites,
The Jabriyah is with the Qadariyah, and the disruptive one is with the Mudhalatah, and like the two states disputing over kingship and whims, he is in the position of Qays. And Yemen, and the like.

If one sect rises against another after the other has harmed it and takes revenge on it, it wants to take its revenge, and it will not stop at any limit. Justice, but rather assault that woman as that woman accustomed herself to her.

So the Christians began to want to contradict the Jews, so they made lawful what the Jews forbade, such as pigs and other things, and they began to test those who entered into their religion. By eating pig, if he eats it, otherwise they do not make him a Christian.
They abandoned circumcision and said that baptism was a substitute for it, and they prayed facing a qiblah other than the qiblah of the Jews.
The Jews had exaggerated in their slander of Christ - peace be upon him - and claimed that he had been born of adultery, and that he was a liar and a sorcerer.
These people went to extremes in glorifying Christ, and said:

He is God and the Son of God, and things like that, and there are those who seek to say the just word about him, like many of their scholars and servants. They gather a gathering for him and curse him in it on the basis of fanaticism, following desires, and extremism regarding those whom they venerate, as is the case. For the people of whims, such as the desert among some sheikhs, some Ahl al-Bayt, some scholars, some kings, some tribes, and some sects, and some paths. The source of their error was the desires of their souls. God Almighty said of the Christians who were at the time of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings be upon him, and those after them:

{Say, O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before, and have misled many, and gone astray from the straight path} [Al-Maeda: 77].
As for their saying that the path is the doctrine, meaning the path, this is a Roman word because the path in Romans is a path.

It is said to them: Al-Sirat in the Arabic language: it is the path. It is said to be the clear path, and it is said to be the path limited by two sides from which one does not deviate. Among them is the path set up over Hell, and it is the bridge over which the believers cross to Paradise, and when the disbelievers cross over it, they fall into Hell, and it is said about it: the meaning of equator and equinox which necessitates speedy crossing over it, and it has three languages, which are three readings: the path, Al-Siraat and Al-Zarat, which is an Arabic language, is not from the Arabized language, nor was it taken from the Roman language as they claimed.
Its origin can be said from their saying: I spread the thing, I spread it in pieces. If I swallow it and stretch it, I swallow it, for the one who swallows flows quickly in a limited stream.

Among the proverbs of the Arabs: Do not be sweet, lest you be bitter, nor bitter, lest you be pardoned, from their saying: I pardoned a thing, when you removed it from your mind because of its bitterness. It is said that so-and-so stipulates what he takes from the debt.

Ya`qub ibn al-Sakit narrated: Taking is easy, and deciding is fast, and Al-Sirat: the model, because it is drawn in length, and the sword of Sarati, i.e. He is decisive, as he is a fast-moving person in his course.

Al-Siraat: It is the limited, moderate path through which its traveler reaches his destination quickly. God has mentioned the word “Sirat” in His Book elsewhere. A place, and God did not call Satan’s path a path, but rather he called them paths, and he designated his path as the path, as He Almighty said: {And indeed, this is my path. Straight, so follow Him, and do not follow other paths, lest they separate you from His path.} [Al-An’am: 153].

And in the Sunan, on the authority of Abdullah bin Masoud, he said: “The Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - drew a line for us, and wrote lines to his right and left. Then he said: This is the path of God, and these are paths. On every path there is a devil to which he invites whoever responds to him. He casts him into the Fire, then recites: {And indeed This is My path, straight, so follow it, and do not follow other paths, for lest it separate you from His path.} [Al-An’am: 153] »
So - Glory be to Him - He called His path a path, and He called those paths, and He did not call them a path as He called them a path, and He called His path a path just as He called it a path.
And He - the Almighty - said: On the authority of Moses and Aaron: {And We gave them the clear Book} [As-Saffat: 117] (117) {And We guided them to the straight path} [As-Saffat: 118].

And He - the Almighty - said: {Indeed, We have opened for you a clear conquest} [Al-Fath: 1] (1) {That God may forgive you your previous sins and those that will follow, and complete His blessings. upon you and guides you to a straight path} [Al-Fath: 2] (2) {And God will grant you victory, Mighty} [Al-Fath: 3].

This special guidance that was given to him after the conquest of Al-Hudaybiyyah is more specific than what was mentioned above, for the one who seeks God continues to draw near. to him with one thing after another, and God increases him in guidance after guidance, and the most upright and perfect path is the path with which God sent his Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings be upon him, as God Almighty said: {Indeed, this Qur’an guides to that which is most upright} [Al-Isra: 9].

chapters.title: A chapter explaining that their interpretation of the Trinity is false
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining that their interpretation of the Trinity is false]

The narrator said about them: So I said: They deny us in our saying, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and also in our saying that they are three persons. And also in our saying that Christ is Lord, God, and Creator, and they also ask us to clarify the incarnation of the Word of God the Creator with a human being. A creature.

They answered, saying: If they knew that we are saying this, we only mean the statement that means that God is a living, speaking thing, they would not have denied us that. Because when we Christians saw things happen, we knew that something other than them caused them, since it is not possible for them to happen by themselves because It contains contradiction and fluctuation.

So we said: He is something, not like created things, since He is the Creator of everything, and that is to deny Him nothingness, and we saw the things. The created being is divided into two parts: a living thing and a non-living thing, so we described it in the most beautiful of the two, so we said: it is a living thing, to deny death. About it, and we saw the living being divided into two parts: a living, speaking, and a living, non-speaking, so we described it with the better of the two, so we said: It is a living, speaking thing. Let us banish ignorance from him.

And the three names are one God, one named, one Lord, one Creator, a living, speaking thing, that is, the essence, speech, and life. So the essence we have is the father, who is the beginning of the two, and the expression, the son, who is born of him to give birth to the expression of the mind, and life. The Holy Spirit, and these are names by which we have not given Him.

The answer is from several aspects: One of them is: Their saying: As for our saying: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, if they knew that we said this, we only want to correct it. The saying that God is living and speaking when they denied that to us, so it is said: The matter is not as they claimed, for the Christians say: This is the saying. They learned it about the Gospel, and in the Gospel about Christ - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - he said:

They baptized people in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and the basis of their saying was what they mentioned, that it was received from the revealed law, not They confirmed life and its meaning with their reasoning, and then they expressed it in these terms, as they claimed in their debate.

If that were the case, they would not have needed this phrase, nor would they need to make the hypostases into three. Rather, it is known to them and to all others. People of religion that God exists, living, knowing, powerful and speaking. His attributes are not limited to three, and three of them cannot be expressed in words that do not indicate Accordingly, it is a word:

The Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. These words do not indicate what they interpreted them by in the language of any of the nations, and they are not found in the speech of Prophets because he expressed with these words the meanings they mentioned, but rather to prove what they claimed of the Trinity and express it with these The words are what they invented, for which neither law nor reason can indicate.

They claim that the trinity, the solutions, and the union only came to him from the point of view of the law, and they are the texts of the prophets and the revealed books, not With regard to reason, they claimed that the divine books spoke of that, then they interpreted what they thought was the meaning of the book in a rational way, and they interpreted it. With an explanation they thought was permissible in reason, and for this reason we find the Christians not resorting to the Trinity and the union except to the law and the books, and they They find their minds and hearts alienated from the Trinity, the unity, and the solutions, for this is the nature of God that He created people with, and what God placed in the hearts of people of rational knowledge which they may call a natural mental law that repels, denies, and alienates that, but they claim that the books God brought that, and that is something that transcends the mind, and that this speech is from a stage beyond the stage of the mind.

So they transfer it because they think that the divine books told of it, not because the minds indicated it, even though there is nothing in the divine books. It indicates that, but rather it contains what indicates its opposite, as we will mention - God Almighty willing - and they do not distinguish between what the mind distorts and invalidates. He knows that it is impossible, and among what the mind is unable to comprehend, it does not know it and does not judge it by denying it or confirming it, and that the messengers informed With the second type:

It is not permissible to tell of the first type, for they did not differentiate between the impossibilities of the intellect and the ambiguities of the intellect, and they were similar in that to those before them. The polytheists who have assigned a partner to God as a son.

God Almighty said: {And the Jews said, “Uzair is the son of God,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of God.” That is what they say with their mouths, imitating the words of Those who disbelieved before - God will fight them. How will they be spared? [At-Tawbah: 30].
They were equaled in this by the people of heresy and misguidance similar to them, from those affiliated with Islam, who say:

What they say is exaggeration regarding the prophets, the Ahl al-Bayt, the sheikhs, and others, and whoever claims unity, solutions, or union. The specific, specific, such as the claim of the Christians and the exclusive claim of the Shiites regarding Ali and a group of the Ahl al-Bayt such as the Nusayris and similar people who claim The divine nature of Ali, and as some Ismailis claim, the divine nature of Al-Hakim and others from the Banu Abdullah bin Maimun Al-Qaddah, who were affiliated with the Muhammad bin Ismail bin Jafar.

Many people called for that regarding some sheikhs, either those who are known for their righteousness, or those who are believed to be righteous but are not among its people. They have sayings that are similar to the sayings of the Christians, and some of them are worse than the sayings of the Christians.

And in general, when they are addressed with an explanation of the corruption of their speech, they say something similar to what the Christians say: This is something beyond reason, and some of them say: What Al-Tilmisani used to say to the Sheikh of the People of Al-Wahdah, he said: What has been proven with us in the revelation is what contradicts the clear transmission, and they say: For whoever wants to Follow their path: leave reason and transmission, or depart from reason and transmission.

And they chant among them: They are crazy except that the secret of their madness is... Mighty on whose feet the mind prostrates. They are a group that dissolved order and burned... the fence, but no It is imposed on them, and it is not transmitted, and these people are imitators of their sheikhs, following them in what they deviate from the law of the Messenger, and what they invented that did not God permits him to take innovations as acts of worship, and to make forbidden things permissible, such as some Christians imitating their sheikhs, and if he objects to anyone Some of them say: The old man’s condition is left to him, and he does not object to it, as the Christians say to their sheikhs. And among these people are those who say, “We are the children of God.”
He says: Christ is the son of God, and he also uses the word lust, saying that they are children of desire, and he says that he is the husband of Mary. As the Christians say so.

The main thing they do is that they tell about their sheikhs some kind of violation of customs, which may be a lie, or it may be the truth, and if it is Truthfully, it may be from the states of Satan’s guardians, such as magicians and soothsayers, or it may be from the states of the allies of the Most Gracious, and if it is from The conditions of the saints of the Most Gracious, there is nothing in this that requires imitating the saint in everything he says, because the saint does not have to be infallible, nor You must follow Him in everything He says, and believe in everything He says.

Indeed, this is one of the characteristics of the prophets, who must be believed in everything they say, and they must be believed in everything they tell. The Unseen, and obeying them in what they have made obligatory upon the nations, and whoever disbelieves in anything of what they brought is a disbeliever, and whoever insults a single prophet must be killed, This is not for anyone other than the righteous prophets.

These innovators, extremists, polytheists, who advocate some kind of solution, are similar to the Christians inasmuch as they resemble them in it, and they differ from In it is the religion of the Muslims, and among them are those whose agreement with the religion of the Muslims is greater, and as for the extremists among them, their agreement with the Christians is greater. And among them are those who are more infidels than the Christians, and since the basis of the Christians is what they transmit, either from the prophets, or from others who They make it obligatory to follow him. If they presented to their scholars something that required abstaining from that, they would say thus in the Book, and with this the Book was pronounced. These books were brought by the messengers, referring to those who supported miracles, and by the apostles they meant the apostles, so their adherence to them is merely... When they thought it was mentioned in the divine books, even if they saw it as clearly contrary to what is reasonable.

For this reason, they forbid their audience from researching and debating about it, because they know that the clear mind, whenever it envisions their religion, knows that it False, so the plaintiffs’ claim that we only said Father, Son, and Holy Spirit to correct the statement that God is living and speaking is an obvious lie, and they know It is a lie, and the correct statement that God is alive and speaking does not depend on this statement, but rather he can correct that with evidence. Shariah, auditory, and rational, and expressing it with clear expressions, as Muslims and others say, without our saying a father. And the Son and the Holy Spirit.

What explains this is the second aspect: which is that the Christians - who acknowledge that this phrase is in the Gospel taken from Christ - There are different interpretations of this word. Many of them say that the Father is existence, the Son is the Word, and the Holy Spirit is life.
Among them are those who say: Rather, the Father is existence, the Son is the Word, and the Holy Spirit is power.

Some of them say: The three hypostases are: the Generous, Wise and Powerful, so He makes the Father the Generous, the Son the Wise, and the Holy Spirit. He is the Powerful, and they claim that all attributes fall under these three, and they say: We have proven His existence by His bringing forth things. From nothingness to existence, and that is due to His presence.

I have seen in the books of the Christians this, this, and this, and among them are those who express the word with knowledge, so they say: There is a living, knowledgeable existence, or There is one who is knowledgeable and capable, as some of them say: a speaker, and among them are those who say that there is one who is alive and wise, and among them are those who say that He is self-sustaining and alive. Wise, and they agree that the one who is united with Christ and dwells in him is the hypostasis of the Word, and he is the one they call the Son instead of the Father, and who He denied solutions and unity among them, like Arianism. He says:

Christ - peace be upon him - is a servant sent, like all other messengers - may God’s prayers and peace be upon them. He agreed with them on the wording: Father, Son, and Spirit. Jerusalem, and this cannot be explained by what those who dispute it say about solutions and union.

The Nestorians also agree with this wording, and dispute with them regarding the union that the Jacobites and the monarchy say: So if They agreed on the word but disagreed on its meaning. It is known that they first believed in the word because of their belief in the coming of the law with it, then they disputed. After that in the interpretation of the book, just as they and the rest of the sects differ in the interpretation of some of the words that they believe to be quoted from The Prophets - peace be upon them -, and it is known from this that the origin of their saying:
The Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, it was not in order to correct the statement that God exists, living and speaking, which they first knew through reason.

This explains the third aspect: which is their saying, “Only when we saw things happen, we knew that something other than them caused them, if The person speaking this is a specific group of Christians, and it is said to them:

The belief in the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit existed among Christians before your existence, and before your consideration of this and your reasoning, so there is no It is possible that your view is the reason for the Christians to say this, even if what is meant by it is that all Christians from the time they said this They looked and reasoned until they said that, but this is a clear lie. The Christians say that they received these words from the Gospel, and that the Messiah - Peace be upon him - he said: Baptize people in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

Christ and the disciples did not command them to take this view that necessitated this saying, nor did Christ make this saying a requirement for them on this matter. Research, so it was known that their making this statement arising from this research is a false statement that they themselves know is false.

The fourth aspect: This saying: If Christ did not say it, then it is not permissible for it to be said, even if a person meant by it a correct meaning, then this The phrase is only understood in false senses when used, and for this reason there are many common Christians who believe that Christ is the son of God, the known sonship of creatures, and they say: Mary is the wife of God, and this is necessary for the general Christians, and if they do not say it, then He who gives birth must have a wife.
That is why God Almighty said: “How can he have a son when he has no companion? And He created everything and He has knowledge of all things” [Al-An’am: 101].

And the Lord has made the father of the newborn more objectionable in minds than the acknowledgment of his companion, whether the birth is explained by a known birth, or With mental birth, which Christian scholars say, whoever proves that it is the owner of it can interpret that, as they interpreted it. The boy, and they say:

The Father, from whom the word was born, and from Mary, humanity was born, and humanity was united with divinity, just as the Father is a father through divinity, not through humanity, and Mary is the mother of humanity, not divinity, so she is a companion of the Father through humanity, and divinity is Mary’s husband, through his divinity, just as He is the father of Christ through his divinity, and if the divinity was united with the humanity of Christ for a long period, then why did he not allow the divinity to combine with the humanity of Mary? For a short time, and if the humanity which she gave birth to is made a son of the Godhead, then for what reason will she not be made a companion and wife of the Godhead, for Christ They have a name for the combination of divinity and humanity, and to them he is a perfect God and a perfect human being. His divinity is from God, and his humanity is from Mary, so he is Of two origins:

Divinity and humanity. If one of the two originals is his father and the other is his mother, why is his mother not his father’s wife in this regard, even though Companionship before sonship? How can the necessary branch be proven without the necessary origin being proven?

There is no impossibility in this according to their origin, except what is of the kind of proving the sonship of Christ, and less impossible, even if Christ - upon him Peace be upon him - he said these words, for we know that Christ - peace be upon him - and other prophets are infallible and do not say: except the truth, and if They said something and it must have a correct meaning.

It is impossible for them to mean by their saying something that cannot be invalidated by hearing or reason, since the minds and the texts of the previous books are with the texts The Qur’an contradicts what the Christians created in Christ. It is known that Christ did not intend a false meaning that contradicts what is clearly stated and true.

Rather, we say in the fifth aspect: If this expression is correct about the infallible Messiah, peace and blessings be upon him, then he intended by that what It fits with the rest of his words, and what is found in their books is calling the Lord Father and calling his servants sons, as they mention that he said in the Torah To Jacob: “Israel,” “You are my son, my firstborn.” And he said to David in the Psalms: “You are my son and my beloved.” And in the Gospel in more than one place, Christ says:

“My Father and your Father,” as he says, “I go to my Father and your Father, and to my God and your God,” and he calls him their father, just as he calls them his sons. This was true, so what is meant by that is that He is the Lord, the Most Merciful educator, for God is more merciful to His servants than a mother is to her child, and the son is The late educator, for God’s upbringing of His servant is more complete than a mother’s upbringing of her child, so what is meant by the father is the Lord, and what is meant is Through the Son he has Christ whom he raised.

As for the Holy Spirit: it is a word found elsewhere in the books they have, and what is meant by it is not the life of God, according to their agreement, but rather For them, the Holy Spirit resides in Abraham, Moses, David, and other righteous prophets.

The Qur’an bears witness that God supported Christ with the Holy Spirit, as God Almighty said: {And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs, and We supported him with a Spirit Jerusalem} [Al-Baqarah: 87].
In two places near Al-Baqarah.
And God Almighty said: {O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessings upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Maeda: 110].

The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said to Hassan bin Thabit: “The Holy Spirit is with you as long as you defend his Prophet,” and he said: “Oh God, support him.” By the Holy Spirit” as previously mentioned, all of this is explained in detail.

And the Holy Spirit: This may mean the holy angel like Gabriel, and what is meant by it is the revelation, guidance and support that God sends down through the angel. Or without his mediation, and they may be connected, for the angel sends down by revelation, and revelation is sent down by the angel, and God - the Most High - supports His messengers with the angels and with guidance, as God Almighty said, on the authority of his Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {Then God sent down His tranquility upon him. And he supported him with armies that you did not see.} [At-Tawbah: 40].
In two places in Surah “Bara’a”.
And God Almighty said: {So We sent upon them a wind and armies that you did not see} [Al-Ahzab: 9].
And He - the Almighty - said: {When your Lord revealed to the angels, “Indeed, I am with you, so strengthen those who believe” [Al-Anfal: 12].

And He Almighty said: {You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day being friendly with those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they are their fathers or Their sons, or their brothers, or their clan: these are the ones in whose hearts He wrote faith and supported them with a spirit from Him.} [Al-Mujadila: 22].
And God Almighty said: {He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whomever He wills of His servants} [An-Nahl: 2].
And God Almighty said: {He sends the Spirit at His command upon whomsoever He wills of His servants, to warn of the Day of meeting} [Ghafir: 15].

And he said: {And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Book or faith is, but We have made it a light by which We guide whomsoever We will. Our servants} [Al-Shura: 52]

And if the Holy Spirit is known in the words of the prophets, both earlier and later, it is something that God sends down to His prophets and the righteous. His servants, whether they were angels descending with revelation and victory or revelation and support with the angel, and without the angel what is meant by the Holy Spirit is not God’s life, which is based on him, was the infallible one if he said:

Baptize people in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit. Command the people to believe in God and His Prophet whom He sent and in the angel who was revealed to him. The revelation that He brought, so that would be a command for them to believe in God, His angels, His books, and His messengers, and this is the truth that indicates It is clear and reasonable and the narration is correct.

Interpreting the words of the infallible with this interpretation, which agrees with all the words of the books that they have, agrees with the Qur’an, and agrees with reason, is better. From interpreting it in a way that contradicts what is clearly reasonable and true to what is reported.

This is an apparent interpretation that does not involve affectation, nor is it an interpretation that is diverting speech from its apparent meaning to something that contradicts its apparent meaning. Rather, it is An explanation of it according to what its apparent meaning indicates in the known language and familiar expression in the speech of Christ and the speech of the other prophets.

As for the Christian interpretation that the Son is an ancient and eternal begotten and is the knowledge or word of God, this is an interpretation of the word since this was not used. The wording in it is not in the words of any of the prophets nor in the language of any of the prophets, nor is the interpretation of the Holy Spirit in the life of God, for he who interpreted The apparent meaning of the words of Christ by the Christians is an interpretation that is not indicated by the language of Christ and his custom in speaking, nor by the language of other prophets. And the nations, but what is known in his language and speech and the speech of the rest of the prophets is to interpret it in the same way we have interpreted it, and in this way the greatest scholars have interpreted it. Christians.
As for the misguided Christians who distorted the meanings of the Books of God Almighty, they interpreted it in a way that contradicts its apparent meaning and is denied by reason and Sharia.

This is completed in the sixth aspect: which is that when the Christians had in their books the naming of Christ - peace be upon him - as a son, and the He called other prophets a son, such as his saying to Jacob: You are my son, my firstborn, and calling the disciples sons, they said, of course, he is his son. And someone else is his son by status, so they combined the word “son” between two meanings and confirmed God’s nature. They made Christ his son by consideration. That is his nature, and this confirms the statement of those among them who understand that he is his son, the sonship known among all creatures, and that Mary is the wife of God.

Likewise, they made the Holy Spirit shared between the life of God and the Holy Spirit that descends on the prophets and the righteous, and it is known that Sharing is contrary to the original, and if the word is used in several places, making it truly complicit in the common destiny is better than Making it verbally common, so that it is a truth in this regard, or it is a metaphor in one of them, for the metaphor and the combination are based on Contrary to the original, this is if it is assumed that the words “Son” and “Holy Spirit” were used in God’s speech and life, as the Christians claim. So how if it is not found in The words of the prophets are that they spoke the word of the Son, and the word of the Holy Spirit, and they meant by it something of the attributes of God, not His words, nor His life, nor His knowledge, nor Other than that, the use of the word “Son” was not found in the words of the prophets except in something created, and there was no use of the Holy Spirit as it is. The attributes of God that exist in Him, and if we interpret the Father and the Holy Spirit by the sonship of upbringing, and the Holy Spirit by what descends to the prophets, we would be We have made the word a single word combined, and they need to make the word a common word or a metaphor in one of the two meanings, so their interpretation was Contrary to the apparent meaning of the language in which they were addressed, and to the apparent meaning of the books in their hands, and our interpretation is consistent with the apparent meaning of their language, and the apparent meaning of the books that With their own hands, and then it became clear that they do not have any auditory or rational argument for the Trinity, but rather it is invalid according to the law and reason.

This is supported by the seventh aspect: which is that, in their faithfulness, they confirmed the meanings and the wording of hypostases and other things that they do not indicate. The books that were in their hands at all, but they understood from them a false meaning, and attached to it false meanings of their own, so they were distorting the Scriptures. God in that, inventing a lie against God, and this is explained in another place.

The eighth aspect: Their claim about the hypostases, despite its invalidity in reason and Sharia, was not uttered in a book with them, and this did not exist. The word is found in none of the books of the prophets that are in their hands, nor in the words of the disciples. Rather, it is a word they invented, and it is said: It is Romans. It was said: Hypostasis in their language means origin, and for this reason they are confused in interpreting hypostases. Sometimes they say: persons, and sometimes they are properties. Sometimes they are attributes, sometimes they are essences, and sometimes they make the hypostasis a name for both the essence and the attribute, and this is the interpretation of their clever people.

The ninth aspect: Their saying about Christ - peace be upon him - that he is a Creator, is a statement that is false in law and reason, a statement that was not uttered. Some of the prophecies they have, but they support that with something that does not indicate it, as we will explain, God Almighty willing.

The tenth aspect: Their statement about the incarnation of divinity - also - is a statement that is false in reason and law, a statement that is not evidenced by any of the words.
