The infallible among the prophets and messengers, the eleventh aspect: We say: There is no doubt that God is Living, All-Knowing, All-Powerful, and Speaking, and Muslims have that in mind. The rational proofs that the Messenger pointed out and guided to, and they became known by reason and referred to by Sharia, what is explained in the Its location, and despite your claim that you prove this with reason, you have not mentioned any rational evidence for this.

So your saying: When we saw things happen, we knew that something other than them caused them, since it is not possible for them to happen by themselves because of what is in them. Contradiction and fluctuation are brief words from one point of view: One of them is that you did not see the occurrence of all creatures, but rather you saw the occurrence of what is being witnessed as occurring. Such as clouds, rain, animals, plants, and the like. Where is your evidence of the occurrence of all other things?

Second: That you should have said when it was known that new things would occur, or that creatures would occur, or that anything other than God would occur, and so on. It shows that the Creator is none other than God. As for the absolute occurrence of all things, it is false. God is called by you and by the majority of Muslims. Any of the things, and this is contrary to His saying - the Almighty -: {Say: Allah is the Creator of all things} [Al-Ra’ad: 16].
This composition shows that the Creator is not the created being, contrary to the statement of the one who said that things happen.

Third: The knowledge that something new must have something new is an innate and necessary knowledge, and for this reason God Almighty said in the Qur’an: {Umm Were they created without anything, or were they the creators?} [At-Tur: 35].

“Jubayr bin Mutim said: When I heard the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - reciting it during the Maghrib prayer, I felt my heart crack,” he says - God Almighty: Were they created without a Creator? Did He create them, or were they the creators of themselves?
It is known by the natural nature with which God created His servants with a clear mind that an event does not occur except by an innovator who brings it about.

The occurrence of the event without an initiator is a known invalidity due to the necessity of the mind, and this is a matter that is established among the children of Adam, even children, if The boy was hit hard and said: Who hit me? It was said: No one hit you. His mind could not believe that the blow had occurred without an actor.

For this reason, if it were permissible for writing, building, planting, or the like to occur without someone initiating that, it would be valid according to wise people. Either he is crazy or a sophist, such as one who denies intuitive sciences and necessary knowledge, and it is also known that he did not speak to himself. It was non-existent before it occurred. It was not a thing, so it is impossible to create something else, let alone create itself.

So your statement that it did not occur by itself, because of the contradiction and fluctuation in it, is a false explanation, since we know that it did not occur by itself. themselves, not because of the contradictions and fluctuations in them, but rather whether they are similar, different, or opposites, we know frankly. The mind is that what is created does not create itself, and this is one of the clearest and clearest knowledge of the mind, just as it is known that nothingness does not create exists, and the cause of existing events is not non-existent.

The fourth aspect: You mentioned an argument that it did not occur in itself, and it is a weak argument, and you did not mention an argument that it did occur. Without an innovator, neither herself nor anyone else. If the absence of the fact that she initiated it herself requires evidence, then so does the abstention Its occurrence, without a narrator, and if it is known by reason’s intuition, and it is one of the necessary sciences, then so is the other, so mention the evidence for it. One of them without the other is wrong. If you cited sound evidence, what if the evidence is false?

Who will convey to them knowledge of the rational evidence by which they prove this knowledge of the Creator and His attributes? Then they want, along with that, to prove rational meanings and claim that they are consistent with their false understanding of the divine books, so they are among those who God said about them:

{And those who disbelieve, their deeds are like a mirage in a valley, which the thirsty person thinks is water; until when he comes to it, he does not find it to be anything, but he finds God with him, and He pays him his account. And God is quick in reckoning.} [An-Nur: 39] (39) {Or like the darknesses in a deep sea covered by waves, and above them are waves of darkness, some of which are clouds of darkness. On top of another, when he takes out his hand he can hardly see it. And for whomever God does not make light, he has no light.} [An-Nur: 40].
The twelfth aspect: Your statement: So we said that He is something, not like created things, since He is the Creator of everything, in order to deny Him Nothingness.

Then it will be said to them: There is no doubt that God is just as He described Himself in His saying - the Most High -: {There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing} [Al-Shura: 11].
And His saying: {So worship Him and be patient in worshiping Him. Do you know a name for Him?} [Maryam: 65]

That is, an example that deserves to be called by its names, and He - the Most High - says: {Say: He is God, the One} [Al-Ikhlas: 1] (1) {God is the Eternal, the Eternal} [Al-Ikhlas: 2] (2) {He does not beget, nor does He He will be born} [Al-Ikhlas: 3] (3) {And there is no one equal to Him} [Al-Ikhlas: 4]. .

This is indicated by reason, for two examples, one of which blocks the other’s obstruction, are obligatory for one of them what is obligatory for the other and abstained from doing. He is obligated to do what is prohibited for him, and what is permissible for him is permissible for him. If the Creator had an example, it would be necessary for them to participate in what is obligatory and permissible. And he refrains.

And it is necessary for the Creator to exist and have eternal existence, and non-existence is prohibited for him, so it is necessary that the created thing that is necessary to exist must be ancient, eternal, and not non-existent. It has never been created, and its being a created being necessitates that it was non-existent, so it necessitates that it be existing, non-existent, ancient and created, and it is a combination of The two opposites are not possible at the beginning of minds, and also it is not possible for the created thing to have precedence, and it is necessary for it to precede nothingness. If it was necessary for the eternal Creator What is obligatory for it, due to the fact that what is obligatory for its origin is obligatory for its occurrence after non-existence, and this is a combination of the two opposites. A clear mind asserts that With God there is nothing like Him, and discussion of this has been explained in another place, but you have not mentioned any proof for that, (rather, you said that it is a thing Not like created things, since He is the Creator of all things, and you have not mentioned any proof that He is the Creator of all things, since your foundation was based on what You witnessed it happen, but that is not all, and you did not mention

As an argument with His being the Creator of everything, there is nothing like Him. Rather, you said, “Because we Christians, when we saw things happen, we knew That something other than it created it because of the contradiction and fluctuation in it, so we said: It is something, not like created things, since He is the Creator of all things. Something, and that is to deny its nothingness, and if your evidence indicates knowledge of the Maker, it only indicates that he is a Creator, so what if it does not indicate?

There is no doubt that the Creator, Glory be to Him, must exist and not non-existent, and this is necessarily known and does not need evidence for the majority of people. Wise people and theorists, even if some of them have proven its existence with theoretical evidence, there is nothing in your evidence that indicates that it is not like things. created beings, and your saying:

Since He is the Creator of everything, it implies that He is the Creator of everything else. It does not contain a statement of denial of similarity to Him, but you have demonstrated this. Your ignorance of rational evidence is like your ignorance of the revealed books. Likewise, God Almighty informed us about the people of Hell that they will say:
{And they say, “If we had only heard or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of the Blazing Fire” [Al-Mulk: 10].

chapters.title: Separating the evidence of God’s existence and life
paragraphs: [Chapter: Evidences of God’s Existence and Life]

As for your saying: We saw created things divided into two parts: a living thing and a non-living thing, so We described it with the term of the two parts. So we said, “He is alive” in order to deny death to him.

It is said: There is no doubt that God is alive, as His revealed Books, which are His verbal verses, speak of that, and His verses indicate that. Like His creatures, which are His actual signs. God Almighty said: {We will show them Our signs on the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth} [Fussilat: 53]

That is, the Qur’an is true, and the Qur’an was previously mentioned in its saying: {Say, “Have you considered if it was from Allah and then you disbelieved in it? Who is more astray than he is?” In a far-off discord} [Fussilat: 52].
God - the Almighty - shows His servants some of His signs that are seen and observed, and that shows the truthfulness of His revealed verses, both verbally and audibly.
He - the Almighty - said: {Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting} [Al-Imran: 2]
And He Almighty said: {And put your trust in the Living One who does not die} [Al-Furqan: 58].

There are many indications of his life, including: that it has been proven that he is a scholar, and knowledge does not exist unless he is alive, and it has been proven that he is capable and chosen to do it. By His will, and the Almighty and the Chosen One can only be alive.

Among them: He is the Creator of the living and other than them, and the Creator is more perfect than the created being, so every perfection proven for the created being is from the Creator. It is impossible for a creature to be more perfect than its Creator, and for its perfection to be more perfect than Him.

The philosophers who believe in the cause by essence accept this, and say: The perfection of the effect is derived from its cause, so if He is a Creator For the living, he was alive in a better and better way.
Among them: The living is more perfect than the non-living, as God Almighty said: {And neither the living nor the dead are equal} [Fatir: 22].

If the Creator were not living, it would be necessary for the possible created thing to be more perfect than the necessary, eternal Creator, so it would be less The existing ones are more complete than the most complete ones, and this aspect deals with the evidence they mentioned, even if they did not explain it completely, but Their saying: We said, “He is alive” in order to deny death to him.

A summary of the words, for God is described with proven, perfect attributes such as life, knowledge, and power, so in order for them to be proven, it is necessary to take away the attributes of Imperfection, and He, Glory be to Him, does not praise negative attributes except because they include proven meanings, for pure nothingness and pure plunder are not to be praised. There is no perfection, as the non-existent is described as pure nothingness, and nothingness is pure negation with no perfection in it, but perfection is in existence.

For this reason, the Book of God Almighty came in this way, and He, Glory be to Him, describes Himself with proven attributes, attributes of perfection, and attributes of negation. Containing proof, such as His saying: {Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him} [Al-Baqarah: 255].

Denying taking the Sunnah and sleeping implies the perfection of his life and his continuity, since sleep is the brother of death, and for this reason the people of Paradise do not sleep. With complete rest, they will not die.

And the Ever-Living: الْقَائِمُ الْمُقِيمُ لِمَا سِوَاهُ، فَلَوْ جُعِلَتْ لَهُ سِنَةٌ أَوْ نَوْمٌ لَنَقَصَتْ حَيَاتُهُ وَقَيُّومِيَّتُهُ، فَلَمْ يَكُنْ قَائِمًا وَلَا قَيُّومًا، كَمَا ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ الْمَثَلَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، لَمَّا سَأَلُوا مُوسَى: Does your Lord sleep? So he made him incense three times, then gave him vials, but sleep took him and they broke.

He explained with this example that if the Creator of the world had slept, the world would have been exhausted. Then He, the Most High, said: {To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is the One who He intercedes with Him except by His permission} [Al-Baqarah: 255].

His denial and denial that anyone would intercede with Him except with His permission implies His complete dominion over what is in the heavens and what is on earth, and that He does not have A partner, for whoever intercedes with someone else without his permission and accepts his intercession, then he is a partner, since his intercession becomes a reason for the action of the one who is interceded for. To Him, unlike one with whom no one intercedes except with His permission, for He is alone in dominion and has no partner in any way.
Then He Almighty said: {He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not encompass any of His knowledge except what He wills} [Al-Baqarah: 255].

He denied that anyone would know any of His knowledge except by His will. It is only because He is alone in teaching, for He is the One who knows the information, and He does not know. No one knows anything except by teaching him, as the angels said: {We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, You are the All-Knowing, the All-Wise} [Al-Baqarah: 32] Then He Almighty said -: {His Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, but their preservation will not tire Him} [Al-Baqarah: 255]

That is, it does not burden him or burden him, thus demonstrating the perfection of his ability, and that he does not face the slightest difficulty, nor the slightest expense in preserving it. Creatures, as God Almighty said in the other verse: {And We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and We did not touch them. Lughob} [Q: 38].

In this way, He demonstrated the perfection of His power and that frivolity does not overtake Him in great deeds such as His creation of the heavens and the earth, as He does over created things. Idle talk is when he does a great deed, and idle talk means interruption and exhaustion. This is a broad section that will be covered in another place.

What is meant here is that he is described with the characteristics of perfection that he deserves in and of itself, and it is impossible to describe him with their opposites. And if he is described In style, what is meant is to prove perfection, and these people said: We described him as life to ward off death from him, as they said:

It is something in order to deny non-existence, and life is an attribute of perfection that it deserves in itself, and death is the opposite of it, so it is not described as life for the sake of Denying death, rather describing it as life necessitates denying death, so death is denied because it is alive, life is not proven for it in order to deny it. Death, and also to prove to it that it is something that exists, and that requires denying its nothingness, not that proving its existence for the sake of Denying nothingness, rather denying nothingness from it.

For the sake of his existence, just as death was denied for the sake of his life, and likewise their saying: We said that he is a thing, not like other things. This is to deny non-existence, but what they meant, and God knows best - even if their expression was short - was to prove existence. Denying nothingness, affirming life and denying death.

chapters.title: Detailing ways to know the attributes of the Lord
paragraphs: [Chapter: Ways to Know the Attributes of the Lord]

Then they said: And we saw the living being divided into two parts: a living, speaking, and a living, non-speaking, so we described it with the best of the two descriptions, so we said: It is speaking. Let us banish ignorance from him.

Then it will be said to them: There is no doubt that the Lord, Glory be to Him, is described as being Ever-Living, All-Knowing, All-Powerful, Speaking, Chosen. But what they said: So we said, “He is the One who speaks.” In order to deny ignorance about it, it means that you wanted to pronounce the opposite of ignorance, and this is knowledge, for knowledge contradicts ignorance. You did not want With that pronunciation, which is expression and clarification, and you do not mean by that what some theorists have made speech, which are meanings existing within the soul and not from The kind of sciences, nor the kind of wills, and then it will be said to you: There is nothing in living things except what is poetic, for every living person has a feeling that corresponds to it.

The stronger life becomes, the stronger its feeling, and the feeling of an animal may be expressed in the word knowledge, as people say: the knowledge of the leopard and the falcon. And the dog, and it is said: a marked dog, an unmarked dog, and a marked dog.
And He - the Almighty - said: {And of the preys you have learned to be chained, you teach them of what God has taught you} [Al-Ma’idah: 4].

The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “If you send your dog as a teacher, and mention the name of God and it kills, then eat.” There is no doubt that knowledge is an attribute of perfection. The knowledgeable is more perfect than the ignorant, and the evidence indicating God’s knowledge is many, such as that He, Glory be to Him, is the Creator of everything according to His will.
Will requires imagining what is desired, so He must know the creatures before He creates them.

Everything that exists outside has a specific existence that distinguishes it from anything else. So if He created it that way, He must have known it. In detail, each thing that is known is distinguished from everything else. Even if it is assumed that he only knew it in a comprehensive manner, he would not have known anything of it.
Because the universal is only universal in the minds, and as for what exists outside, it is specific and specific to itself and is not universal.

And every one of the spheres is specific, so if he knew nothing but universals, he would not have knowledge of any of the existing things, and he has been spread out in anything other than this. This has been discussed in full, and the corruption of the almost negation of this has been demonstrated, due to what they claimed about the necessity of change or multiplication, and it has been made clear that there is no In order to prove God’s knowledge of all things in detail, there is something forbidden that is refuted by sound evidence.

The multiplication of meanings he says is the meaning of the mental and auditory evidence, for he is knowledgeable, capable, and alive, and knowledge is not Power, and power is not life nor is the attribute described, and whoever makes each attribute the other, and makes the attributes the described, then it is a saying. فِي غَايَةِ السَّفْسَطَةِ.

Also, He is the Creator of the worlds of the angels, the jinn and mankind, and He made them scholars, so it is forbidden to make anyone else a scholar who is not himself. He calls himself a knower, for knowledge is an attribute of perfection, and he who knows is more perfect than he who does not know, and every perfection of a created being is from the Creator, so he refrains from That the created thing be more perfect than the Creator, and also that in the created possibilities there is something that is All-Knowing, and the eternal duty is the Creator. More perfect than possible is the created thing, so it is impossible for an imperfect, vile existent to be characterized by perfection rather than a perfect and honorable existent, and this refers to The meaning of their argument.

Also, he is alive, and life necessitates knowledge, and if his life is more complete than any other life, then his knowledge is more complete than any other life. Knowledge, but it will be said to you: Just as He is living and knowing, so He is also All-Powerful. Why did you not mention that existing things or living beings are divided into All-Powerful? And unable, it must be described with the term of the two parts, which is ability.

Especially since the evidence of his being Able is clearer than the evidence of his being a Knower, since the very fact that he is an active creator necessitates his being Able, for Action without power is impossible. Even if it is said: An inanimate object acts, then it is only acted upon by a force within it, like the natural forces within bodies. Naturally, it is impossible for the Creator of the world to have no power or ability. God Almighty said: {Indeed, God is the Provider, the Possessor of Power, the Sustainer.} [Al-Dhariyat: 58]
And God Almighty said: {Have they not seen that God, who created them, is stronger than them in power?} [Fussilat: 15].

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari there is a hadith about istikharah: “O God, I ask You for guidance with Your knowledge and I seek guidance from You with Your ability, and I ask You to please The Great, for You have power and I do not have power, and You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen.”

Many Muslim theorists who write about the principles of the religion provide evidence that He is powerful before He was knowledgeable and alive, and they say: Knowledge of this takes precedence in the theoretical deductive behavior of the significance of events and action on the ability of the active speaker, so they must prove He has the characteristic of power with knowledge.
And they also say: When the living is divided into the hearing and the non-hearing, the all-seeing and the non-seeing, we described it as the nobler of the two types. He is the Hearer and the Seeer.

The same applies to speech, if what is meant is clarification and expression, and not merely knowledge, or a meaning of the type of knowledge, for the living It is divided into a speaker, a clarifier who expresses what is in itself, and what is not like that. You must describe it with the more noble of the two types, which is speech. The one who expresses the meanings in the soul.

What is evidence of the validity of all the attributes of perfection is that if he had not been described as being alive, knowledgeable, capable, hearing, seeing and speaking, he would have been described as the opposite. This is like death, ignorance, disability, deafness, muteness, and muteness, and it is known that it is necessary to sanctify it from these shortcomings. Rather, this He is known by rational necessity, for He is the most perfect, the most exalted and the greatest of all existing beings, and the Lord of everything else, its Creator and Owner, and the Maker Everything other than Him is alive, knowing, capable, hearing, seeing, and speaking, so it is impossible for Him to be something helpless, ignorant, deaf, dumb, and mute. Rather, it is known. By the necessity of reason, the one who is characterized by these shortcomings is unable to be an agent, let alone the creator of everything.

Some atheist philosophers and those who follow them here have a well-known question, which is: It is only necessary if it is not characterized by qualities Perfection is to be described by its opposites if it is capable of them, but if it is not capable of them, then it is not necessary.
They said: These qualities are opposite to nothingness and the kingdom, which is the nothingness of a thing that would be capable of it, such as the absence of life and hearing. And sight.

And talking about the animal that is capable of it, if it is not capable of it like inanimate objects, then it is not called that when it does not have life, hearing, or sight. Speech is dead, and there is no deaf, blind, or mute.
The answer to that is in a number of ways: one of them is that it is either capable of being characterized by perfect qualities, or it is not.

If it is not possible, then it must be less than what came before it and was not characterized by it, for inanimate objects are less than an animal that has not yet been characterized by it. By the attributes of His perfection, and if He is capable of them, then if He does not have them, He must be characterized by their opposites.

These people may say: In proving it there is a resemblance of it to an animal, and they are told: And in denying it there is a resemblance of it to an inanimate object, which is smaller than an animal. If there is no resemblance to an inanimate object in its negation, then likewise there is no resemblance to it in its affirmation. With an animal, and if that involves resembling an animal, then it is forbidden. What is forbidden in resembling an inanimate object is greater, even if it is not Such an analogy is forbidden in this regard, even if it is not forbidden in this case in the same way as the first.

The second aspect: That they took away death, deafness and muteness from inanimate objects due to their claim that they are not capable of them is a pure terminology. It is found in the Word of God that inanimate objects are called dead, as God Almighty said about idols: “Dead, not living” [An-Nahl: 21].

The third aspect: The absence of these attributes is sufficient, for the mere absence of life, knowledge, and ability is an attribute of deficiency, regardless of what is described. Whether he accepts it or not, but if it is determined that he is not capable of it, then that is the most significant deficiency.
He knew that denying these qualities about himself, and denying their acceptance, meant that he should be inferior to the blind, deaf animal that accepts them, even if He was not characterized by it.

The fourth aspect: Perfection is in existence, and imperfection is in nothingness. The essence of affirming these attributes is perfection, and the essence of negating them is deficiency, even if not It is characterized by its imperfection, that the object be more perfect than the subject, and that the created, possible thing, and creation be more perfect than the previous. The Eternal, Necessary Existent, the Creator, and this was impossible at the beginning of the minds, and these matters are explained elsewhere, but We have highlighted them here in order to explain some of the ways in which the attributes of the Lord are known, and to show that these people are among the sects who are ignorant of the Lord.

The ways in which his perfection is known are intellectual and auditory, and that the people have some of the words of the prophets unless they understand much of them. And they did not distort much of it, and they have reason in that in which the Jews prefer them, but the Jews, even if they know better Among them, they are more stubborn, arrogant, and ungrateful for the truth. The Christians are more ignorant and misguided than the Jews, but they are more devout, ascetic, and good. Morally, and for this reason they were closest in affection to those who believed, both Jews and polytheists.

chapters.title: Chapter explaining the names of God Almighty
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explanation of the Names of God Almighty]
They said: And the three names are one God, one Lord, one Creator, one named, and He has always been and continues to be a living, speaking thing. The self, speech, and life.
For us, the essence is the father, who is the beginning of the two.
And the pronunciation: the son who is born of him as the pronunciation is born of the mind.
And life: is the Holy Spirit.

The answer to this is from several aspects: The first is that the names of God, Blessed and Most High, are many and many, for He is: {He is God, there is no god. Except He, the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.} [Al-Hashr: 22] (22) {He is Allah, there is no god but He, the King, the Holy, the Peaceful, the Faithful. The Dominant, the Mighty, the Mighty, the Arrogant. Glory be to God above what they associate with Him.} [Al-Hashr: 23] (23) {He is God, the Creator, the Creator, the Creator, the One who creates the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.} [Al-Hashr: 24]
And He Almighty said: {And to Allah belong the most beautiful names, so call upon Him by them, and leave those who deny His names. They will be recompensed for what they used to do} [Al-A’raf: 180].
And He - the Almighty - said: {Say: Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Gracious - whichever you call upon - to Him belong the best names} [Al-Isra: 110].

And He - the Almighty - said: {Taha} [Taha: 1] (1) {We have not sent down to you the Qur’an that you should be miserable} [Taha: 2] (2) {Except as a reminder to him who fears} [Taha: 3] (3) {A revelation from Him who created The earth and the highest heavens} [Taha: 4] (4) {The Most Gracious has established Himself above the Throne} [Taha: 5] (5) {To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and what is between them and what is under them. Al-Thara} [Taha: 6] (6) {And if you speak loudly, then he knows the secret and what is hidden} [Taha: 7] (7) {Allah, there is no god but He. To Him belongs the best names} [Taha: 8].
And in the two Sahih books on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - he said: “Indeed, God has ninety-nine names. Whoever remembers them will enter Paradise.”

This means, according to the most famous and correct of the two sayings of the scholars, that of His names - the Most High - are ninety-nine names. Whoever counts them will enter Paradise. Otherwise, his names, Blessed and Most High, are more than that, as in the other hadith narrated by Ahmad in his Musnad, and Abu Hatim in Sahih, on the authority of Ibn Masoud, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said:

“Never has a servant been afflicted with worry or sadness and said, ‘O God, I am your servant, the son of your servant, the son of your female servant. My forelock is in your hand. Your decree, I ask you by every name that is yours by which you have named yourself, or which you have revealed in your book, or which you have taught to any of your creation, or which you have taken away. With it in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Qur’an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the remover of my sadness, and the remover of my worry and grief. He was worried and sad, and he changed his place to joy. They said: O Messenger of God, shall we not learn them? He said: Yes, it should be for those who
He heard them and learned them.”

If the names of God are many, such as Al-Aziz, Al-Qadeer, and others, then limiting it to three names and not the others is invalid, and anything The claim of the claimant that these names are unique to him and not others is false, as has been explained in another place.

The second aspect: Their saying of the father who is the beginning of the two, and the son: the expression from which he is born, like the birth of the expression from the mind, False talk, for the attributes of perfection are indispensable to the Essence of the Lord Almighty first and last, and He has not ceased to be and is still alive, knowing and capable. He did not become alive after He He was not alive, nor a scientist after he was not a scientist.

So if they say: The Father, who is the Essence, is the beginning of life and speech, this necessitates that the Father be before life and speech. And to be the agent of life and speech, for what is the beginning of something else is prior to it or is the agent of it.
In the eyes of God, this is false.
And so is their saying:

Speech is born from it just as speech is born from the mind, for what is born from something other than it is generated from it, so it occurs after it did not exist, as Speech occurs little by little, whether what is meant by utterance is knowledge or clarification, neither of which is necessary for the speaking soul, but rather occurs within it. And she characterized it after it did not happen, even if she was the recipient of it and spoke with power, then if they represented the generation of speech from the Lord as its generation from Reason requires that the Lord was a speaker by power, then he became a speaker by action, so it is necessary that he became a knower after he was not a knower. This is the greatest disbelief and the most impossible, for nothing else makes him possess perfect qualities after he was not characterized by them. Since everything other than Him is created for Him and its perfection is from Him, it is impossible for Him to be the Creator of the Lord, Glory be to Him and - the Most High - perfect.

This is an impossible role in the clear mind, since a thing does not cause another to be characterized by perfect attributes, such that it itself is characterized by them, If he is not characterized by it until someone else makes him characterized by it, then the impossible role remains, such as each of the two things being the agent of the other and its cause or cause. Because of some of its conditional attributes in action, it became clear that the fact that its speech was generated from it was invalid, just as speech is generated from the mind, just as it is invalid for it to be His necessary attributes have something that is a principle for them that precedes them or is an agent of them.

The third aspect: Their saying about the Son that he was born of God, if they meant by it, is that it is an essential attribute of him. Likewise, life is an attribute necessary for God, so the Holy Spirit is also a second son, and if they mean by it that it came from him after it did not exist, he became a knower after it did not exist Be a scholar, and despite this being falsehood and disbelief, something similar to it is necessary in life, which is that he became alive after he was not alive.

The fourth aspect: Calling the life of God the Holy Spirit is something that has not been uttered in any of God’s revealed books, so calling the Holy Spirit May God protect you from their alteration and distortion.

The fifth aspect: They claim that what is united with Christ is the Word, which is knowledge, and this is if they mean by it the same essence. The speaking scholar, Christ was the Father, and Christ himself was the Father, and he is the Son, and he is the Holy Spirit, and this is according to them And for all people it is falsehood and disbelief.

And if they say that what is united with Him is knowledge, then knowledge is an attribute that does not separate from the world, nor does it separate from the other attribute that is life, so it is impossible for it to be united. It has knowledge without self, and without life.

The sixth aspect: Knowledge is also an attribute, and the attribute is neither created nor provided, and Christ Himself is not an attribute that exists with others by agreement. wise people, and also, according to them, he is the Creator of the heavens and the earth, so it is impossible for him to be united with an attribute, for the God who is worshiped is the God He is the Living, the Knowing, the Powerful, but He is not the same as Life, nor is He the same as knowledge and speech.

If someone said: O life of God, or oh knowledge of God, or oh word of God, forgive me, have mercy on me and guide me, this would be falsehood in a clear mind, For this reason, it is not permissible for any of the people of that religion to say of the Torah or the Gospel or other words of God, “Forgive me and have mercy on me,” but rather It is said to the God who speaks these words: Forgive me and have mercy on me.

For you, Christ - peace be upon him - is the Creator God to whom it is said, “Forgive us and have mercy on us.” If he were the same as God’s knowledge and words, he would not have It is possible for him to be a worshiped god, so how if he is not the same as God’s knowledge and words, but rather created by His words, as He said to him: Be. So it will be?

So it became clear from that that the words of God are many and have no end, and in the divine books such as the Torah that He created things with His words, And it was at the beginning of the Torah that He said: Let it be thus, let it be that.
It is known that Christ is not many words, but rather his goal is to be one word, as he was created with one of the words of God Almighty. Glory be to Him.

The seventh aspect: Your trustworthiness, which was established by your leaders in the presence of Constantine, is the doctrine of your faith that you made the foundation of your religion. It contradicts what you claim that God is one, and shows that you are saying to those who debate with you the opposite of what you believe.

These are two well-known matters in your religion: your contradiction and your demonstration in the debate contrary to what you say from the foundation of your religion. Which the majority of Christians agreed upon, saying:

I believe in one God, Father Almighty, Creator of heaven and earth, all things visible and unseen, and in one Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God The only begotten begotten of the Father before all ages, Light from Light, true God from true God, of the essence of His Father, begotten, not created, equal To the Father in the essence by whom all things were made, who for us men, and for our salvation, came down from heaven, and was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, And of the Virgin Mary, and became man, and was crucified, and suffered, and was buried, and rose again on the third day according to the Scriptures, and ascended into heaven, and is seated on The right hand of the Father, and He will come again in His glory to judge the living and the dead, whose kingdom is without end, and by the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceeds from The Father who is with the Father and the Son, who is worshiped and glorified, speaking through the prophets, one catholic and apostolic Church, and I confess Through one baptism for the forgiveness of sins, and a Son who came to the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come, because he was faithful.

In this trust that you have made the foundation of your religion, belief in three things in one God, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, the Creator of What is seen and what is not seen, this is the Lord of the worlds, besides whom there is no god, and no Lord, and He is the God of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all others. The prophets and messengers, and He is the one whom all the messengers were called to worship alone, without any partner, and they forbade anyone to worship anyone other than Him, as God said - God Almighty -: {And We did not send before you any messenger except to him that We revealed: There is no god but Me, so worship Me} [Al-Anbiya’: 25].
And He Almighty said: {And ask those whom We sent before you of Our messengers: Have We made gods to be worshiped besides the Most Gracious?} [Al-Zukhruf: 45].

Then you said: And in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all ages, Light from Light, true God from God. Truly, from the essence of His Father, begotten, not created, of one essence with the Father, you have professed faith with the Creator of the heavens and the earth in one Lord. A created being, equal to the Father, the only-begotten Son of God, and you said: He is true God from true God from the essence of His Father.

This is a declaration of belief in two gods, one of the other, and the knowledge of God that exists in it, or His words or wisdom that exists in it, which you have named. A son, and none of the apostles called the attribute of God a son. He is not a true god from a true god, but rather one God, and this is an attribute of God, an attribute God is not a god, just as His power, hearing, sight, and all of His attributes are not gods, and because God is one, His attributes are multiple. And God is a entity characterized by attributes that subsist in itself, and the attribute subsists in what is described, and because you called God an essence, and you said:
He is self-existent, and the attribute is not a self-existent essence.

In this faithfulness, they made God a father, who is the Father, and a begotten man, who is the Son, and made him equal to him in essence. God Himself is different from the three types, so they said: He is begotten, not created, and equal in essence to the Father. So they declared that He is equal to Him in essence. Equal is not equal.
The Father is only one essence equal to the Father, so the Son must be a second essence, and the Holy Spirit a third essence, as will follow.
This is a declaration that three essences and three gods are proven, and they say with that: We only affirm one essence and one God. This is a combination of the two opposites.

It is the truth of their saying that they combine making the gods one, and proving three gods, and proving one essence, and Proof of it are three jewels, and God has distanced Himself from that by saying: {Say: He is God, the One} [Al-Ikhlas: 1] (1) {God, the Eternal, the Eternal} [Al-Ikhlas: 2] (2) {Why? He begot but He was not born} [Al-Ikhlas: 3] (3) {And there was no one equal to Him} [Al-Ikhlas: 4].
So He exalted Himself to give birth as they say He is the Father, and to be born as they say He is the Son, and to have someone equal to Him, as They say: He has someone equal to Him in essence.

And if you say, “We say that a true God is a single entity with three attributes,” you will be told: You have declared that a true God is proven from a true God, and that He is equal. of the father in essence, and this is a statement proving a second essence and not an attribute, so you combined the two sayings by proving three essences, and The claim of proving one essence, and the apology of those among you who apologized such as Yahya bin Adi and the like, where they said: This In the same way that you say: Zaid, the physician, the calculator, and the scribe. Then you say: Zaid, the physician, Zaid, the calculator, and Zaid, the scribe.

With each attribute, He has a ruling different from His ruling with the other attribute, and they may explain the hypostasis in this way, so they say: The hypostasis is the essence. With the attribute, the essence with every attribute is a hypostasis, so the hypostases became three, because this example does not match your statement, for Zaid here is One essence has three attributes: medicine, arithmetic, and writing. There are not three gems here, but each attribute has a ruling that the other does not.

No rational person will say: The attribute is equal in essence to the thing described, nor that the essence with this attribute is equal in essence to the entity with the other attribute. Because the essence is one, and the equal is not the equal, and because the essence with the characteristic is the father, then this is the one who was united with Christ. The One who is united with him is the Father, and because you said about this man that you said:

(He is true God from true God, from the essence of his Father, who is equal to the Father in essence, and that he descended and was incarnated by the Holy Spirit, and from The Virgin Mary, and became man, and was crucified and suffered. This necessitated that the true God, equal in essence to the Father, be crucified and suffer, so that He Divinity crucified and suffering, and some groups of you acknowledge this and some groups deny it, but the requirement of your honesty is the first.

Also, if he was incarnated by the Holy Spirit and Mary, then if the Holy Spirit is the life of God, as you claimed, then Christ is the word of God. And his life, so his divinity is two of the three hypostases, and according to them he is only the hypostasis of the Word, even if the Holy Spirit is not He is the life of God. Your interpretation of the Holy Spirit that it is the life of God is invalid.
And it was said to you: The Holy Spirit must not be an attribute of God or a hypostasis.

Then you mentioned in the doctrine of your faithfulness that you believe in the Holy Spirit of the Lord, the Giver of life. So you established a third Lord. You said, “He who proceeds from the Father.” And emanation: eruption, such as eruption, effusion, and the like. It is said: the eruption of the stream in such and such a place, erupting it erupting, i.e. piercing it. He split it open and it emanated, meaning it exploded. This meant that this life-giving Lord emanated from the Father and flowed from him.
Then you said: He is with the Father, prostrated to Him and glorified, speaking to the prophets. So you made Him prostrated with the Father, and you established a third God. He is prostrated to him.

It is known that the life of God, which is His attribute, does not emanate from Him, but rather exists in Him and does not depart from Him at all, and it is a necessary attribute. Do not relate to anyone else, for knowledge relates to information, ability to capabilities, and speaking to those who are addressed other than speaking. It is an intransitive adjective. It is said: God knew such-and-such, God had power over everything, and God spoke to Moses.

As for life: the word indicating it is intransitive and does not relate to anything other than the living. It is said: “life” “life” “life”, and it is not said “so-and-so” or “such-and-such”. It is only said:

He revived such-and-such, and revival is an action other than being alive, just as teaching is different from knowledge, ability is different from ability, and speaking is different from speaking. Then you made this Holy Spirit speaking through the Prophets - peace be upon them -, and the life of God is an attribute that exists in Him and cannot be found in anyone else, and the Holy Spirit What is in the prophets and the righteous is not the life of God that exists in him, even if the Holy Spirit who is in the prophets were one of the hypostases. The three, so that each of the prophets would have been a worshiped god, His humanity united with divinity, like Christ among you, for Christ was not united with anyone. The hypostases became humanity and divinity, so if the Holy Spirit, who is one of the three hypostases, spoke through the prophets, each of them was in him. Divinity and humanity like Christ, and you do not acknowledge the solutions and union except for Christ alone, while you prove to others what is proven to him.

At times, they liken the two hypostases - knowledge and life, which they call the Word, and the Holy Spirit - to the light and heat of the sun, along with The sun, and they liken that to life and the communication that the soul has with the soul, and this is a corrupt comparison, for if they meant by light Heat is what is sustained by the essence of the sun, so that is an attribute of the sun that exists in it and is not replaced by anything else nor is it united with anything else. Just as the attribute of the soul is The same applies if it is said that the sun gives off heat, otherwise this is forbidden.
What is meant here is to show the corruption of their speech and analogy.

And if they want something that is separate from the sun and stands elsewhere. Like the rays that radiate through the air and the earth, and the heat that emanates from that, this was evidence of the falsity of their statement in many ways, including: that These are symptoms that are separate and separate from the sun and stand in parallel with anything else, not with it. The equivalent of this is the knowledge that takes place in the hearts of the prophets. And the wisdom and revelation with which they were warned. According to this assessment, there is nothing of divinity in humanity, but rather it contains traces of His wisdom and power.
Among them: that heat and light in the air and walls are symptoms other than the sun, and the Word and the Holy Spirit to them are Two essences.

Among them: This is not the sun, nor is it one of the attributes of the sun, but rather an effect that occurred in something other than the sun due to the sun, and such a thing does not It is denied that he will lead the prophets and the righteous, but Christ - peace be upon him - has no jurisdiction over that, so what happened to Christ is also done to others. Messengers, and what is not permissible for anyone else is not permissible for him, so there is no specialization for him in a matter that requires him to be a god to the exclusion of other messengers, and there is no unity here. Between divinity and humanity, just as the sun and its inherent attributes are not united with the air and the earth from which the rays and heat occurred.

chapters.title: The chapter in response to their claim is that God has called Himself Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
paragraphs: [Chapter: Refuting their claim that God called Himself Father, Son, and Holy Spirit]

They said: We Christians did not give him these names on our own initiative, but rather God named his divinity by them, and that is because He said On the tongue of the Prophet Moses in the Torah, addressing the children of Israel, saying: Is not this the father who made you, blessed you, and acquired you? And also on his own tongue, saying: And the Spirit of God moved upon the water, and on his saying on the tongue of David the prophet: Your Holy Spirit shall not be taken from me, and also on By his tongue, by the word of God the heavens and the earth were strengthened, and all their powers were strengthened by the spirit of his mouth.

And he said: On the tongue of Isaiah: (The astragalus withers and the grass withers, and the word of God abides forever), and on the tongue of the righteous Job, the Spirit of God He created me and is teaching me.)

And the Lord Christ said in the Holy Gospel to the pure disciples: (Go into all the world and baptize them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Spirit of Jerusalem is one God, and teach them to observe all that I have commanded you.) And He said in this book: {And indeed Our word to Our servants preceded The Messengers} [Al-Saffat: 171].
He also said: {O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessings upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Maeda: 110].
He also said: {And God spoke to Moses in a manner} [An-Nisa: 164]

And he said in Surat Al-Tahrim: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures. And she was of the obedient ones} [Al-Tahrim: 12].

And all other Muslims say: The Book is the word of God, and there is no word except a living, speaking voice. These are essential attributes that run the same course as names. Each of its attributes is different from the other, and God is one and not separate or divided.

The answer is in a number of ways: One of them is to say: The words of the prophets, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, are only truth and sincerity, and there is nothing in them. Something is known to be false by a clear mind, even if there is something in it that the mind is unable to know without informing the prophets, and there is no speech. The prophet who tells it contradicts his words in another place, nor the words of the other prophets, but everything that the prophets have told is true. And it is true, some of it confirms the other.

God has made it obligatory for us to believe in everything we are told, and He has decreed disbelief for whoever believes in part of that, and disbelieves in part of it, and he did not know it. With a clear mind, he does not contradict what is known by correct transmission from the Prophets, and what is taught by correct transmission from some of them does not contradict what he knows by transmission. Which is more correct than others, but some laws and approaches may differ regarding commands and prohibitions.
As for what they inform about God and His angels and His books and His messengers and the Last Day,
Other than that, it is not permissible for them to contradict each other.

And if that is the case, then what they transmit from the prophets is only used to complete the argument if its chain of transmission and text are known, so it is known that it was transmitted. An authentic narration from them, and we know that its translation from Hebrew to another language, such as Roman, Arabic, and Syriac, is a translation It is correct, and it is known after that that they meant that meaning.

The Christians do not have any proof from the prophets in which these three premises are proven. In this case, it is enough for us to prevent and demand. They ask them to correct these premises, as they claimed that the trinity they took from the prophets, so we demand that they correct these. Introductions.

The second answer: We explain the interpretation of the words they mentioned, as for his saying on the tongue of Moses - peace be upon him - addressing the Children of Israel, saying: (Is not the Father who made you, blessed you, and acquired you)? This is because he called him the father of someone other than the Messiah - peace be upon him -, and this is equivalent to his saying to Israel: (You are my son, my firstborn), and David (my son My beloved), and the saying of Christ (my father and your father), and they acknowledge that what is meant by this is with regard to non-Christs, in the sense of the Lord, not in the sense of generation that They single out Christ.

Third: This is an argument against them, since in the previous books he was called the father of someone other than the Messiah, and what is meant by that is nothing but the meaning of the Lord. It is known that this word in the language of the Scriptures means the Lord, so it must be taken in relation to Christ in this sense, because the original is not to share In speech.
Fourth:

Using it in the meaning they assigned to Christ is only proven if it is known that the meaning they claimed in Christ was intended. If it is proven That is what is meant by simply using the word “father” as a necessity of the turn. It is not known that this meaning was intended, since it is proven that it was What is meant by it in relation to God is this meaning, but this is not proven, until it is known that this meaning was intended in relation to Christ, so if it stops The knowledge of each of them over the other, neither of them knew, so it became clear that they had no knowledge that it was intended against the Messiah, in words The father is what they assigned to him in the dispute.

The fifth aspect: It is found in the books of the prophets and their words to use the name of the Father, and what is meant by it is the Father of Divinity, and not to use the name of the Son. What is meant by it is something of the Godhead, not His Word or His life. Rather, there is no word “Son” except when what is meant is the created being, so the word “Son” is not Except for a created son.

In that case, it becomes necessary from this that the name of the Son in Christ’s name is humanity, and this invalidates their statement: “The Son and the Holy Spirit.” They are two attributes of God, and that Christ is a name for divinity and humanity, so it became clear that the texts of the books of the prophets invalidate the Christian doctrine, and contradict Because of their honesty, they are between two things: between belief in the words of the prophets (and the invalidity of their religion.
And between correcting their religion and disbelieving the prophets), and this is what is required.

chapters.title: A detailed explanation of the meaning of the spirit in his saying, “And the spirit of God hovered over the water.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of the spirit in the saying: And the Spirit of God moved upon the water]
They said: And also on his tongue, saying: (And the Spirit of God hovered over the water).

This is said in the first book, “the book of creation,” at its beginning, when it was mentioned that in the beginning he created the heavens and the earth, and that they were The earth was covered with water, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the water. He declared that the water was above the dust, and the air was above the water, and the Spirit of God was It is the wind that was above the water.

This is the interpretation of all nations, including Muslims, Jews, and Christian wise men, and the word “spirit” in Hebrew is pronounced with a plural of the r and emphasis. The waw, which is the spirit, and the wind is called spirit, and its plural is spirits. This does not mean that the life of God was floating on the water.

This would not be said by a rational person, for the life of God is an attribute that exists in Him and does not depart from Him or be sustained by anything else, so it is impossible for it to be sustained by water or anything else. In addition to floating on the water, the one who floats on the water is a body that stands on its own, and this is information about the wind that was moving above Water.

An example of this is the saying of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace -: “Do not curse the wind, for it is from the Spirit of God. It brings mercy and brings punishment. Curse it, but seek refuge in God from its evil, and ask God for its good.” And His saying: “Indeed, I find the breath of the Most Merciful before Yemen.”

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of his saying on the tongue of David, “Do not take away your holy spirit from me.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of his saying on the authority of David, “Do not be taken from me, Your Holy Spirit.]
They said: And he said on the tongue of David the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Your Holy Spirit shall not be taken from me.”

It is said: This is evidence that the Holy Spirit was in David, so it was known that the Holy Spirit that was in Christ was of this kind, so it was known Therefore, the Holy Spirit is not specific to Christ, and they acknowledge that, for what is in the books that are in their hands is in no place that the Holy Spirit It occurred among people other than the Messiah in David, in the Apostles, and in others.

Then, if the Holy Spirit is the life of God and whoever dwells in it is divinity, it must be God and all these things must be in them. Divinity and humanity like Christ, and this is contrary to the consensus of Muslims, Christians, and Jews.
It is also necessary for Christ to have in him the divinity of the Word and the Holy Spirit, so that Christ, along with humanity, would be two hypostases:

I am the hypostasis of the Word, and I am the hypostasis of the Holy Spirit. Also, this is not an attribute of God that exists in Him, for the attribute of God that exists in Him, but rather a description Every description you do not separate from and do something else, and this does not mean that God’s name is the Holy Spirit, nor that his life is called the Holy Spirit, nor that the Spirit Jerusalem, from which Christ was incarnated, and from Mary, is the life of God, Glory be to Him, the Most High, and you said, “We Christians have not named it.” These names are from our souls, but God named His divinity by them, and it is not in what you mentioned about the prophets that God called Himself, nor None of His attributes by the Holy Spirit, and He did not call Himself nor any of His attributes a Son, so your naming of His attribute, which is life by the Holy Spirit, is invalid. And because of his characteristic, which is knowledge of the Son.

Also, you claim that Christ is specific to the Word and the Spirit, so if the Holy Spirit was in David - peace be upon him - and the Apostles And others, what you singled out for Christ is invalid, and it is known by agreement that David is a servant of God Almighty, even if the Holy Spirit was in him.
Likewise, Christ is a servant of God, and if the Holy Spirit was in him, then what you mentioned about the prophets is an argument against you for the people of Islam, not An argument for you.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of his saying, on the tongue of David, by the word of God the heavens and the earth were strengthened, and all their powers were strengthened by the spirit of his mouth
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of his saying on the tongue of David: By the word of God were the heavens and the earth strengthened, and all their powers were strengthened by the spirit of his mouth.]

They said: And also on the tongue of David the Prophet - peace be upon him -: By the word of God the heavens and the earth were strengthened, and all their powers were strengthened by the spirit of his mouth.

It is said: As for his saying: By the word of God the heavens and the earth were strengthened, it is also an argument against you for several reasons: one of which is that God created things. With His word, which is (Kun), just as He said in the Torah (Let it be such and such, let it be such and such) and likewise in the Psalms: (For He said, and they were, And it is a matter, so they were created.) So he made their being based on his statement.
Such as his saying in the Psalms: (All things I have created with wisdom), and in the Qur’an: {His command, when He intends something, is to say to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.’” [Yasin: 82] .
These words are not the Christ.

Second: The word of God is a general noun, for the words of God have no end. God Almighty said: “Say, ‘If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, it would run out. The sea before the words of my Lord are exhausted, even if We had brought the like of it as a reinforcement” [Al-Kahf: 109].
The Torah indicates the multiplicity of words, and if that is the case, then Christ is not the sum of words, but rather he was created by one of them.

Third: That Christ is the Creator among you, and while you say that He is the Son and the Word, you say that He is the Creator God, and you say He is a true God from a true God, and you say: One God, so you combine the two opposites, and if He is the Creator, then He is the one who strengthens the heavens. And the earth, it is not said by it that the heavens and the earth were strengthened, but rather it is said by it insofar as it is an attribute of what is described, so it is said: God created things with a being. And He created things by His power.

And his saying: (By his word the heavens and the earth were strengthened) implies that the word is an adjective of a verb because it is the Creator and the Messiah. To you, He is the Creator, not an attribute of creation.
Fourth: That the word of God is meant by a kind of His words, as God Almighty said: {And He made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, and the word of God the highest} [Al-Tawbah: 40]

And as the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “Whoever fights so that the word of God may be supreme is in the path of God.” In that case, what is meant is that God He established the heavens and the earth with His word, as He said, “Be.” And this does not constitute an objection to Christ - peace be upon him -.

As for our narration that he said: (And in the spirit of his mouth all their powers), this word, whether it is true or false, you have no argument for it. Because if by this word what is meant is the life of God, then proving the life of God is true, and he did not call the life of God the Holy Spirit, as you claimed, although He wanted something other than the life of God, which did not benefit you, for you claimed that the life of God is the Holy Spirit, to the point that you said what he meant in the Gospel when he said:

(Baptize people in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit) is the life of God, and you claimed that the prophets called it that, but you did not mention a citation. Concerning the prophets, they called his life the Holy Spirit. Rather, you mentioned about them what is consistent with what is in the Qur’an, but that is not what is meant by the Holy Spirit. The life of God. Even if it were assumed that this word was used in this and that, it would not be certain that Christ meant when he said: (The Holy Spirit) the life of God. So how if it was never used in the words of the prophets - may God’s prayers and peace be upon them all - in the life of God?

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the correct meaning of the Spirit of God
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the true meaning of the Spirit of God]
They said: And his saying: On the tongue of the righteous Job, the Spirit of God created me and is teaching me.

It will be said that there is no evidence for this because you claimed that the prophets called the life of God the Holy Spirit, and this did not say the Holy Spirit, rather he said The Spirit of God.

By the spirit of God, what is meant is the angel, who is a spirit that God chose and loved her, as He said in the Qur’an: “So We sent to her our spirit, and he appeared to her as a human being.” Together} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious.” [Maryam: 18] (18) {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a boy.” Pure} [Maryam: 19].
He reported that he sent his spirit to her and appeared to her as a normal human being, and it became clear that he was his messenger.
He learned that what is meant by the soul is an angel, it is a soul that he chose and added to it, just as he adds to objects that he has assigned characteristics that he likes.
Such as his saying: {Allah’s she-camel and He watered it} [Al-Shams: 13].
And His saying: {And purify My House for those who circle around, and those who stand and those who kneel and prostrate} [Al-Hajj: 26].
And His saying: {A spring from which the servants of God drink} [Al-Insan: 6].

And what is attributed to God, if it is an attribute that does not attach to a created being, such as knowledge, power, speech, or life, then it is an attribute of Him, even if it is an existing entity. By itself or as an attribute of something else, such as a house, a she-camel, a slave, or a soul, it was a created thing owned and attached to its creator and owner, but The addition requires that the added person be singled out for characteristics that distinguish him from others, such that he deserves the addition, just as the Kaaba and the camel were singled out. And the righteous servants are called “the house of God,” “the she-camel of God,” and “the servants of God.” Likewise, the chosen soul is designated to be called “the soul.” God.

Unlike evil spirits, such as the spirits of devils and infidels, they are created for God, and cannot be added to Him like the holy spirits. Likewise, inanimate objects are not added to it as the Kaaba is added, nor are people’s she-camels added to it, as the camel of Salih, which was one of his signs.
As God Almighty said: {This is the she-camel of God as a sign for you} [Al-A’raf: 73].

If that is the case, then this word, if it is confirmed from the Prophet and translated correctly, may mean that the angel formed me in the womb. My mother, and he is teaching me, because the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: “When the sperm has passed through forty-two nights, God will send to it an angel So He shaped it and created its hearing, its sight, its skin, its flesh, and its bones. Then He said: O Lord, whether male or female, and your Lord will decide as He wills. And the angel writes, then says: O Lord, what is his term? So your Lord says whatever He wills, and the angel writes, then he says: O Lord, provide for him?

Then your Lord says what He wills, and the angel writes, then the angel comes out with the scroll in his hand, and nothing is added to or subtracted from.” Narrated by Muslim from The hadith of Hudhayfah bin Usayd al-Ghifari.

It may be said: From this is his saying in the Psalms in the creation psalm: You send out your spirit and they are created. And in the psalm also he said: And they were, and he commanded So they were created, and creation may be added to kingdom.
From this point of view, God Almighty says: {Indeed, I create for you from clay the likeness of a bird, and I breathe into it, and it becomes a bird, God willing} [Al Imran: 49].
So he told him that he would create a bird out of clay in the shape of a bird, God willing, and likewise the angel creates the sperm in the womb, God willing.

It is not permissible to mean by it that the life of God created me and teaches me, for the attribute does not create or teach. Rather, the described Lord creates and teaches, who He created man from a clot of clots. He taught by the pen. He taught man what he did not know, but He, Glory be to Him, creates through the angels. The angels are God’s messengers to creation, so it is permissible for the verb to be added to the media at times, and to the Lord at other times, and this is found in the divine books. In other places, as in the Qur’an: {Allah takes souls at the time of their death and those who do not die in their sleep} [Az-Zumar: 42].
And in another place: {Until when death comes to one of you, Our messengers will take him to his soul, and they will not neglect} [Al-An’am: 61].
And in a third place: “Say, ‘The Angel of Death will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned.’” [Al-Sajdah: 11].

And everyone is true, so if there is a word that has a meaning in the words of some of the prophets, and there is not a meaning that contradicts that in their words, then it is Taking it to that meaning is better than taking it to a meaning that contradicts their words, and it is not found in their words that the life of God is called spirit, nor that the attributes of God creates creatures.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the correct meaning of the word God
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the true meaning of the word of God]
They said: And his saying: on the tongue of the prophet Isaiah: (The astragalus withers, and the grass withers, and his word endures forever).

It is said: Either by the word of God he means his knowledge, or a specific word, or the word of God is a generic noun, and according to the three interpretations you have no argument. In this regard, if the word of God is a generic name for everything that God spoke about, as He said: {And He made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, and the word of God is The Most High} [At-Tawbah: 40].
The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Whoever fights so that the word of God may be supreme is in the cause of God.”
That is why he combined it in His saying - the Most High -: {And the word of your Lord was completed in truth and justice} [Al-An’am: 115].

And in his saying: {Say: If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as an ink} [Al-Kahf: 109]
What is meant by this is that what God said is an established truth that cannot be invalidated.
As God Almighty said: “And the good word of your Lord was completed upon the Children of Israel because they were patient” [Al-A’raf: 137].
By its completion, he means the fulfillment of what he promised them of victory over Pharaoh, his destruction, and their expulsion to the Levant.
And He - the Almighty - said: {And the word of your Lord was completed in truth and justice} [Al-An’am: 115].
And from Him is His saying: “And recite what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord; there is no one to alter His words” [Al-Kahf: 27].

And he said: {Those who were left behind will say: When you go to spoils to take them, leave us, and we will follow you. They want to change the word of God. Say, “No.” Will you follow us? This is what God said before.} [Al-Fath: 15].

From this point of view, Christ said: Heaven and earth will pass away, and my words will not pass away. If he intended the knowledge of God, then the knowledge of God will remain, regardless of what he meant by it. His self-existent knowledge, or His known knowledge that informed of its survival, you have no argument against it. Likewise, if He meant a specific word, then the Messiah You do not have a specific word of His words, but rather with you He is the Word and He is God the Creator, and there is nothing in this word that indicates that He wanted By the word Christ, and Christ with you is eternal and everlasting and cannot be described as remaining without antiquity. Even if it were assumed that he meant by the word Christ, we do not We deny that he is called by the Word, because He said to him:
It was and it was, as will be explained later, and it is intended
Thus, either he will remain until he descends to the earth, or he wills that his remembrance and praise remain, and one tongue of truth to him will continue to the next. The time.
What makes this clear, and that what is meant by it is not what they claim, is that he said: And the word of God endures forever, and He described it as remaining without end. The foot.

According to them, the Word born of the Father is ancient and eternal, and has not ceased and continues to exist. Such things do not need to be described as permanent. Permanence, in contrast to what was promised of bliss, mercy, and reward, is described as permanence and permanence, as in the Qur’an: {its food is everlasting} [Thunder: 35] And his saying: {Indeed, we have been provided with this for what he can use.} [p. 54].
And in the Psalms: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, and His mercy endures forever.

chapters.title: Chapter invalidating their reasoning by baptizing the hypostases
paragraphs: [Chapter: Invalidation of their evidence by baptism on the hypostases]

They said: And the Lord Christ said in the Holy Gospel to his pure disciples: (Go to all nations and baptize them in the name of the Father and the Son. And the Holy Spirit, the one God, and teach them to observe all that I have commanded you.”
Then it is said to them:

This I baptized you into what you call the Three Persons, and there is nothing in it that indicates that, neither textually nor apparently, for the word “Son” does not It is never used in the divine books to mean one of the attributes of God, and none of the prophets named the knowledge of God His Son, nor did they name His words. His son, but with you they called his servant or servants his son or his sons, and if that was so then your claim was that Christ wanted By the knowledge of the Son of God and His words - a claim that is the ultimate lie against Christ, and it is a presumption of the word for something that neither he nor anyone else used in it. Neither in reality nor metaphor, for what lie and distortion of the words of the prophets is greater than this.

If the word “son” were used to describe God, His life would be called a son, and His ability a son, so the specification of knowledge, using the word “son” and not Life is a second mistake. If the word “son” is used to describe God, then what if it is not like that?

Likewise, they did not use the Holy Spirit in the life of God, nor did they mean by this term the life of God, which is His attribute. Rather, they meant by that What He sends down to the righteous and the prophets, and supports them with it, as in the words of David: (Your holy spirit will not be taken from me), and according to them, the spirit of Jerusalem was found in the disciples, and we have presented that what is meant by the Holy Spirit is the angel, and what is meant by it is the guidance and strength that He places in the hearts. Among his sayings in some prophecies:
(And in those days I will pour out of my Spirit on every saint) and in the Psalms of David (your good spirit will guide me in a right land.

This explains that they said in their faithfulness: “Who for us - us men - and for our salvation came down from heaven and was incarnate of the Spirit Jerusalem, and from the Virgin Mary) and they mentioned that that is in the Holy Books, and what is in the Holy Books is only the truth, and there is no doubt that it contains Such as what is in the Qur’an, and in the Qur’an that God sent His Spirit to Mary and breathed into her, and she conceived the Messiah, peace be upon him. The Almighty said: {So We sent Our spirit to her, and he appeared to her as a perfect human being} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious.” [Maryam:

18] (18) {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.} [Maryam: 19] (19) {She said, ‘How can I have a boy when no human being has touched me and I have not [Maryam: 20] (20) {He said, 'Thus said your Lord, 'It is easy for me, and We will certainly make him a sign for the people and a mercy from Us; and it is a matter decreed.'} [Maryam: 21] (21) {So she carried him and retreated with him to a far away place} [Maryam: 22].
Until the end of the story, and God Almighty said: {And she who has guarded her chastity, so We have breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91].

And God Almighty said: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and she was of The obedient ones} [Al-Tahrim: 12]
This spirit is the Messenger, as He said: {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy” [Maryam: 19].
And this spirit was breathed into her, and Christ was created from this spirit, and from his mother Mary, as they said about the trust:

He was incarnated from Mary and from the Holy Spirit, but they believed that the Holy Spirit from which Christ was created and from Mary is the life of God, and this is not There is no evidence in the books for this. In fact, all the books are clear in the opposite of this, and it also contradicts their saying that the one united with Christ is a hypostasis. The Word, which is knowledge. If he was incarnated from Mary, and the hypostasis of the Word, he was not incarnated from the Holy Spirit, even if he was from the Spirit The sanctuary was not of the Word, and if it were of both of them, then Christ would be two hypostases: a hypostasis of the Word and a hypostasis of the Spirit.

And the Christians, with their three sects, all say: Only by Him is the person united, I hypostasize the word, not life, so their contradiction becomes clear in Their honesty, and their error in how they interpreted the words of the prophets became clear.

It has become clear that what has been proven from the prophets is the truth and is consistent with what Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets, told us, and does not contradict any of the words of the prophets.
