It also does not contradict any of their clear and reasonable words, and it became clear that they carried the words of the prophets in the wording of the Son and the Holy Spirit and elsewhere. Unless this word was used in it, and they left it based on the meaning present in their words, and this is the most extreme distortion there is. Their talk about its meanings and changing the meanings of the word of God, so how can it be possible for the word Holy Spirit to be interpreted in a sense in which He did not use it? The Prophets, and they did not mean it by that, and its interpretation is left in the well-known meaning in which they always use it.

Is this anything other than the work of those who distort the words of the prophets and invent lies about them? Rather, the apparent meaning of these words is that they baptize them with the name of the father by which they mean - in their language - the Lord, and the son by which they mean - in their language - The educator, and here he means Christ and the Holy Spirit, and he is the Holy Spirit with which God supported Christ through the kingdom, revelation, and other things, and with this This speech was explained by one of their greatest scholars.

chapters.title: Separating their calling of God’s knowledge and words the Son and their calling his life the Holy Spirit
paragraphs: [Chapter: They are called the Son because of God’s knowledge and words, and they are called the Holy Spirit because of His life.]

This is what they mentioned in their book, using it as evidence against what they believe about the three hypostases, saying: Calling God that He is Father and Son The Holy Spirit is a name by which we Christians did not call Him on our own, but rather God named His divinity by them.

It has become clear that there is nothing in what they mentioned about the prophets that indicates, neither textually nor apparently, that any of the prophets named God, nor any of His attributes are neither a son nor a holy spirit.

It became clear that their calling of God’s knowledge and His word “Son,” and their calling of His life “the Holy Spirit” - are names they invented for what God revealed to them. Of authority, and that there is no proof with them for what they claimed of the hypostases at all, neither auditory nor intellectual, and that it is not due to their saying By the trinity and their confining the attributes of God to three is a legal document.

It also became clear that it has no rational basis, and that the people are among those about whom it was said: “And they said, ‘If only we had heard or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of The Blazing Fire} [Al-Mulk: 10].
And among those about whom it was said: “Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are nothing but like cattle. Rather, they are more astray from the path.” [Al-Furqan: 44].

chapters.title: Chapter on invalidating their invocation of what is mentioned in the Qur’an regarding the hypostases
paragraphs: [Chapter: Invalidating their argument based on what is stated in the Qur’an regarding the hypostases]

Then they began to claim that what was revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was evidence for them against the entities they claimed, and they invented the saying. With the hypostases and the Trinity before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent.

This has been known to them since the time they created the trust that was theirs, which the three hundred and eighteen of them entrusted in the presence of King Constantine, so if they had no rational basis, nor had there been any audio evidence from the prophets before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, then how? Do they have a basis for what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought after they invented trustworthiness?

Especially with the apparent and widely transmitted knowledge that Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, declared them to be unbelievers in the Book that was revealed to him, misled them, and fought against them. Himself and ordered their jihad. As the Almighty says: {Indeed, those who say that God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah: 17].

And the Almighty said: {And the Christians said, “The Messiah is the Son of God.” That is the speech of theirs with their mouths, imitating the speech of those who disbelieved before He killed them. By God, how can they be saved?} [Al-Tawbah: 30]
And he said: {Indeed, those who say that God is the third of three have disbelieved} [Al-Maeda: 73].
And He said: “And do not say to three: ‘Desist, it will be better for you.’” [An-Nisa’: 171].
And similar verses.
And they said: And He also said in this book: Our word to Our righteous servants has preceded.

Then it will be said to them: You have distorted the wording of the verse and its meaning. Its wording is: {And indeed Our word preceded to Our messenged servants} [Al-Saffat: 171] (171) {Indeed, they will be helped.} [Al-Saffat: 172] (172) {And indeed Our soldiers are those who are victorious.} [As-Saffat: 173].
The word that preceded to His messenged servants is: {Indeed, they will be helped} [As-Saffat: 172].

He informed that a word had preceded from Him to His messenged servants to help them, as the Almighty said: {And had it not been for a word which had preceded from your Lord, it would have been Obligatory and for an appointed time} [Taha: 129]

And His saying: {And We gave Moses the Scripture, but they differed therein; and had it not been for a word that had preceded from your Lord, it would have been decided between them, and indeed they are in doubt about it, disconcerting} [Hud: 110].
And His saying: {And thus is the word of your Lord true against those who disbelieve, that they are inmates of the Fire} [Ghafir: 6].

And He said: {And they did not separate except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. And had it not been for a word that had preceded from your Lord, for an appointed time, it would have been decreed. among them} [Al-Shura: 14].
And His saying: {And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me has come true: I will fill Hell with jinn and mankind all together} [Al-Sajdah: 13] .
The word in the Arabic language: it is the useful sentence, whether it is a nominal or actual sentence, and it is the complete statement, as well as the speech For them, it is the complete sentence.

Sibawayh said: And know that they narrate by words what is speech, but they do not narrate by it what is speech, but the grammarians have agreed to call what The Arabs call it a letter, which they call a word, such as Zaid and Amr, and such as: he sat and he went, and each letter comes to mean a meaning that is neither a noun nor a verb, such as: If and then, and perhaps.
God Almighty said: {And He warns those who say, “Allah has taken a son”} [Al-Kahf: 4] (4) {They have no knowledge of it, nor did their fathers. A word that comes out of Their mouths} [Al-Kahf: 5].
So he called this sentence a word.
And God Almighty said: {For example, a good word is like a good tree} [Ibrahim: 24].
It is a saying: There is no god but Allah.
And the Almighty said: {To Him good words ascend, and good deeds He raises them} [Fatir: 10].

And God Almighty said: {Say, O People of the Book, come to a word common between us and you: that we worship none but Allah, and do not associate anything with Him, nor take Some of us are lords other than Allah} [Al Imran: 64]
And God Almighty says: “And he made them adhere to the word of piety, and they were more deserving of it and its people” [Al-Fath: 26].

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Two words that are dear to the Most Gracious are light on the tongue and heavy on the scale: Glory be to God and praise be to Him. Glory be to God the Great,” and he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: “The truest word ever said by a poet is the word of Labid: Everything except God is false.”

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Fear the Fire, even if it is with the half of a date, and whoever does not find it, then with a kind word.” And when it became widespread among those who worked By the way the word is used in a noun or verb, and the letter of the meaning - they began to think that this was the speech of the Arabs, then when they found Some of them heard from the speech of the Arabs that what is meant by the word is a complete sentence, and they began to say: And a word that contains words that may lead, so he makes that From a little.

Some of them make this a metaphor, but that is not the case. Rather, this is the terminology of these grammarians, for the Arabs were not known to They used the word and speech except in the complete sentence, and this is what the imams of grammar such as Sibawayh and others quoted from them.
How can it be said: This is a metaphor, when this is little and much?
Also, the word “old” in the Arabic language is the one that precedes anything else, as God Almighty said: “Until he returned like the old cripple” [Yasin: 39].
And God Almighty says: {And when they are not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient fabrication” [Al-Ahqaf: 11].
And the Almighty says: {Have you seen what you used to worship - you and your ancient fathers} [Al-Shu’ara’: 75-76].

Then, among the theologians are those who single out the expression of the ancient as something that was not preceded by nothingness, or something that was not preceded by anything else, and this has become, according to them, it. The truth of the wording, to the point that many of them began to think that using the old in the old in general over something else - is a metaphor.
So it became clear that what God Almighty meant when He said: “And indeed Our word preceded to Our messenged servants” [Al-Saffat: 171].
Similar to his saying: “And had it not been for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been necessary” [Taha: 129].

Then his word preceded what would come of victory for the messengers, filling Hell with jinn and all people, and the like, so he distorted these Misguidance misguided the wording of the verse, so they said: For our righteous servants, and they made the word the Messiah, and there is nothing in the wording that indicates that in any way. Nor in the fact that Christ preceded our messenged servants - a correct meaning, and the Almighty said: {And indeed Our word preceded our messenged servants} [Al-Saffat: 171] (171) {Indeed, they will be the ones who will be helped} [As-Saffat: 172] (172) {And indeed, We have enlisted against them those who are victorious} [As-Saffat: 173]

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of supporting Christ with the Holy Spirit
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of Christ being supported by the Holy Spirit]
They said: He also said: {O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessings upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Maeda: 110].

It will be said: This is something about which there is no doubt, and you have no proof for it. Rather, it is proof against you, for God supported Christ, peace be upon him, with the Holy Spirit as He mentioned that in this verse, and God Almighty said: In Al-Baqarah: {And We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs, and supported him with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Baqarah: 87].

And God Almighty said: {Those are the messengers. We favored some of them over others of them - whomever spoke to God, and raised some of them in degrees, and We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs. And We supported him with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Baqarah: 253].

This is not specific to Christ. Rather, others supported this, and they mentioned that he said to David: Do not take your holy spirit from me. “Our Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to Hassan bin Thabit: Oh God, support him with the Holy Spirit,” and in other words: “The Holy Spirit is with you as long as you defend His Prophet” and both words are in the Sahih.
According to the Christians, the Holy Spirit descended upon the disciples, and similarly, according to them, the Holy Spirit descended upon all the prophets.

The Almighty said: {Then when you read the Qur’an, seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan} [An-Nahl: 98] (98) {Indeed, he has no authority over those who believe. And they put their trust in their Lord} [An-Nahl: 99] (99) {His authority is only over those who turn to Him and those who associate with Him} [An-Nahl: 100] (100) {And when We have substituted a verse for another verse, and God knows best what He sends down. They said, “You are merely inventors.” Nay, most of them do not know. (An-Nahl: 101) (101) {Say: It was sent down by a spirit. Holy from your Lord with truth, that He may strengthen those who believe, and as guidance and good tidings for the Muslims.} [An-Nahl: 102].
And God Almighty said in another place: {The Faithful Spirit has descended upon your heart} [Al-Shu’ara’: 193-194].
And he said: {Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - he has sent it down to your heart by God’s permission} [Al-Baqarah: 97].

It has become clear that the Holy Spirit here is Gabriel, and God Almighty said: {You will not find a people who believe in God and on the Last Day be friendly with those who rebel against God. And His Messenger, even if they were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred, He wrote faith in their hearts and supported them with a spirit From Him} [Al-Mujadila: 22].

And God Almighty said: {And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Book or faith is, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will. Of Our servants} [Al-Shura: 52].
And God Almighty said: {He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whomsoever He wills of His servants: Warn that there is no god but Me, so fear Me.} [An-Nahl: 2].
And he said: {He casts the Spirit at His command upon whomever He wills of His servants, to warn of the Day of meeting} [Ghafir: 15].

This is the spirit that He inspired and which the angels send down to whomever He wills of His servants - other than the trustworthy spirit that is sent down by the Book. Both of them are called spirit, and they are inseparable. The spirit with which the angel descends, along with the trustworthy spirit with which the Holy Spirit descends, means this and that.

With both sayings, the commentators interpreted his statement about Christ and supported it with the Holy Spirit, and no one said that what was meant by that was the life of God, nor The word indicates that and was not used in it.

They either accept that the Holy Spirit in relation to other than Him does not mean the life of God, if it is proven that it has a meaning other than life. It was used in the life of God as well. It did not necessarily mean that this was meant against Christ, so how could it not be used in the life of God against Christ.

Or they claim that what is meant by it is the life of God in relation to the prophets and disciples. If they say that, it is necessary for the theology to be present in All the prophets and apostles, and then there is no difference between these and Christ.
They also require that there be two theologies in Christ: the theology of the Word and the theology of the Spirit, so that two hypostases are united in Him.

Then in the Almighty’s saying: “And We supported him with the Holy Spirit” [Al-Baqarah: 87], it is impossible to mean the life of God, for the life of God is an existing attribute. By itself, it does not exist by anything other than Him, and is not specific to some existing things other than Him. As for them, Christ is God the Creator, so how can He support With anything else, and also, what is united to Christ is the word without life, so it is not correct to support him with it.
So it became clear that they wanted to distort the Qur’an just as they distorted other ancient books, and that their words in interpreting similar books Divine - of one kind.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of his saying, “And God spoke to Moses in full.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of his saying, “And God spoke to Moses in a strict manner.]
They said: He also said: {And God spoke to Moses in a manner} [An-Nisa: 164].

It will be said to them: What proof do you have in this? Indeed, it is an argument against you, for it has been proven that God spoke to Moses in a speech, and the word of God that Moses, peace be upon him, heard it from him. He is not the Messiah, so he knew that the Messiah is not the word of God. To them, he is the word of God, and it is the knowledge of God. And He is God.

It is known that the words of God are many, such as the Torah, the Gospel, the Qur’an, and other of His words, and the Messiah is not any of that, and the Messiah They have a Creator, and if Christ were the Word of God himself, he would not be a creator nor be worshiped, for the Word of God did not create the heavens and the earth, nor the Word of God. God is the God who is worshiped. Rather, His words are like all of His attributes, like His life and His power. No one says: O knowledge of God, forgive me, nor, O words. God, forgive me. Only the God who is described with knowledge, power, and the words that he spoke to Moses is worshiped and called upon.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of his saying, “So We breathed into him of Our Spirit.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of His saying, so We breathed into it of Our Spirit]

They said: And He also said in Surat Al-Tahrim: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord. And his writings, and she was of the obedient ones} [Al-Tahrim: 12].
It is said: As for His Almighty saying: {Then We breathed into it of Our Spirit} [Al-Tahrim: 12].
And he said: In Surah Al-Anbiya: “And she who has guarded her chastity, so We have breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds” [Al-Anbiya’: 91].

This was explained by the Almighty’s saying: {So We sent to her our spirit, and he appeared to her as a sound human being} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious.” From you, if you are pious.} [Maryam: 18] (18) {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.” [Maryam: 19].
In the other reading: To give you a pure boy.

So he was told that he was his messenger and his spirit, and that he appeared to her as a human being, and he mentioned that he was God’s messenger to her, so he knew that his spirit was a created being. Owned by Him, what is meant is not His life, which is His attribute, Glory be to Him, the Most High: And likewise His saying: {Then We breathed into it of Our Spirit} [Al-Anbiya’: 91].
It is like His saying about Adam, peace be upon him: {So when I formed him and breathed into him of My Spirit} [Al-Hijr: 29].
Jesus was likened to Adam in his saying: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was} [Al Imran: 59].

The suspicion in this arose among some ignorant people that if a person says: My soul, then his soul in this regard is the soul that is in The body, which is a self-sustaining eye, even if there are people who care about life through it. The human being is composed of a body and a soul, and it is a self-sustaining eye. By itself, according to the predecessors of the Muslims, their imams, and the masses of nations.

The Lord Almighty is far above this, and He is not composed of a body and a soul, and it is not permissible to mean by His spirit what a person wants when he says: My soul, but rather Added to it are His angels and the revelation, guidance, support, and the like that He sends down to His prophets.

chapters.title: Chapter to respond to their saying, and all other Muslims say that the Book is the word of God
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to their statement and all other Muslims say that the Book is the word of God]

They said: And all Muslims say: The Book is the word of God, and there is no speech except a living, speaking one. These are essential characteristics that run the course of Names, and each attribute is different from the other, for God is one, one Creator, and one indivisible Lord.
Then it will be said to them: As for the Muslims’ saying that the Book - that is, the Qur’an - is the word of God, this is the truth, and the words are only for the speaker.

Muslims say: God is living and speaking, and that He spoke the Torah, the Gospel, the Qur’an, and other of His words, and the Qur’an has He proclaimed the word of God in many places, and is he called a speaker when his words are utterances?

There is a dispute over it, as some Muslims permit it, and others prohibit it because it is not intended by Sharia, and it is not in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms. Calling God a speaker, in contrast to the word “speech” and “speech,” and the Muslims disputed after the emergence of heresies among them, just as the People of the Book disputed. In the words of God, is He based on Him, or a created being separate from Him?
What the predecessors of the nation, its imams, and its masses are upon is that the word of God is based on it.
The same goes for everything else that is described with it, such as life, power, and so on.

A group of them spoke after the disappearance of the Companions and the major followers, more than a hundred years after the death of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. He is a created being created in something other than himself, and many Jews and Christians participated in this innovation.

This article appeared after the second hundred, and some of the governors and others supported it, then God extinguished it with the one who established it. God is one of the imams of Islam and the Sunnah who explained its corruption and explained what the predecessors agreed upon, that the word of God was sent down from Him, not created. Rather, He began from Him, He did not begin from any of the creatures, and despite this, none of the Muslims said: The word of God is neither a god nor a Lord.
And likewise his life, none of them said: His life is neither a god nor a Lord, nor that he is equal to the Lord Almighty in essence.

chapters.title: Separate their discussion of their claim that the hypostases are essential attributes that run the same course as names
paragraphs: [Chapter: Discussing their claim that the hypostases are essential attributes that take the same form as names]
As for their saying: These are essential qualities that serve as nouns.

If what they mean by saying: essential is that every attribute is an essence, then this is a statement that appears to be corrupt, as an attribute that exists other than it is not an essence. Sustaining by itself, and whoever thinks that the heat of the radiating fire contains a substance that is sustained by itself like fire, then he is either mistaken in his mind or A stubborn sophist.
The first: The insane deserve to be treated.
The second: He deserves the punishment that deters him from stubbornness.
Then, if it is possible for an attribute to be an essence, then power is also an essence.

And if they mean by saying: intrinsic that they are intrinsic attributes, and other than them are actual attributes such as the Creator and the Sustainer, then it is known that His attributes Intrinsic things, including ability and others, are not limited to this.
Also, even if speech exists in itself, it is said: It is related to His will and power, and this is the saying of the predecessors and many, and it was said: It is not Likewise.

The speaker was said to be the one who did the speech, even if he was separate from it, and it was said to be the one to whom the speech was done, even if it was not by his will. And His ability, and it was said: The speaker is the one to whom the speech is spoken by His will and ability, and this is the saying of the predecessors and many, so their statement is invalid in all cases. Appreciation.

And if what they mean by essence is that it is intrinsic and evaluative, and the rest of the attributes are incidental according to the Greek logicians who differentiate regarding the attributes. What is necessary for the description between this and that, this is invalid in many ways, including:

That these are differentiated in terms of the necessary attributes of what is described between one attribute and another, and making some of them intrinsic, constituted within the essence, and some of them incidental. Later, outside of the essence - false speech according to the masses of the nations’ theorists from among the people of religion and others, as was explained in response to These philosophers, and it is clear that what they claim of the synthesis of species, genera and classes is merely a synthesis in the minds and not It has a reality in the objects, and what constitutes the mind differs according to the mind’s perception.

Sometimes he imagines the thing as a whole, and sometimes he imagines it in detail, and what they call the completeness of the essence, and that which is within the essence, and that which is outside of it, and the necessary. It has - when verified, it returns to what the word indicates by conformity, inclusion, and commitment.

The meaning of the word is according to what the speaker means, intends, and imagines, and this varies according to the wills of the people. This is not due to To a rational reality and no intrinsic characteristic of existing things.

For this reason, since their words were false, they could not state a correct difference between the intrinsic and the necessary accidental, if both of them were necessary for what is described. They mentioned three differences, and all three are false, and their clever people recognized their falsehood, as they said: The essence confirms the described, without a mediator, The incidental and intransitive is only established by means of an intermediary.
Then their clever people explain the middle using evidence, as Ibn Sina explained it.

Among them are those who explain the middle as a direct characteristic of what is described, as Al-Razi and others explain it, and these people did not understand what those people meant, so their error increased. And those meant by the middle term the evidence, just as they meant by the middle term what is associated with the blame in your saying: Because, so it became the necessary incidental. They have what is known to be confirmed by evidence for what is being described, and this is not due to an established fact in the matter itself, but rather this is a matter related to Knowing the attributes.
Among them are those who have perfect perception and know that the attribute is necessary for what is described, without any evidence.

And among them are those who do not have a complete conception and do not know that except with evidence. Then, whenever it is necessary for something, it is possible to infer it. Accordingly, if the evidence is what requires its verification to verify the signified, then the middle is everything that is necessary for the presentation, so it is The presentation is necessary for the necessary.

They acknowledge that there are accidents that are necessary, without a middle point, and they represented this with evenness and oddness in number, such as knowledge. That four is an even number, and three is an odd number, even if it is apparent, but the knowledge that five hundred and forty-three is half a thousand and six Eighty, he may lack evidence, or he may lack contemplation and thought.
They say what Ibn Sina, the best of their scholars, and others say, namely that the proposition divided into quality and quantity and other than that is subjective. Because of its descriptions.
The color divided into black and white is intrinsic to the colored person, and blackness and whiteness are two intrinsic characteristics, unlike Marital and individual.

They said: Because the fact that this is black and white and coincidental with other things does not require inference and consideration other than the fact that this is a number. A pair or an individual, as this may lack insight and reasoning, as it may be divided into two equal parts or not divided.

It is known that this is a difference that goes back to the scholar’s knowledge of these characteristics. Is it clear or hidden, and does he lack consideration and reasoning? Or does it not lack, it is not a difference that goes back to the attribute itself nor to its description, so it is known that there is no intrinsic constituent among what they have made Essence, and what they made accidental and necessary outside of essence - a difference that goes back to the same essence, which is the described essence existing in outside, nor to its attributes, but rather to all of its attributes necessary for it - all the same in that, and the essence is not composed of this other than that, nor is it in it. Something takes precedence over essence in external existence, as they say:
The subjective takes precedence over the essence in existence and mind.

Attributes are not substances that exist externally and have parts like the parts of composite bodies. Rather, they are attributes that exist in what is described. It is impossible for any of it to be preceded by what is described.

But if it is said about man: He is a sensitive, perfect body, moved by will and speaking - then the mind may imagine these matters, He expresses them, and each one of them is part of the sentence that is in his mind and on his tongue.

The sentence that is in his mind and tongue is composed of these parts, not that the person outside is composed of these parts. parts, and that they precede it or that they are essences, all of this is what a clear-minded person knows to be false, but these The Greek philosophers and those who followed them were often suspected of what they imagined in their minds by what was found in the real world, as has been proven. Among their ancients, such as Pythagoras and his followers, were proven numbers - abstract numbers existing abroad.
This was rejected by other wise people, as were those who came after him.

They said: The abstract number and the abstract quantity exist only in the mind and not externally, but the counted things exist externally. And the decreed things, such as separate bodies that are counted like the planets, or connected bodies that are estimated like the spheres, and that is what is characterized. With the continuous quantity and the separate quantity located outside.

The followers of Plato affirmed the rational faculties abroad, which they call Platonic ideals, and claimed that they were ancient. eternity, and they affirmed an existing dimension with an abstract essence: it is emptiness, and an essence subsisting in itself, which is eternity, and an abstract, subsisting essence By Himself: He is the eternal matter and substance.

All of these things are only imagined in minds, not in objects. Rather, what they have proven from the ten abstract minds is also upon realization. It goes back to what the mind abstracts and appreciates in it, not to what exists outside.
The origin of their saying:

Abstractions and paradoxes It is taken from the separation of the soul that speaks to the body by death, and this is true, for the one upon whom the prophets And their followers, and the majority of wise people, say that the soul leaves the body, and remains after the separation of the body, and whoever speaks of the people of religion says that it does not What remains after the body is a soul that departs from it, and the soul is a part of the body or a symptom of the body, so his saying - even though it is a mistake in the mind Al-Sarih - It is also contrary to the revealed books of God and His messengers, and to those of all religions who followed them, and these matters are not explained in detail. This place.

What is meant here is to point out that these Greeks differentiate between the necessary qualities of what is described between the intrinsic and necessary accidental qualities. And He made them necessary: some of them are necessary for the essence, and some of them are necessary for their existence - it is based on two corrupt principles for them, The majority of the nations' wise men, from the viewpoints of religious sects and others, disagreed with them.

One of the two origins: it is what was mentioned above, by making them the necessary qualities of what is described, which are externally divided into an essence, a part of the essence. It is included in it, and something incidental outside of it is necessary for it.

The second: Their claim that every existing entity is possible and has an external essence that is itself and its reality - other than the known, specific, and immutable entity within. The outside, and this is also what they suspected of what was in the mind and what was outside.

If what is meant by essence is what is conceived in the mind, which is what is said in response to what it is, and by existence is what is established and established in outside, so it is known that this is different from that, as they say: We visualize the triangle before we know of its existence outside, so it is known that The nature of the triangle other than the triangle located outside.

For it is said to them: If you want, what is imagined in the mind of a triangle that does not exist outside, then this is true, but this is not what It indicates that there are two things outside the mind: one of them: the essence of the triangle, which is its reality and its essence.
The second: The existing triangle, which is the corner of the wall.

And if you want that there are two things on the outside, then this is wrong, and this place is something that was suspected by many of the theorists to the point that some of the most senior of them became Bewildered, he paused.

Some of them have different and contradictory statements, and the reason for that is their lack of distinction between what is imagined in the mind and what exists in the physical being. Then they moved this topic to talk about the attributes of God necessary for him, such as his life, knowledge, and ability. Are they intrinsic or accidental?

If it is said: intrinsic, it must have parts that precede it from which it is composed, and if it is incidental and necessary, it must be capable of And an active one, because His being an active one is different from His being a capable one, so it must have two aspects, and this is from the negative structure that they claimed, and that necessitates Synthesis, which is the combination of essences, and the corruption of this has been demonstrated from multiple aspects, including:

The reasonable combination is the combination of animals, plants, and minerals from their parts and mixtures, and the combination of buildings and clothing. And foods and drinks, including their components and mixtures.

As for the composition of bodies from individual substances or from matter and form, this is what the majority of rational people have disputed over, and likewise Composing a thing from an existing entity, and its essence, whether it is obligatory or possible, is something that the majority of wise people have disputed over, as well as its composition from The common and distinct intrinsic characteristics that they call: gender and season.

As for describing the self with characteristics that it possesses, this is what most rational people know, but they do not call this a combination. Whoever called it Overall, his verbal dispute was not offensive, as far as he knew from the auditory and mental evidence.

Then they say: The compound lacks its parts, and its parts are other than it, and the necessary existence does not lack other than it, and all of these General terms. The word lack here does not mean the object’s lack of its agent, nor the effect’s lack of its efficient cause. For the part of a thing is neither its agent nor its cause that causes it, but rather by it they mean connection and conditionality, for the existence of the total is necessary. Because of the existence of its parts, and it is conditional on that.
Among them: The word “part” does not mean a part that is distinct from the sentence, because the part of the sentence is not distinct from it.

Among them is the word “ghayr”, as what is meant by “ghayr” is that which is permissible for one of them to be separate from its owner, or for it to be separated from him in a time, place, or Existence, and what is meant by them is what is permissible to know about one of them without the other, and some of the totality is the description of what is described and it is not necessary to separate or differ from it, Rather, it may be permissible to contrast it or it may not be contrasted with it.

It is not permissible for the attributes of the Lord Almighty and Majestic to be necessary for Him to separate from Him, and in that case among the people there are those who do not name them other than Him, and those who call them other than Him. His essence is necessary for it. The attributes are not the effect of the essence, nor is it a cause that causes it.

The word “obligatory existence” means that which exists by itself, which has no agent or effective cause, and the essence of the Lord Almighty and His attributes are obligatory. Existence in this sense, and what is meant by it is the one who does not have a place to perform it, and the essence in this sense is obligatory without the attributes. What is meant by it is that which has no relation to anything else, and this has no truth. The Lord Almighty has an attachment to His creatures, especially according to these secular philosophers who say:
It is by itself necessary for the spheres and necessary for them, so they make it binding for its effects, so how can they deny that its essence is necessary? For his qualities?

These Greek philosophers, called the Peripatetics, were followers of Aristotle, the author of the teachings: natural, mathematical, and divine logic. They say: The subject of natural science is related to the matter inside the mind and outside the body and its rulings.

The second is mathematical: it is related to matter outside, not in the mind, for there is no number or quantity outside except in a body inside. The external or countable incident, or a separate estimator, unlike the mind, which abstracts numbers and quantities that are devoid of countables and estimables.

The third: what they call the science of what comes after nature, taking into account scientific behavior, and it is the science of what came before it, taking into account concrete existence. They also call it divine knowledge, and its subject according to them is that which is abstract from matter in the mind and outside, and it is what exists as such. Existent, and its division into essence and accident, and the division of essence into body and non-body, and the division of body into matter and form. And minds and souls.

The first cause is called by Aristotle and his followers as an essence, but they do not call it as a necessity of existence. As for their later scholars, such as Ibn Sina and his followers, They call it the necessity of existence, and they do not call it essence, and talking about these is simple in another place, as what is meant here is that these The matters that they say are the subject of divine knowledge, and which according to them are abstract from matter in the mind and outside, are upon investigation. It exists in minds, not in objects.

For the total general existence does not exist as a total general except in minds and not in objects, just as the general human being and the general animal are The universal does not exist as a universal generality except in minds, not in objects.

The discussion has been extended to these people other than this place, and it has become clear that the Jews and Christians, after abrogation and alteration, are closer to the truth in Divine matters from them.

These matters have been explained in detail elsewhere, but we drew attention to them due to their connection here with the saying of these Christians: The three attributes of the Lord are: Essential to the exclusion of anything else, and if they mean by that what these people mean by essence, then their statement is false and based on a false foundation.

The difference between these Greeks regarding necessary attributes is between the intrinsic and the accidental that is necessary for the existing, the accidental that is necessary for essence, and the accidental that is necessary. For the described - a false difference, and they mentioned three differences, all of which are false, as previously mentioned: The first: the middle.
The second difference: the essence comes first in mind and existence, in contrast to the occasional intransitive.
The third: The truth depends on the self.
The invalidity of this has been shown elsewhere.

And the Christians do not mean, in essence, what these people want in essence, so that is why we did not expand the discussion on it. Rather, they say: The three Essences, and these logicians differentiate between what is necessary for essence and what is necessary for its existence based on the fact that there are two things outside: existence and essence. Other than existence.
The discussion on all of this is explained in another place.

Among them: If it were estimated that the attributes of the attributes necessary for them are divided into intrinsic, constitutive, and accidental, and necessary, and that the attributes of the Lord, Glory be to Him, Likewise, the specification of knowledge as being intrinsic is not more important than power, so mentioning the One who exists by Himself, the living and knowing, is not more important than Remembrance of the Almighty, the Ever-Living, the All-Powerful.
And the Christians, when they had three persons, and they claimed that the revealed law indicated that, and in that they were in violation of the revealed law. To them,

Just as it was spread out in its place - a group of them began to say: There is an Existent, a Living, All-Knowing One, and a group of them said: There is an Existent, All-Knowing, All-Powerful. So they put the Powerful in the place of the Living, and they make the Holy Spirit the power.
Although this saying is better in meaning, the interpretation of the Holy Spirit with power is so far removed that its corruption becomes apparent to everyone.

They must prove the hypostasis of the word, which they say at times: it is knowledge, and at other times: it is wisdom, and at other times they call it: pronunciation as They called it this in their book, because to them who was united with Christ is the hypostasis of the Word, so they sometimes joined life to it. Sometimes they add power to it.

And the Father, sometimes they say: He is the Existent, and sometimes they say: The Self-Subsisting, and sometimes they say: The Self, and it is called the Self-Subsisting. In Syriac: entity, and sometimes they say: generosity.

All of this comes from confusion and misguidance, because they do not find three meanings that deserve to be essential apart from other attributes. Whether essence is interpreted as essences, or as a self-evaluating entity, or otherwise.

Among them is their saying: It takes the course of nouns, so if they mean by that proper or inanimate nouns, the rest of which are adjectives, then the noun of the living and the world. A derived name that indicates the meaning of knowledge and life, just as the Almighty indicates power, and if they want it to be called by it, then God Almighty has names. Many, for glory be to Him, to Him belong the most beautiful names.

Among His names is Al-Qadir, and power entails His power over creatures that science does not indicate, and His creation of creatures indicates His ability is more eloquent than his evidence of his knowledge, and his specificity with ability is clearer than his specificity with knowledge, to the point that a group of theorists Like Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ash'ari and others say: The most specific description of him is the ability to invent, and no one else can be described with that.

And Al-Jahm bin Safwan before him said: There is no one in existence capable of anything other than Him, nor does anyone else have power. And Al-Ash’ari, even if he affirmed that the created being has power, but it confirms power that does not affect what is possible, and none of the wise people said: His most specific description is life and knowledge, nor that anything else is Living and not knowing, so making the Almighty a noun and something else an adjective - if the difference is real - is preferable to the opposite. So how about if the difference is false? The names of God Almighty that people know are names, and they are attributes in the Arabic terminology that indicate meanings, which are His attributes that exist in Him.

The living denotes life, the knowledgeable denotes knowledge, and the All-Powerful denotes power. This is the doctrine of the nation’s predecessors and the masses of nations, and those who Al-Nas is an anomalous group that claims that these names do not indicate meanings like proper names. The people have disputed over what He is called, Glory be to Him, and He is called Other than Him, such as the Living, the All-Knowing, and the All-Powerful.
The public is of the opinion that it is a truth in both of them, and a group such as Abu Abbas al-Nashi said: It is a truth in the Lord Almighty and a metaphor in the creation.

A group of the Jahmites, atheists, and philosophers, unlike these, said: It is a metaphor in the Lord Almighty, a reality in the creation. According to the first ones, it is a partner, and they may call it suspicious because of the difference in it, and some of them say: it is a partner in common. Verbally.

chapters.title: Chapter on invalidating their representation of attributes with a ray of sunshine
paragraphs: [Chapter: Invalidating their representation of attributes by the rays of the sun]

As for their saying: Each attribute is different from the other: this is if what they mean by it is that the attributes of the Lord, Glory be to Him, the Most High, may differ from Him and be separated from Him. This is the truth of what they say. They say, however: It is connected to it, so it is a combination of the two opposites, and representing them with the rays of the sun is false, and it is an argument against them. No to them.
The ray that exists in the air, the earth, the mountains, the trees, and the walls is not the same as the sun.
And the one who exists in the essence of the sun is not the one who exists in the air and the earth.
If they say: Rather, from the knowledge that he carries out, knowledge flows from it to the hearts of the prophets, just as a ray of light flows from the sun.

They were told: This is not specific to Christ, but rather this is a common destiny between him and other prophets, and the Lord’s essence does not dwell in this. Nor does His attribute exist in any of His creatures, nor does the servant, by virtue of the knowledge and faith that have descended upon him, become a worshiped god.
And if they want it to be based on it, and each one is called something different from the other, then there is a verbal dispute. Should it be called something else or not called something else?

For there are those who say: Every attribute of the Lord Almighty is different from the other, and he says: The two are different if it is permissible for the existence of one of them in the absence of the other, or It is not permissible to have knowledge of one of them and ignorance of the other.

And among them are those who say it is not the other, nor is it the same; Because the two are other than it is permissible for one to exist in the absence of the other, or it is not permissible for one of them to separate from the other in time, place, or existence.

And what the nation’s predecessors and imams are upon, when it is said to them: The knowledge of God and the word of God, is it other than God or not? They did not say negation or affirmation, for if he said: something else; He thought that he was different from him.

And if he says: There is no other than Him; He imagined that it was him. Rather, the questioner elaborates. If he meant by saying: someone else; That it is distinct from Him and separate from Him - so the attributes of what is described are not distinct from Him and separate from Him, and if He is a created being, then how about His attributes? The Creator?

And if he meant by something other than it, then it is not the attribute described, for it is other than Him in this regard, and the name of the Lord Almighty then He was released to take up the Holy Self with the perfect attributes that he deserves, and thus the existence of the Self being stripped of the attributes of perfection is impossible.

The name of God refers to the entity described with perfect attributes, and these attributes are not additional to this name, but are included in the name. But it is additional to the abstract essence, which is confirmed by the negation of the attributes. When they claimed that it is an abstract entity, they said: Rather, the attributes. In addition to what you have proven of yourself.

As for the same matter, there is no abstract entity to which there are additional attributes. Rather, the Almighty Lord is the holy entity described by attributes. Perfection, His attributes are included in the name of His names, Glory be to Him.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the contradiction of what Christians say about the doctrine of their faith
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the contradiction of what the Christians say about the doctrine of their faith]
And their saying: There is one God, one Creator, one Lord.

It is true in itself, but they have contradicted it by saying in the doctrine of their faith: (We believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only Son of God, A true God from a true God, of the essence of his Father, equal in essence with the Father.) So here they established two gods, then they established the Holy Spirit as a God Thirdly, and they said that He is prostrated to, so they began to affirm three gods, and they say: We only affirm one god, which is an apparent contradiction. It combines the two opposites, between confirmation and denial.

For this reason, a group of wise people said: Most people’s opinions can be imagined, except for the words of Christians, and that is because those who created them did not They imagined what they said, but rather they spoke ignorantly, and in their speech they combined the two opposites, and for this reason some of them said: If ten Christians had gathered, they would have dispersed. On the authority of eleven sayings, and another said: If you asked some Christians and his wife and son about their monotheism, the man would say one thing, and his wife would say one thing. Another, and his son said a third.

chapters.title: Separating the contradiction of their statement cannot be separated or separated
paragraphs: [Chapter: The contradiction of their statement is neither separate nor divisible]
And their saying: (It is neither separated nor divided) contradicts what they mentioned about their trustworthiness, and what they represent it with.

They represent it with a ray of the sun, and the rays are dispersed and divided, so what of it remains in this place is part of it and a part of it. It is possible for some of it to disappear while some of it remains, for if something is placed on the source of the ray, its two sides are separated, and the ray that was between them becomes On that upper ray separating the two lower rays.

This shows that the ray extends to the earth and the air, and each of them is divided and dispersed, and whatever is dispersed is dispersed, for The situation follows the subject, and this requires division and division in what he did.

They also say that he was united with Christ and that he ascended to heaven and sits at the right hand of the Father. They hold that theology has been united since He did not depart from his humanity, but when he ascended to heaven and sat at the right hand of the Father, the one who ascended to them was Christ, who is humanity and divinity. A perfect God and a perfect man. They do not say that He who sits at the right hand of the Father is humanity only. Rather, the Divinity united with humanity sat at Oath of divinity, what division and division is more eloquent than this?
This is not the word of the prophets, such that it is said:

It has a meaning that we do not understand, but rather it is from the words of their elders who fabricated it and made it the doctrine of their faith. If they spoke something that did not They understand it, then they are ignorant and it is not permissible for them to be followed, and if they understand what they said, then no one understands the fact that divinity is united with humanity. He sat at the right hand of the divinity devoid of unity. However, this abstract divinity is separate and distinct from the united divinity, and is not connected to it. Its goal is to be in contact with Him. Rather, what touches abstract theology must be humanity with the divinity united with it, for this is the reality of separation. And fragmentation with the separation of one part from the other.

Also, it is said to them: Is he who is united with Christ the Lord of the worlds, or is he one of His attributes? If He is the Self, then He is the Father Himself, and Christ is the Father Himself, and this is what the Christians agreed is false. For they say: He is God, and He is the Son of God, as God said about them, but they do not say: He is the Father and the Son, and to them the Father is God, and this is one of their contradictions.

And if they say: What is united to Christ is the attribute of the Lord, then the attribute of the Lord does not depart from Him, and it is not possible for them to be united or resolved into anything other than the Self.

Also, the attribute itself is not the Creator God, Lord of the worlds, but rather it is His attribute, and no rational person would say: The word of God, or the knowledge of God, or The life of God is the Lord of the worlds who created the heavens and the earth. If it were assumed that Christ was the same attribute of God, he would not be God, nor would He May He not be the Lord of the worlds, nor the Creator of the heavens and the earth.

And the Christians say: Christ is the Lord of the worlds, the creator of everything, and he is the creator of Adam and Mary, and if he is the son of Adam and Mary, then he is the creator of that By his divinity, he is the son of Adam and Mary by his humanity.

If it were assumed that Christ is an attribute of the Lord, then the attribute was not the Creator, then how come it is when Christ is not the attribute of God itself, but rather a created being? By the word of God, and it was called the word of God, because God created it (Bkun)?

And the Almighty said: {That is Jesus, son of Mary, the Word of Truth about which they dispute} [Maryam: 34] (34) {It is not for God to take from a son. Glory be to Him when He decrees a matter. He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Maryam: 35].
He called it His Spirit, because He created it by breathing the Holy Spirit into its mother. He did not create it as He created others from a human father.

God Almighty said: {Indeed, God gives you good news of a word from Him. His name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, distinguished in this world and in the hereafter, and of those brought near.} [Al Imran: 45] (45) {And He speaks to people in the cradle, and as an old man, and of the righteous.} [Al Imran: 46] (46) {She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child when no human being has touched me? God has said so.” He creates whatever He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Al Imran: 47]

And if they say: What is united to Him is some of that and not the other, then they say by dividing and dividing, then they are between two things: either the invalidity of their doctrine, Or their acknowledgment of division and division while invalidating it.
And also their saying: (True God from true God, of the essence of His Father, begotten, not created, consubstantial with the Father, the Son of God The only one, born before all ages.)

It will be said to them: This is the Son who is begotten, equal in essence to the Father, who is true God from true God. Is this an existing characteristic? Other than that? Or an eye that exists by itself?

If it is the first, then the attribute is not a god, nor is it a creator, and it cannot be said that it is born of God, nor is it equal to God in essence. He never named any of the prophets, nor did any of the prophets follow the attributes of God, nor did he have a son or a son, nor did he say: The attribute of God was born from him, nor A wise man said: The old characteristic emerged from the old self.
They say: Christ is God who created the heavens and the earth to unite his humanity to this Son, born before all ages, equal to the Father in The essence.

And all of this is an attribute of an entity that exists by itself, like jewels that exist by themselves, not an attribute of attributes that exist by another, and if that is the case The division and division were necessary for their statement, as the statement of natural birth is necessary for a part of it to come out. God Almighty said: {And they have appointed for Him from among His servants a part. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.} [Al-Zukhruf: 15] (15) {Or has He taken daughters from among what He creates and has chosen you with sons?} [Al-Zukhruf: 15] 16] (16) {And when one of them is given good tidings of what has been given as an example of the Most Merciful, his face remains dark and he is gloomy} [Al-Zukhruf:

17] (17) {Is he who is created in disgrace while he is in dispute not clear?} [Al-Zukhruf: 18] (18) {And they made the angels who are servants of the Most Gracious into females. Let their creation bear witness; their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned} [Al-Zukhruf: 19].

As for this meaning, which is confirmed by some of the Christian scholars who confirm it and call it birth and sonship, they call it the ancient and eternal attribute. The one who is described as a son, and they sometimes call it speech, sometimes the word, sometimes knowledge, and sometimes wisdom, and they say: This is born of God, and the Son of God.

This was not said by any of the prophets and their followers, nor by any of the wise people other than these innovated Christians, and no one understands. Among the wise people are the names of birth and sonship that have this meaning.

The prophets did not apply the word “son” except to a created being, and they said: He is the father of Christ by nature, and of others by birth, so there is no The majority of rational people and others believe in this sense that only reasonable filiation occurs through the separation of part of the father, and this is denied by those who Some of their scholars deny it.

But they did not follow the prophets, and they did not say what wise people think, so they went astray in what they transmitted from the prophets, and they misled their followers in what They said it, and the common people among them, and if they do not say: The birth of God is like the birth of an animal by the separation of something that exists, then they say: The birth Divinity by separating a part of the divinity into humanity, nothing other than this is intelligible from birth.

And also their saying: (And we believe in the Holy Spirit of the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceeds from the Father, who is with the Father, worshiped, and glorified, who speaks in The prophets, and they said:

Who proceeds from the Father, who is with the Father worshiped and glorified. This cannot be said about the life of the Lord that exists in him, for it is not emanating from Him like all other attributes, for if the One Who created Himself were emanating, then His knowledge, His ability, and all of His attributes would emanate from Him. Emergence in speech is more apparent than in life, for speech emerges from the speaker, but life does not emerge from the living, so if it is in

The attributes that are not emanating would be the attribute that they call the Son, and they say: it is knowledge and speech or speech and wisdom - is it better that It emanates from life, which is further from that than words.

They also said: He is prostrated and glorified with the Father, and the attribute associated with the Lord is not prostrated with Him, and they said: He speaks in The prophets. The description of the Lord that exists in him is not expressed in the prophets. Rather, this is all an attribute of the Holy Spirit that God places in the hearts of Prophets, or a description of one of the angels like Gabriel. If this is emanating from the Father, and the emanation is coming out, then what is Disaggregation and fragmentation are more eloquent than this.

If they liken it to the emanation of a ray from the sun, then this is false in many ways: among them: that the ray is a projection that extends through the air and the earth, and is not A substance existing by itself, and according to them this is a living thing that is prostrated to, and it is a substance.
Among them: That ray that exists in the air and the earth is not an attribute of the sun, nor does it exist with it, and the life of the Lord is an attribute that exists with it.
Among them: They specifically attributed emanation to the Holy Spirit, and they did not say in the word: it emanates.

And the emergence, if it were true, would be more like the word than life, and whenever the wise person reflects on their words regarding honesty and other things, he will find It contains contradictions and corruption that are not hidden except to the most ignorant of people, and it is found in it to contradict the Torah and the Gospel, and the rest of the books of God - What is not hidden from contemplating this and that.

And he found in it something that contradicts what is clear and reasonable, which is not hidden except from stubborn or ignorant people, so their statement is contradictory in itself, contrary to what is clear. Reasonable, and authentic, what is transmitted from all the prophets and messengers, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them all.

chapters.title: A chapter that contradicts their saying that gentleness only appears in dense things, and that is why the creative word of God was embodied in Jesus
paragraphs: [Chapter: Disproving their saying that subtle things only appear in dense things, and for this reason the creative word of God was embodied in Jesus]

They said: As for the incarnation of the creative Word of God into a created human being and their birth together, that is, the Word with humanity, then He did not address the Creator. None of the prophets except by revelation or from behind a veil, according to what was stated in this book, saying: {And it is not for a human being that God should speak to him. Except by revelation, or from behind a veil, or He sends a messenger and reveals by His permission whatever He wills.” [Al-Shura: 51].

If the subtleties do not appear except in the subtleties - the Holy Spirit - and other things, then the word of God by which the subtleties and the subtleties were created, It appears in a completely incomplete manner.
That is why he appeared in Jesus, son of Mary, because man is the most revered of what God created, and for this reason he addressed the creation, and they witnessed from him what they witnessed.

The answer is in several ways: One of them is: It is said: This is what they mentioned, and they claimed that it was the incarnation of the creative word of God in a created human being. Their birth together, that is, the Word and humanity, which is expressed by the union of divinity and humanity - is something impossible in a clear mind. And what is known to be impossible according to the clear mind, it is not permissible for a messenger to be informed of it, for messengers only inform about what is not known to the mind. Abstained. As for what is known to a clear mind to be abstained, the messengers are abstained from informing about it.
The second way: The divine news is clear that Christ, the servant of God, is not the creator of the world, and the Christians say: He is a perfect God. And a complete human being.
The third way: talking about what they mentioned.

As for the first way, it has several aspects: One of them is that it is said: The one who is united with Christ must either be the self characterized by speech or speech only. If you wish, you can say: the one united with Him, either speaking with the self, or speaking without the self. If what is united with Him is the speaking with the self, then Christ is The Father, He is the Son, He is the Holy Spirit, and Christ is the three Persons.

This is false according to the agreement of the Christians and all people of that religion, and according to the agreement of the divine books, and it is false according to clear reason, as we will mention it, if we wish. God.

And if what is united with Him is the Word only, then the Word is an attribute, and the attribute does not exist without what is described, and the attribute is not a Creator God. To them, Christ is a Creator God, so their statement is invalid according to both estimates, and if they say: The one who is united with Him is the one described by the attribute, then the one described is The Father, and for them Christ is not the Father, and if they say: the attribute only, then the attribute does not separate from what is described and does not stand in anything other than the described, and the attribute It does not create or provide, and it is not God, and the attribute does not sit on the right of the one being described, and Christ according to them ascended to heaven and sat on the right His father.
As for the fact that He is the Father only, and He is the entity devoid of attributes, this is even more impossible, and there is no one among them who would say this.

The second aspect: The self united with the humanity of Christ is with the humanity of Christ, if after the union they were two entities, and they are two essences as they were. Before the union, it is not a union.

And if it is said: They became one substance, as those of them say: They became like fire with iron, or milk with water, then this is This entails the transformation of each of them, and the inversion of the character of each of them, rather its reality, just as water and milk become transformed when they are mixed, and fire with Al-Hudaydah, and in that case it is necessary that theology be transformed and its character and reality changed, and the impossibility can only be through the absence of something and the existence of Another, it is necessary that there is nothing of the eternal and necessary existence by itself.

What is necessary for its existence is impossible for its non-existence, and what is necessary for its existence is impossible for its non-existence, for what is ancient is not ancient except because of its necessity by itself, or Because it is necessary for the obligatory thing itself, since if it were not necessary for it, but rather it was not necessary for it, it would not be as old as it is, and the necessary thing By itself, its non-existence is precluded, and its incumbent does not cease except by its non-existence, for the absence of what is necessary entails the absence of the obligated.

The third aspect: That it may be said: People have several sayings about the word of God Almighty, and the saying of the Christians is false despite all the sayings that He said. people regarding the word of God, so its falsehood has been proven beyond all measure. This is because the word of God, Glory be to Him, is either an attribute of Him existing in it, or it is Either it is a creation that is separate from Him, or it is neither this nor that, but rather what is found in souls, and this third is the furthest away. Sayings based on the sayings of the prophets, which is the saying of the philosophers and Sabians who say: The Lord’s attributes are not created by Him, and He is not a Creator. By his choice.

They say, however: He does not know the specifics, nor is he able to change the heavens. Rather, according to them, his words are what resonate with souls. Perhaps they called it speech, in the adverbial language.

These people deny speaking about God, and they say: He is not a speaker, and they may say: He is a metaphorical speaker, but when the prophets spoke to them Prayer and peace was used by those among them who fell into the sect, then they interpreted it like this, and this is one of the two sayings of the Jahmiya.

The second saying: He is a true speaker, but his speech is created. He created it in something other than Himself. This is the saying of the Mu’tazilites and others, and the other opinion. For the Jahmiya.

According to these two sayings, God has no words to support him in order for him to be united with Christ, or to reside in him, and the created being is one of the symptoms and is not a god. Creator, and many of the People of the Book: Jews and Christians, who say this and that.

As for the first saying, which is the saying of the nation’s predecessors, its imams, and its majority, and the saying of many of the predecessors of the People of the Book, and their majority - Either it can be said: The speech is old in type, meaning that He was still speaking according to His will, or old in essence, or it can be said: It is not old, but rather It is a hadith, and the first is the well-known saying from the imams of the Sunnah and the hadith.

As for those who say that the eye is eternal, they say: Speech is not related to His will and ability, because they believe that it is not solved by accidents. Whatever happened by His will and power could only be an accident.

They have two opinions: Some of them say: The ancient has one meaning, or five meanings, and that meaning is a command, a prohibition, and news, and these are attributes. It has no divisions, and if it is expressed in Arabic, it is the Qur’an, and if it is expressed in Hebrew, it is the Torah.
Among them are those who say: It is letters, or letters and sounds of ancient origin.
And the third saying: He speaks according to His will and ability, words that stand on their own. They said:

It is a recent event, and it is impossible for it to be ancient, due to the absence of the intended meaning being ancient, and these groups based their statements on the fact that what It is not devoid of accidents, for it is an accident due to the abstention of the existence of something that has no end to them, and if this is abstained it must be of a kind Accidents are a beginning, just as the meaning of an event is a beginning, and unless it preceded an incident, whether it was with it or after it, then it is an accident, and for this reason it is prohibited. These are the words of God that have no end in eternity, although there are those who say that they will continue to exist in eternity.

As for the saying that the words of God have no end even though they subsist in themselves, this is the saying reported by the imams of the Salaf, and it is This is the opinion of most of the scholars of hadith, many of the scholars of theology, and of the philosophers, and these opinions have been discussed extensively in other than position.

What is meant here is that the Christians’ statement is invalid according to each of these four opinions, as previously stated. The two opinions, for - according to the opinion of the majority of those who attribute many words to God - either words that have no end and have not ceased, or words that have no end and have not ceased, or words It has a beginning, and if He has many words, then Christ is not the words that have no end, nor is He many words, but rather He was created with one of the words of God, as in the divine books: the Qur’an and the Torah. He creates things with His words.

God Almighty said in the story of Mary’s good news of the Messiah: “She said, ‘My Lord, how can I have a child when no human being has touched me?’ He said, ‘Thus, God creates what He wills.’” When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Al Imran: 47].
He also said: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was} [Al Imran: 59].

And he said: {That is Jesus, son of Mary. The word of truth about which they dispute. It is not for God to take from a son. Glory be to Him. When He has decreed a matter, it is only He says to him, “Be,” and he is.} [Maryam: 34-35].
God has told in the Qur’an of His creation of things with His words in more than one place, saying: {His command, when He intends something, is only to say Be for Him, and it is” [Yasin: 82].
And in the Torah: Let it be Sunday, let it be thus, let it be that.

And also according to the words of these people and according to the words of those who make their words either one meaning, or five meanings, or letters and sounds that are one thing. one; They all say: Speech is an attribute existing in what is described. It is not conceivable that it is an essence existing in itself, nor is it conceivable that it is a Creator. Speech has no will, nor does it have any essence other than that of the speaker, and it is not united with anything other than the speaker. Rather, their audiences say: It is not permissible Also without the speaker.

And whoever among them says of the permissible, does not say: The condition is an essence, and there is no Creator God, so it becomes clear that what the Christians said is false according to all opinions. What people said about the word of God, although most of these statements are wrong, and since the Christians’ statement was corrupt, it became clear to the wise that it was a mistake. What is in most of these sayings was hidden from the wise people who said them, and the corruption of the Christian saying was not hidden from them.

Also, those who say that it is permissible are among the extremists whom the Muslims declare to be unbelievers, like those who say that it is permissible regarding some of the Ahl al-Bayt or some of them. The sheikhs, even if they were infidels, participated with the Christians in the permissibility, but they did not say: The word that was permissible is the Creator God. So they contradict each other in an apparent contradiction, such as what the Christians say of a clear contradiction that is not in what these people say, even if they are in some aspects. Their words are worse than the words of the Christians.

The fourth aspect: to say: If Christ was the Word of God himself, then the Word of God is not the Creator God of the heavens and the earth, nor is it Sins are forgiven, and people are rewarded for their deeds, whether His word is an attribute of Him or created for Him like all of His attributes and creatures. God and His power and His life did not create the world, and no one should say: O knowledge of God, forgive me, O ability of God, repent for me, and O word of God Have mercy on me, and he does not say:

O God’s Torah, or His Gospel, or O His Qur’an, forgive me and have mercy on me. He only calls upon God, Glory be to Him, and He, Glory be to Him, is characterized by attributes Perfection, so how come when Christ is not the same word?

For Christ is an essence existing in Himself, and speech is an attribute existing in the speaker, and He is not the same as the Lord who speaks, for the Lord who speaks is the one who They call him the Father, and Christ is not the Father to them, but rather the Son. They went astray in what they said in some ways: including: making three hypostases, and attributes God is not limited to three.
Among them: making the attribute a creator, while the attribute does not create.

Among them: Christ made them the same word, and Christ was created by the word, so it was said to him, “Be,” and it was as it will come, God Almighty willing. Interpretation That is, Christ was singled out for being called the Word of God, not the rest of humanity, because all other humans were created in the usual manner in Creatures, one of Adam’s descendants is created from a sperm, then a clot, then an embryo, then the spirit is breathed into him, and they were created from the water of the parents: Father and mother.

Christ, peace be upon him, was not created from the water of a man, but rather when he breathed the Holy Spirit into his mother, she conceived him, and God said: Be, and it was, and for this reason God likened him to Adam in His saying: {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus in the sight of God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was} [Al Imran: 59].
Adam, peace be upon him, was created from dust and water, and it became clay, then the clay dried up, then He said to him:

He was and was, and when He breathed the Spirit into him he became a complete human being. He did not need after that what his children needed after the Spirit was breathed. After the soul is breathed, the fetus completes the creation of its body in its mother’s womb. It remains in her womb for about five months, then emerges as a breastfed baby. Then he grows little by little, and when Adam, peace be upon him, was created his body was told, “Be,” and he was a complete human being when the spirit was breathed into him, but he was not named by a single word. God because his body was created from dust and water and remained for a long time. It is said:
Forty years, and the creation of his body was not creative at one time, but rather he was created little by little, and the creation of the animal from clay is usual in the sentence.
As for Christ, peace be upon him, his body was creatively created by the same breath of the Holy Spirit in his mother. It was said to him:

It was and it was, so it had the specificity that it was created by the word of God, as no other human beings had it, and it is the usual matter in the language of The Arabs and others say that if a general noun has two types, they designate one of the types as a name, and leave the general noun specific to the type, such as the word The animal and the animal, for it is general in everything that moves and every animal. Then, since the human being had a name specific to him, the word “animal” remained specific. It refers to the animal, and the word “animal” refers specifically to horses, mules, donkeys, and the like, and likewise the word “permissible” and “possible.” And relatives, and the like. Since there was nothing specific to anyone other than Christ, the general word name was kept as specific to Christ.

The second way: That what they mentioned is a proof against them, for if God did not speak to any of the prophets except by revelation or from behind a veil, then the Messiah, Jesus The son of Mary should not speak to him except through revelation, or from behind a veil, or a messenger should be sent to him.
