And the Almighty says: {And it is not for a human being that God should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a veil} [Al-Shura: 51].
It applies to all human beings: Christ and others.
If he refrains from God speaking to him except by revelation or from behind a veil, then it is better and more likely that he refrains from uniting with Him or dwelling in Him.
For that is what was united with him and the word of God dwelt within him without a veil between divinity and humanity, and they accepted that God does not speak to humans except from behind A veil.
The third aspect: that his saying.
{And it is not for a human being that God should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a veil} [Al-Shura: 51].

This requires that the veil be a veil that blocks people as it blocked Moses. This implies that they do not see him in this world, even if he speaks to them. Just as he spoke to Moses, but Moses did not see him, but rather asked about the vision and said: {He said, “My Lord, show me that I may look at You.” He said, “You will not see Me, but look at the mountain, and He settled in his place, and you will see Me. When his Lord appeared to the mountain, He caused it to collapse, and Moses fell down dumbfounded. When he woke up, he said, Glory be to You, I repent to You, and I am the first. The believers} [Al-A’raf: 143].
It was said: I am the first to believe that no one will see you in this world, and they have in the Torah: Man cannot see God in this world. And he lives,

And so Jesus said when they asked him about seeing God, and he said: No one has ever seen God. This is known to them, and if it is so, then the veil that conceals humans must not be from humans, and this invalidates the statement. Christians, they say: The Lord was hidden with a human veil, and it is the body that Mary gave birth to, so He took it as a veil and spoke to the people from Behind it, and the Qur’an indicates that the veil is not from human beings.

This clarifies the fourth aspect: that that body that Mary gave birth to is of the same type as the bodies of the sons of Adam, so if it is permissible for them to be united With it, and it is permissible in it, and the human body can bear it in this world due to the strength that God places in it, it is permissible for it to unite with other Bodies because of the strength he puts in them, and if it is permissible for him to be united with them, then it is permissible for him to speak to them without a veil between him and them by means of The first and most likely, and this is contrary to what they mentioned and contrary to the Qur’an.

So it became clear that the denial of the prophets for a person to see him in this world is a denial of his contact with human beings in a better and better way. The Christian humanity is a human being, so if he cannot see God, how can he unite with Him, touch Him, and become Him and Him? Like milk and water, fire and iron, or like the soul and the body?

The fifth aspect: It is known that a human being’s vision of Him is easier than being united with Him, and His abode in Him, and more likely. If the vision in this world was denied by God, and He forbade it on the tongues of His Messengers: Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, then how? Is it permissible for him to contact humans and unite with them?
The sixth aspect:

If its solution were in human beings, which is possible and real, then no one human being would have the authority to do that without the one before him. And after it there is a meaning, for power is comprehensive, and the requirement - which is the existence of God and the need of creation - exists, and for this reason the message was It is possible that He sent from mankind more than one, and since it was possible for mankind to hear His words, more than one man could hear His words, and see Him in this world with eyes. It did not occur to anyone according to the agreement of the Muslim scholars, but they had two opinions regarding the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace, and the greatest scholars agreed upon it. The majority of them are that they did not see it with their own eyes, as is indicated by the Qur’an and Sunnah.

And when the confidant was possible, Abraham took a friend, and he also took Muhammad as a friend, as in the Sahih, without a chain of transmission, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. And he said: “Indeed, God has taken me as a friend just as He took Abraham as a friend.” And he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: “If I had been taken from among the people of I would have taken Abu Bakr as a friend on earth, but your companion is the friend of God, meaning himself.”

The seventh aspect: Their saying: And if subtle things do not appear except in dense things, such as the soul and other things - then the word of God by which you were created. Densities appear in things that are not dense at all.

Then it will be said to them: The appearance of subtle things in the thick is a general statement. If you want the soul of a person to appear in his body, or the jinn to speak about... A severed tongue and the like - this is not what we are in. And if you want that God Almighty Himself resides in humans, then this is the place The conflict, so where is the evidence for it when you have only mentioned what indicates the opposite of that?

The eighth aspect: This is a matter that has not been proven by reason or transmission, and no prophet among the prophets has ever said that God dwells in human beings, nor has he claimed. The Lord’s coming upon him is absolutely true, but only liars claim that, like the Antichrist who will appear at the end of time and claim divinity, and God will come down. Blessed and Most High is Jesus, the son of Mary, the Messiah of guidance. The Messiah of guidance, in whom divinity was falsely claimed, will kill the Antichrist, who claimed God is false, and it shows that the Lord of the worlds does not reside in man.

For this reason, when the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, warned of the Antichrist, he said: “There is no prophet who does not warn his nation of the Antichrist, even Noah. Warn his people about it.” The Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, mentioned three obvious signs that appear to every Muslim, showing his lie: one of them: His saying: Written before his eyes is an infidel, “KF R” is read by every believer: reader and non-reader. The second: His saying:

“And know that none of you will see his Lord until he dies.” It is clear that no one in this world sees God with his own eyes, and every human being sees Him in The world is for the eye, so it is known that God is not united with a human being.
Third: His saying: He is one-eyed, and your Lord is not one-eyed, and the evidence to deny divinity from Him is many.

But since the infliction of divinity in human beings and people adopting it as a doctrine led astray many groups of the Christian sons of Adam and others, and the Messiah was The Antichrist will bring great miracles, and the Christians protested against the divinity of Christ using this - the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned some of the signs His lying about obvious matters does not require an explanation of the sources of the conflict in which many human beings have gone astray. Indeed, many people, Most of them are astonished by the supernatural until they believe its owner before considering the possibility of his claim. And if they believe him, they believe the Christians in a divine claim. Christ, and they also believed those who claimed solutions
And uniting in some sheikhs, or some of the Ahl al-Bayt, or others who are people of immorality and immorality.

Thus, the answer to what some theologians, such as Al-Razi, mentions regarding this hadith, appears, where they said: Evidence that the Antichrist is not God - It is apparent, so how can the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, provide evidence for that by saying: “He is one-eyed, and your Lord is not one-eyed”? This question indicates the ignorance of its speaker of the misguidance into which the sons of Adam fall, and of the clear evidence that shows the falsity of the statements. falsehood, otherwise the children of Israel during the time of Moses thought that the calf was the god of Moses, and they said: This is your god and the god of Moses, and they thought that Moses had forgotten him.

And the Christians, despite their large number, say: Christ is God. And among those who are affiliated with facing the Qiblah, there are many people who say that about many of the sheikhs and Ahl al-Bayt, even many of the most senior sheikhs Knowledge and Sufism make this the end of achieving monotheism, which is for the monotheist to be the monotheist, and they seek: What He has united. One from One... since everyone who is alone denies the monotheism of the one who tells about his description... a shameful thing that the one has nullified by his monotheism...

We have described someone who calls him “Lahid,” so how can it be ruled out that, with the Dajjal displaying these great miracles, it is unlikely that he will be believed to be God, when he says: I am God. This was believed among those in whom no miracles of liars appeared, and among those who did not say: I am God, like Christ, and all others. The prophets and the righteous.

The ninth aspect: Their saying: The Word of God, by which the subtle things were created, appears in an incomplete form, so it is said to them: The Word of God which they call upon. Its appearance in Christ. Is it the word of God, which is His attribute, or the speaking essence of God, or the sum of it? If you say: What appears to be the same words, then this means two things: If what is meant by it is that God sent down His words to the Messiah, just as He sent them down to Other messengers, this is a truth agreed upon by the people of faith, and the Qur’an has spoken of it.

And if what is meant by it is that the word of God separated from itself and took up residence in Christ or someone else, then it is false, even though this does not benefit the Christians, for Christ They have a God who created the heavens and the earth, and to them he is the son of Adam and the creator of Adam, the son of Mary and the creator of Mary, her son through his humanity. And its Creator with His divinity.

And if by the appearance of the Word they meant the appearance of God’s essence, or the appearance of Himself and His words in the dense entity that is man, then this also is meant by it. The appearance of His light in the hearts of believers, as God Almighty said: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth} [An-Nour: 35] to His saying: {A shining star} [An-Nour: 35] The verse.

And as God appeared from Mount Sinai, and shone from Seir, and was revealed from the mountains of Paran, and as He was revealed to Abraham, as He mentioned Him in the Torah, This is not specific to Christ, but rather it is for others as well as for him.

And if they wanted the Lord’s essence to dwell in Christ, or in anyone else, then this is the subject of dispute. So where is their evidence of the possibility of this and its occurrence? Although the masses of wise people from the religion and others say: This is not realistic, but rather it is impossible.
The tenth aspect: Their saying: The word of God, by which the good things were created, appears in a completely incomplete manner - false talk.

If the appearance of divine matters is possible, then its appearance in the gentle is more preferable than its appearance in the dense. The angels send down revelation to the prophets, peace be upon them, and they receive the word of God from God, and send it down to the prophets, peace be upon them. So the word of God will reach angels before it reaches human beings, and they are the intermediaries, as the Almighty said: {Or sends a messenger and reveals By His permission whatever He wills.” [Al-Shura: 51]

And God Almighty supported His human messengers until they were able to receive information from the angels, and the angels would sometimes come to them in a form other than that. humanity, and sometimes in human form, so it was more appropriate for divine matters to appear through subtle things and for them to reach them. And if it were possible for the Lord, Glory be to Him, to unite with a living being and dwell in it, then His dwelling would be in one of the angels and his union with it would be It is better than his coming together and uniting with one of the human beings.

The eleventh aspect: Their Christian humanity was united by both the body and the spirit, for Christ had a body and a spirit, just as For all mankind, and to them divinity was united with it, for them it is a name that applies to a human body and soul and to divinity, and in that case divinity is Their opinion was united into a gentle, which is the soul, and a dense, which is the body. It did not appear in a dense only, and were it not for the gentle that was with the dense, And he is the spirit - the dense person had no virtue or honor.

The twelfth aspect: They liken the union of divinity and humanity to the union of the soul and the body, just as they likened his appearance in him here to the appearance of The soul is in the body, and then it is known that whatever pain afflicts the body, the soul suffers, and whatever pain the soul suffers, the body suffers. It is necessary for them that when humanity was crucified and suffered and suffered severe pain, the divinity was also suffering and in pain, and I addressed some of this. Christians, and he said to me: The soul is simple, that is, it is not afflicted by pain, so I said to him:

So what do you say about the souls of infidels after death, whether they will be blessed or tortured? He said: It is in torment, and I said: It is known that the departing soul is both blessed and tormented, so if
You likened the divinity in humanity to the spirit in the body. It must suffer when humanity suffers, just as the spirit suffers when the body suffers. So he confessed. And others as necessary.
The thirteenth aspect: Their saying: And if gentle things do not appear except in dense ones - then the word of God does not appear except in dense ones. No.

A corrupt construction that has no significance, but it only indicates if they explain that every subtlety appears in a dense one, and does not appear in any other, such that it is said: For this reason. God appeared in Khathayf and did not appear in Latif. Otherwise, if it is said: He does not reside in either Latif or Khathayf, or it is said that He resides in both of them - Their statement that it must be found in Christ, which is dense and not gentle, is invalid. They did not compose the argument in a productive manner, nor did they indicate its premises. With evidence, they did not bring the form of evidence, nor its material,, but rather fallacies that are only spread by an ignorant person who imitates them.

The soul’s incorporation into the body does not necessarily mean that everything resides in the body. Rather, this is an abstract claim, as the souls of the children of Adam appear in their bodies. It does not appear in the bodies of animals, nor even in the jinn, and angels appear in the form of human beings, and so do jinn, and humans do not appear in the form of humans. Other than the image of man, what evidence is there from their words that the Lord dwells in the dense man, and does not dwell in the gentle man?

And the people began to protest against the anthropomorphism of the creative word of God, and they said: As for the anthropomorphism of the creative word of God with a created human being? And their birth together, that is, the Word with humanity, for God did not speak to any of the prophets except by revelation or from behind a veil, and not about what they mentioned. Qat is an indication, neither definite nor speculative, of the embodiment of the creative word of God and its birth with humanity.

The fourteenth aspect: They said: As for the anthropomorphism of the creative word of God, then they said: The word of God by which the subtle things were created, sometimes They make it a creator, and sometimes they make it a creature created by it, and it is known that the Creator is not the One created by Him, and the one created by Him is not He. The Creator, if the Word is a creator, then it created things, and things were not created by it, and if things were created by it, then Things were created, nay, things were created by them, and if they say: Things were created by them, in the sense that if God wills a matter, He only says For him:
Be and it is, this would be true, but they make her a creator, while saying something that contradicts that.
The fifteenth aspect: That it be said to them:

If God does not speak to humans except by revelation or from behind a veil, or sends a messenger who reveals by His permission whatever He wills - then His speech to humans By revelation and from behind a veil, as Moses spoke, and by sending an angel, as he sent the angels - either is sufficient to achieve what the Lord wants from the message. To His servants, or it is not sufficient, rather He must have Himself dwell in human beings. If that were sufficient, could it be possible for the Messiah to be like anyone else? Then God will inspire him, or send him an angel, and he, by God’s leave, will reveal whatever he wants, or he will speak to him from behind a veil, as he spoke.

Moses, then there is no need for him to be united with any created human being, and if speaking is not enough, he must be united with all the prophets, just as He united with Christ, so he united with Noah, Abraham, Moses, David, and others. This is demonstrated: the sixteenth aspect:

It is known that the prophets who were before Christ are better than the common Christians who were after Christ, and better Of the Jews who denied Christ, then the Lord had preferred to unite him in Christ, to the point that he spoke to his servants himself, so he would be united with Christ. Hiding himself with his thick body, he spoke by himself to the Jews who denied Christ and to the common Christians, and to everyone else whom Christ spoke to, so it was that It is better and more likely for him to speak to those who are better than these, among the prophets and righteous people, on his own behalf, such as uniting with Abraham the friend. So he speaks to Isaac, Jacob, and Lot, concealed in the body of the friend, or he unites with Jacob and speaks to his sons or others, concealed in Jacob’s body. Or he would unite with Moses bin Imran and speak to Aaron and Joshua bin Nun and others, while concealing himself under the body of Moses. If it was him, glory be to Him, he would not have done so. This is either because he refrained from doing so, or because his dignity and wisdom are higher than that, despite the lack of need for that. It is known that he does not do it. This is in Christ in the first and most appropriate way.

The seventeenth aspect: If it is possible for him to unite with a human being, then it would be better and more likely for him to unite with an angel among the angels, and in that case it would have been His union with Gabriel, who sent him to the prophets, is more important than his union with a human being who addresses the Jews and common Christians.

chapters.title: Chapter refuting the Christians’ intentions regarding the appearance of God in Jesus
paragraphs: [Chapter: Refuting the Christians’ desire for the appearance of God in Jesus]

They said: That is why he appeared in Jesus, son of Mary, since man is the most glorious of what God created, and for this reason he addressed the creation, and they witnessed from him what they witnessed.
It is said:

If you claim that he appeared in Jesus as he appeared in Abraham, Moses, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, and as he appeared in his houses to which he called God, that it be raised and His name be mentioned in it, and that is with the manifestation of His light and knowledge, and the mention of His names and worship of Him and the like, without permission. itself in mankind and not its union with it. This is a common matter between Christ and others, so Christ has no jurisdiction over this. This also may be called Permissible, and according to them, God dwells among the righteous, and this is mentioned among them in some of the divine books, as in their books in the fourth Psalm. From the Psalms, David, peace be upon him, says in his supplications to his Lord:

And let those who trust in you rejoice forever and be glad, and let you dwell in them and be proud. So he was told that it is permissible for the righteous people mentioned, so he knew that this was not specific to Christ, and what is meant by this is not - by their agreement and the agreement of Muslims - that the essence of God Himself unites with humanity, and divinity and humanity become like fire and iron, water and milk,

And other things by which they represent unity. Rather, what is meant by this is the coming of faith in Him, knowledge of Him, love of Him, remembrance of Him, and worship of Him. And His light and guidance.
This may be expressed through a scientific example, as God Almighty said: “And He is the One who is a God in the heaven and a God on earth” [Al-Zukhruf: 84].
And God Almighty said: {And He is God in the heavens and in the earth} [Al-An’am: 3].
{And to Him is the highest example in the heavens and the earth} [Al-Rum: 27].
He, Glory be to Him, is the highest example in the hearts of the people of the heavens and the people of the earth.

From this chapter: “What the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, narrates on the authority of his Lord. He said: God says: I am with my servant as long as he mentions Me, and his lips move with Me.” So he told that his lips moved with it, that is, with his name, and likewise his saying in the authentic hadith: “My servant fell ill and you did not visit me,” so the servant says: My Lord, how can I return to You when You are the Lord of the worlds? He will say: Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine fell ill? Had you visited him, you would have found Me with him.
He said: You would have found me with him, but he did not say: You would have found me with him, while he was with him, that is, in his heart, and in whose heart is the scientific ideal.

“And God Almighty said: My servant, I was hungry and you did not feed Me. He will say: How can I feed You when You are the Lord of the worlds? He will say: Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine was hungry? Had you fed him, you would have found him with Me. He did not say, “You would have found Me having eaten him.”

Likewise, his statement in the authentic hadith narrated by Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: God Almighty says: Who “He was hostile to a friend of mine, so I declared him to war, but my servant did not approach me in the same manner as I had enjoined upon him, and my servant continues to draw near to me.” voluntary prayers until I love him. If I love him, I will be his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he strikes. And his foot with which he walks.”

And in a narration: By me he hears, and by me he sees, and by me he runs, and by me he walks, and if he asks Me, I will give him, and if he seeks refuge from Me, I will seek refuge with him, and what I hesitated from something that I would do, just as I hesitated from taking the soul of my faithful servant. He hates death, and I hate suffering from it.
This hadith may be used as evidence by those who say general solution, or general unity, or unity of existence, and it may be used as evidence by those who say In particular, like the Christians.

The hadith is proof for both parties, for it said: Whoever is hostile to a friend of mine, I have declared war upon him, and he has confirmed three: his friend, and an enemy who is hostile to him. his guardian, and distinguished between himself and his guardian, and the enemy of his guardian, so he said: “Whoever is hostile to a guardian of mine, I have declared war upon him,” but this indicates that His friend is the one who befriended him, so he loves what he loves and hates what he hates, and is loyal to whomever he supports and is hostile to whomever is hostile, so the Lord will be a caller to war to whomever He was hostile to him, because he was hostile to God.

Then God Almighty said: “And my servant does not draw near to Me with a performance like that which I have enjoined upon him,” so he differentiated between the servant who draws near and the Lord who draws near to Him. Then he said: My servant will continue to draw near to Me by performing voluntary acts of worship until I love him. He made it clear that he loves him after he has drawn near to Me by performing voluntary and obligatory prayers.

Then he said: If I love him, I will be his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his hand with which he strikes, and his foot with which he strikes. He walks with it, and according to the people of the solution, general union, or unity: it is his chest, stomach, back, head, and hair, and it is all Something, or in everything before and after closeness, and according to the elite and the people of the solutions, it became it, and it is like fire, iron, water, and milk, no This concerns the machine of perception and action.

Then God Almighty said: “By me he hears, and by me he sees, and by me he walks, and by me he walks,” and according to the words of these - the Lord is the one who hears, sees, and moves. And he walked, and the Messenger only said: By me, then he said: “And if he asks Me, I will give him, and if he seeks refuge from Me, I will seek refuge with him.” So he made the servant a beggar. seeking refuge, and the Lord is responsible, seeking refuge in him, and this contradicts union, and his saying: by me he hears is like his saying: his lips did not move by me, he wants It has a scientific example.
And God says: So God is in his heart, meaning his knowledge, love, guidance, and loyalty, and this is the scientific proverb, so with that which is in his heart He hears, sees, walks, and walks.

If a creature loves a creature, venerates it, or obeys it, he expresses it in this way, saying: You are in my heart and in my heart, and you still are. Between my eyes, and from it is the saying of the one who said: Your likeness is in my eyes and your remembrance is in my mouth... and your resting place is in my heart, so where will you be absent? And the other said: It is a wonder to me that I yearn To them... And I ask about them whomever I meet while they are with me, and my eyes seek them while they are in its darkness...

My heart misses them while they are between my ribs, and there are many such things, despite the wise people’s knowledge that the soul of the most beloved is not within himself. Himself in the eyes of his lover, not in his heart, but this may be suspected by this, to the point that the misguided think that the soul of the beloved and worshiped is in itself. The loving and worshiping one.

For this reason, some philosophers were mistaken to the point that they thought that the essence of the intelligible known was united with the rational world, so they made the intelligible, the intellect, and the intellect One thing, and they did not distinguish between the solutions of the example of the known, and the solutions of itself, and this is due to the weakness of reason and the strength of the authority of love. And knowledge, a person is absent from his worship, from his beloved from his love, from his witness, from his witness. And by His being known from His knowledge, then whoever was not from the witness of the servant will be annihilated, not because his soul will be destroyed and he will be annihilated in whoever did not remain in Him. His witnesses, and in this case, if he makes a mistake, he may say something like what is narrated on the authority of Abu Yazid Al-Bistami:
Glory be to Me, or whatever is in the robe

Except God, and in this case a story is mentioned, which is that a person was in love with another, and the beloved threw himself into water, so the lover threw himself Behind him, he said: I fell, so why did you fall? He said: You were absent from me, so I thought you were me. When this loving servant took control of his heart, the power of love became his heart. Absorbed in his beloved, his heart did not witness anything other than what was in his heart, and he was absent from witnessing himself and his actions, so he thought that he was the same person. The beloved, and this is more trivial than thinking that the beloved is himself.

This assumption about the unity of the self or its coming into being is a mistaken belief that many people fell into. Those who said: Christ or any other human being is God, or that God is present in him. Their mistake may be of this type, when they heard words implying that God is present in the person himself, and they made this act. فِعْلَ هَذَا، ظَنُّوا ذَاكَ اتِّحَادَ الذَّاتِ وَحُلُولَهَا.

Rather, what is meant is the knowledge of God in it, and the unity of what is commanded and forbidden, and the one who follows and the enemy, as the Almighty says: {Indeed, those They pledge allegiance to you; they pledge allegiance only to Allah} [Al-Fath: 10].
And his saying: {Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed God} [An-Nisa: 80].

This is not because the Messenger is God, nor because his soul resides in the Messenger, but rather because the Messenger commands what God has commanded, and forbids what God forbids it, and he loves what God loves, and hates what God hates, and is loyal to the friends of God, and is hostile to the enemies of God.
So whoever pledges his allegiance to him on hearing and obedience, he has pledged allegiance to God only on hearing and obedience, and whoever obeys him has only obeyed God.

Likewise, Christ and the other apostles; They only command what God commands, and they forbid what God forbids, and they are loyal to the friends of God, and they are hostile to the enemies of God. Whoever obeys them has obeyed God, and whoever believes them has accepted from them what they were informed of, he has accepted from God, and whoever supports them has loyal to God. And whoever is hostile to them and wars with them has been hostile to God and wars against God, and whoever imagines these matters, it will become clear to him that the word permissible may be expressed in it. With a correct meaning, it may be expressed as a corrupt meaning.
Likewise, the abode of His words in the hearts, and for this reason Ahmad ibn Hanbal disliked speaking about the abode of the Qur’an in the hearts, as has been mentioned elsewhere. This place.

What makes this clear is that a thing has existence in itself, and it has existence in the known and minds, and it has existence in speech and the tongue. It exists in writing and statement, and there is a concrete, personal, scientific, verbal, and formal existence. This is like the sun, for example, and it has verification in itself, and it is the sun in the sky, then the heart imagines the sun, then the tongue utters the word sun, and the sun is written with the pen.

What is meant by writing is to match the word, and by the word to match the knowledge, and by knowledge to match the known, so if a person sees in... A book that traces the line of the sun, or he heard someone mentioning that he said:

This sun God has made a radiant lamp, and this sun rises in the east and sets in the west, so he refers to what he heard from The word “he saw it from the handwriting” and what is meant is not the word and the handwriting itself, for that is not the sun that rises and sets, rather what is meant is what is meant. In writing and verbally, what is meant by both is the meaning that corresponds to them. Likewise, the name of God may be seen written in a book, along with the name of an idol. And he says:

I believed in this, and I disbelieved in this, and what he means is that he is a believer in God and disbelieves in the idol, so he refers to his written name and what he means by this. The name. Likewise, when he hears someone mentioning the most beautiful names of God, he says: This is the Lord of the worlds, and what is meant is: the one called by those names, and of these. “The saying of Anas bin

Malik: The inscription on the seal of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, had three lines: Muhammad is the Messenger of God, Muhammad is a line, the Messenger is a line, and God is a line.
What is meant by these names is the script for this, this, and that, not the word or the name.

Something similar to this is what is seen in a mirror or in water, such as when the sun or something else is seen in water or a mirror, so the visible is referred to and it is said: This is the sun, and this is my face or the face of so-and-so, and it does not mean that the same sun or his face or the face of so-and-so dissolved in the water or the mirror. But since what was meant by that vision was the sun, which is the face - he mentioned it, then it may be said: he saw it bound in the water, or The mirror, and it may be said: He saw it through water and a mirror, and it may be said:
He saw his example and his imagination imitated it, but what is meant by the vision is himself, and there are many such things.

It is known that what is in the hearts of the scientific example that matches the known is closer to it than the word, and the word is closer than the handwriting. He might have referred to the wording and the handwriting, and what was meant was the same, even if the handwriting and the handwriting were not the same, but rather it appeared and was recognized, Because it refers to what is in the heart, and what is meant by it is the good that appeared to the heart and was revealed to the heart, and its light became in the heart - in the first way.

The wise people only have their hearts directed toward the desired goal rather than the means, and they express it with phrases that indicate that so that their intention becomes clear through them. Just as they say to someone who knows the knowledge of someone else, or to someone who orders someone else’s affairs and tells his information, “This is so-and-so,” so if what they are seeking is knowledge. A scholar or obedience to a prince. Then his representative came to take his place in that regard. They said: This is so-and-so, meaning what is required of him is with this person. Unity What is meant by them is that they express one of them using the other's word.

As it is said: Ikrimah is Ibn Abbas, and Abu Yusuf is Abu Hanifa, and from this section what is mentioned about Christ, peace be upon him, is that He said: My father and I are one. Whoever sees me has seen my father.

“And God Almighty said in what he narrated on the authority of His Messenger: ‘My servant, I was sick and you did not visit Me. My servant, I was hungry and you did not feed Me.’” It is similar to His saying: “Indeed, Those who pledge allegiance to you only pledge allegiance to Allah} [Al-Fath: 10].

This type of speech should be known, because it solves many problems, for this is found in the words of God and His Messengers. And the speech of created beings, in general of the sects, with the meaning becoming apparent and the speaker and the addressee knowing that what is meant is not that the essence of one of them is united. In the same way as the other.

Rather, it is more eloquent than that when the word “solution” and “union” is used, and what is meant by it is a correct meaning, as it is said that so-and-so and so-and-so has a union between them, so They were in agreement in what they loved and hated, and were loyal and hostile, so when their desire and purpose were united, it became said that they were united, and between them This does not mean that the essence of one is united with the essence of the other, like the union of fire and iron, water and milk, or the soul and the body. The same applies to the word “permissiveness,” “dwelling,” “permeation,” and so on, as it was said: “The path of the soul has permeated me...

Thus, the friend was called a friend, and what pervades the soul’s path through him is his love for him, his feeling for him, and the like, not his essence in and of itself. Likewise what the other said:

He resides in the heart, he lives in it... I do not forget him, so I remember him, and the one who lives in the heart is his scientific example, his love, and his knowledge, so it resides in The heart is its knowledge and love, not the eye itself. Likewise, the other saying: If the stream remains still in clarity... and avoids being stirred by the breeze, it will seem... In it is the sky without any color... This is how the sun appears and the stars. Such is the hearts of the masters of manifestation... God Almighty can be seen in its clearness, and it may be said: So-and-so is in His heart is none other than God, and there is none with him but God. This means:

Except for remembrance of Him, knowledge of Him, love, fear of Him, obedience to Him, and the like, that is, there is not in his heart what is in the heart of other created beings. There is no one in his heart but God alone, and it is said: So-and-so has no one but so-and-so, when he dwells on mentioning Him and prefers him over others.

This is a broad section, with the speaker and listener knowing that the soul of so-and-so was not included in this, let alone united with him, and it is as it is said. Concerning the mirror if it faces nothing but the sun: there is nothing in it but the sun, that is, nothing but the sun appears in it.

Also, the word solutions sometimes means the solutions of the thing itself, and the solutions of its knowledge, love, and scientific example at times, as mentioned above. And they hold that in the prophecies God has resided among the righteous other than the Messiah, and what is meant by this is not that the essence of the Lord has resided in him, rather it is said that so-and-so lives in my heart And it resides in my heart, and it resides in my secret, and the endosperm of my heart, and the like, but its scientific example has resided in it, and if that is the case, it is known that If a place is devoid of those who know God and worship Him, then there is no remembrance of God nor is it permissible to worship Him and know Him. He knows God, worships Him, and remembers Him. The remembrance of Him and belief in Him appeared in it, and belief in God, worshiping Him, and remembering Him appeared in it, and it is the House of God. God Almighty, it is said:
God is in it, and He abides in it.

As it is said: God is in the hearts of those who know, and dwells in them, and what is meant by it is the abode of knowing Him, believing in Him, and loving Him, and so on. Evidence of this was presented, for if the Lord is in the hearts of His faithful servants, that is, His light and knowledge, and this was expressed as being present in them and in them. They are in the mosque - it was said: God is in the mosque, and He is in it, with this meaning, just as it is said: God is in the heart of so-and-so and so-and-so, and he has nothing but God, as the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said in the authentic hadith: “Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine had fallen ill? Had you visited him, you would have found Me with him.”

What makes this more clear is what the sleeper sees in his dream of some people, speaking to him, ordering him, forbidding him, and telling him things. Many, and he says: I saw so-and-so in my dream and he said to me: such-and-such, and I said to him: such-and-such, and he did such-and-such, and I did such-and-such, and he mentions types of Words and deeds.

It may contain knowledge, wisdom, and literature that will be of great benefit, and that person who saw it in the dream may be alive, and he is not He feels that he saw him in his dream, in addition to feeling that he said or did it, and the dreamer may narrate his visions to him, and tell him The dreamer: Sir, I saw you in a dream and you said to me:

Such-and-such, and You commanded me to do such-and-such, and forbade me to do such-and-such, and the one who is seen does not know that, nor does he feel it, because the visible thing that settled in the heart of the seer It is the scientific example that corresponds to the eyes, just as the person who sees in a mirror or water sees the person outside, so this is what is intended, and some Those who are seen in a dream may know that he was seen in a dream, and he may disclose that to the dreamer just as he may disclose other matters to him, not because he himself has dreamed. In it.

If the vision is true, then those words and actions are appropriate to the situation of the one seeing it, as is his habit of saying and doing it himself. So he represented to the seer his example, speaking to him and acting; So that it is known that he himself says it and does it, so that the person seeing it will benefit from it, just as a person is told about the words and deeds of others so that he himself will be aware of that. The spoken word and deed, for many things are not known to people, or most of them, except by the example given to them, either while awake Or in a dream, knowing that this person’s eye is not that person’s eye,

Whoever imagines that if he sees a person in his dream that his own self has resided within him, this indicates his ignorance. The visible person is often alive and does not feel who he saw. This is because neither his soul nor his body feels, so he does not imagine that his soul is It is represented in the physical image of the sleeper. Rather, what is represented in the dreamer’s soul is an identical example of him, and his body and soul are where they are.

Then the vision may be from God, so it is true, or it may be from Satan, as its division into these two has been proven in the authentic hadiths, Satan, just as he may be represented in a dream as a person, may also be represented in waking life as a person seen by many people, thereby misleading him. Whoever is not among the people of knowledge and faith, as happens to many Indian polytheists and others, when he dies, their dead person will see him having come. After that, he paid debts, returned deposits, and told them things about their dead, but it is a devil that took his own form, and he may come to them in The image of those whom they venerate among the righteous, and he says:
I am so-and-so, but he is a devil.

One of the sheikhs may stand up, and his place will be replaced by a person in his image. They call him the spirituality of the sheikh and his companion, and he is a genie who was created in his image. This happens to many monks and non-monks who are affiliated with Islam, and one of them may see someone saying to him in his waking hours: I am the friend, or I am Moses, or I am the Messiah, or Muhammad, or I am so-and-so to some of the companions, or the disciples, and he sees him flying in the air, But that is from the devils, and that image is not like the image of that person.

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has truly seen me, for Satan does not take my form.” So seeing him in a dream True, but in waking life neither he nor any of the dead can be seen with the eye, although many people may see in waking life someone they think is a prophet. Among the prophets, either at his grave or at someone other than his grave.

He may see the grave split open, and the image of a human being emerges from it, and he thinks that the dead person himself came out of his grave, or that his spirit was incarnated. And she came out of the grave, but that was a genie that took his image to mislead the person who saw it, for the soul is not something that exists under the dirt and is torn apart. The dirt is attached to it, and even though it may be connected to the body, there is no need to make a split in the dirt, and the dirt has not split from the body. This is merely an imagination from Satan, and something like this has happened to many of those affiliated with the Muslims, the People of the Book, and the polytheists.

Many people think that this is one of the blessings of the righteous servants of God, and it is from the devils being led astray, as has been explained in detail about this. The chapter is about something other than this book, such as the difference between the guardians of the Most Gracious, and the guardians of Satan, and so on.

chapters.title: The response chapter to what they said appeared in Jesus’ self-exaltation and his union with Christ or someone else
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to their saying that the incorporation of himself and his union with Christ or someone else appeared in Jesus]
And if you want to say:

The incorporation of himself into Jesus and his union with Christ or others appeared in Jesus - this is an abstract claim, with no evidence, whether earlier or later, and the fact that Man, the greatest thing God created - if he were suitable for his dwelling in it - is something that is not specific to Christ. Rather, evidence has been established that someone other than Jesus was responsible for it. Peace is better than that of Abraham and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, and God made these two friends, and there is no rank higher than a companion. If it were permissible for the sake of what God created of man, because he is the most exalted of His creatures, then it would be permissible for this type, which is the Khalil and Muhammad. May God’s prayers and peace be upon them, and they have never had any argument that the body taken from Mary, if it is not united with divinity according to their origin, is Better than Hebron and Moses.

And if they say: He did not commit a sin, then Yahya bin Zakariya did not commit a sin, and whoever commits a sin and repents from it may become Through repentance, he is better than he was before the sin, and better than he who did not commit that sin, and Hebron and Moses are better than Yahya who They call him John the Baptist.

As for their saying: That is why he addressed the creation, the one who addressed the creation was Jesus, son of Mary, and the people only heard his voice and they only heard His voice, and when the jinn resides in a human and speaks on his tongue, it will appear to the listeners that this voice is not the voice of a human being, and he speaks With words that those present know are not the words of humans.

And Christ, peace be upon him, was not heard from him except what was heard from other messengers like him, even if the one speaking through the language of humanity was a genie or an angel. This would have become apparent, and it would have been known that it was not a human being, so what if the speaker was the Lord of the worlds? If this were true, it would have appeared much greater than the appearance of the words of the king and the genie on human lips.

As for the miracles they witnessed of Christ, peace and blessings be upon him, they witnessed others like them and greater than them, and he was revived. The dead changed him and told him more about the unseen than him, and Moses’ miracles were greater than his miracles or more, and miracles appeared at his hands. It indicates his prophecy and his message, just as miracles indicate the prophecy of others, and their message does not indicate divinity.

And when the Dajjal claimed divinity, the supernatural phenomena that appeared on his hands were not evidence of them, because the claim to divinity is impossible, so it would not be The appearance of miracles indicates something that is impossible.

chapters.title: Detailing what previous books predicted about Christ
paragraphs: [Chapter: What the previous books predicted about the Messiah]

They said: God had spoken on the mouths of the prophets and messengers, who prophesied about his birth from the pure virgin Mary, and on all His deeds that he did on earth, and his ascension to heaven, and all of these prophecies are acknowledged and recognized by the Jews. They read it in their churches, and they did not deny a single word of it.
It is said:

All of this is something that Muslims do not dispute, for there is no doubt that he was born of the virgin Mary, whom no human had ever touched, and that God made signs appear on His hands, and that He ascended to heaven, as God told of that in His Book, as mentioned above, so if this is Of what the prophets were told about in the prophecies of the Jews, they did not deny that, even though the Jews interpreted that in a different way. The Messiah, as in the prophecies of the good news of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is true, even if those who disbelieve in it are among the People of the Book. They interpret that as something else.

chapters.title: Detailing their discussion of what they reported from the prophets about the coming of Christ, peace be upon him, and explaining its significance
paragraphs: [Chapter: Discussing with them what they reported from the prophets about the coming of Christ, peace be upon him, and explaining the significance of it] [Ezra’s saying The Messiah will come and save the peoples and nations]

They said: Our way is to mention some of the sayings of the prophets who prophesied against the Lord Christ and his descent to earth. Ezra said The priest, when Bukhtazer the Alfred took them captive to the land of Babylon for four hundred and eighty-two years: The Messiah will come and save the peoples And the nations, and in the completion of this period the Lord Christ came. The Prophet Jeremiah said about his birth at that time:

chapters.title: Ezra said: “The Messiah will come and save the peoples and nations.”
paragraphs: A son of David will arise, who is the light of light. He will reign as king, and will teach and understand, and will establish truth and justice in the earth, and will save those who believe in him. The Jews from the Children of Israel and others, and the Holy House remains without a fighter and is called God. As for his saying: A son of David, because Mary was of the lineage of David, and for this reason the Prophet said: A son will arise from David.

It is said: As for the statement of Ezra the priest, it only tells him that the Messiah will come and save the peoples and nations, and this is something that is not disputed. Muslims, for they acknowledge what God told in His Book about the coming of Christ, peace be upon him, and God’s salvation through him of all those who believe in him. Peoples and nations until Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent.

Everyone who believes in Christ and follows what was revealed to him without distortion or alteration, God has saved him through Christ from the evil of the world. And the Hereafter, just as God Almighty saved those of the Children of Israel who followed him through Moses.

And whoever distorts and alters does not follow Christ, and whoever denies Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is like one who denied Christ after he had acknowledged Moses over him. Peace.

But this text and others like it are evidence against the Jews who interpret this to mean that this is not the Messiah, the son of Mary, but rather he is A Messiah is waiting, but they are only waiting for the Antichrist, the Messiah of misguidance, for the Jews will follow him and the Muslims will kill them with him (“until he says Trees and stones: “O Muslim, this is a Jew behind me. Come and kill him.”) And this is what is said in the second prophecy that they mentioned about the Prophet Jeremiah. Peace be upon him.

chapters.title: Detailing what Jeremiah the Prophet said about his birth at that time
paragraphs: [Chapter: The words of Jeremiah the Prophet about his birth at that time]

They said: And Jeremiah the prophet said about his birth at that time: A son of David will arise, and he will be the light of light. He will rule the kingdom, and will teach and understand. He will establish truth and justice in the land, and save those of the Jews who believe in him, from the children of Israel and others, and the Holy House will remain without a fighter. He is called God, and as for His saying: A son of David, because Mary was of the descendants of David, and for that reason He said: (And a son of David shall arise) .
The answer is to say: He said about it: And He will save the Jews and the Children of Israel who believe in Him. This is how we interpreted the salvation that he transmitted from Ezra the priest.

As for his saying: And His name is God, this indicates that He is not God, Lord of the worlds, but rather the word God is a name by which He is named as He is called. Moses was a god to Pharaoh in their view in the Torah. If he had been God, Lord of the worlds, he would have been too exalted to be said and called a god, for God is Blessed and Most High is not known by something like this, and it is said about it: God is called God, and He said: God himself will come and appear. And he said: He reigns over the kingdom, and the Lord of the worlds is and is still in possession of the kingdom, Glory be to Him.

And also, for he said: A son of David will arise who is the light of light. It is known that the son who is of the lineage of David, whose mother’s name is Mary, is Humanity only, for divinity is not from the lineage of humans, and it has become clear that this humanity, who is the Son of David, is called God, so it was known that This is a name for created humanity, not for the Creator God.

And also, he said: And it is the light of light, and the light itself did not make it, rather, He made it the light of light, and God Almighty enlightens all light, so how can it be? It is a light of light, and God Almighty called Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, an illuminating lamp, and he was not a creator of that, so how if it was called light? The light?
Also, no one made the risen one except the son of David, and the son of David is a created being.

He added the verb to this creature, and if this were God, Lord of the worlds, united with human humanity, Jeremiah and others would have made it clear. Among the prophets, that was a conclusive statement of the excuse, and they were not satisfied with such expressions that are either explicit or apparent in the opposite. That, or a summary that does not indicate that, for it is known that informing them of the coming of one of the prophets is a common and possible matter. Despite this, they mention good news and clear evidence about it that removes suspicion.

As for informing about the coming of the Lord Himself and His coming or His union with human humanity, it is: either impossible or impossible, as most say. The wise people among the children of Adam say: Anyone with a clear mind knows that this is impossible.

Or is it possible, as some people say, and in that case its possibility is hidden to most wise people, and it is something unusual, and the coming of the Lord By himself, it is greater than the coming of every messenger and prophet, especially if his coming was through his union with a human being on whose hands no signs appeared. He specializes in the divine, but nothing appeared at his hands except what appeared at the hands of other prophets who were similar to him or greater than him. By God Almighty, when he was speaking to Moses and Moses could not see him, and he did not identify himself with Moses or anyone else, and despite this, He made clear from the verses on That, and according to the prophecy of Moses, no one like it or anything close to it has appeared at the hands of Christ.

If He Himself were united with human humanity, the prophets would have reported that in a clear and clear way that does not allow for interpretations. And the Lord would have revealed signs in that which had not been revealed by a messenger or a prophet, so how come when the prophets did not speak about that with explicit words? Rather, the clear texts indicate that Christ was a created being, and no verse came to the contrary. Rather, the verses indicate the prophecy of Christ.

chapters.title: Chapter on the words of the prophet Isaiah: God will come and save the peoples
paragraphs: [Chapter: The words of the prophet Isaiah: God will come and save the peoples]

They said: And the prophet Isaiah said: Tell Zion, “Here you will rejoice and be glad, for God will come and save the peoples, and he will save those who believe in him and his people.” He will save the city of Jerusalem, and God will reveal his pure arm therein to all the scattered nations and make them one nation, and they will see. All the people of the earth are saved by God, because he walks with them and before them, and the God of Israel gathers them together.

It is said: This first needs to be known from this prophecy that this speech was transmitted without any distortion of its wording, or any error in the translation, and there was no error in the translation. This proves,
And if that is proven, then it is equivalent to what is in the Torah, which says: (God came from Mount Sinai, and looked up from Seir, and was revealed from the mountains. Varan).

It is known that there is nothing in this that indicates that God resides in Moses ibn Imran and is united with him, nor that He resides on Mount Paran, nor that He It is united with something from Mount Sinai, and not from Sa'ir.

Likewise, this word does not indicate that he is present in Christ and united with him, since they are both the same, and if it is said: What is meant by that is his closeness. His approach is like the speech of Moses, and the appearance of his light, his guidance, his book, his religion, and other such things that occurred. It was said: And so it was in Christ. Peace be upon him.

And his saying: And God will reveal His pure arm to all the scattered nations. He said something like this in the Torah in more than one place, and it did not indicate that. For his union with Moses, peace be upon him.
As for what he said about the dispersed nations: He makes them one nation, for they are the ones who followed Christ, for they were dispersed and dispersed. So he made them one nation.

As for his saying: And all the people of the earth will see the salvation of God, because he walks with them and before them, and the God of Israel will gather them together, for example This is mentioned in the Torah in more than one place, and this does not indicate his union with Moses or his presence therein, as his saying in the fifth book of the Torah: He says Moses to the children of Israel: Do not fear them, nor fear them, for God is your Lord, who goes before you. He will fight on your behalf.

In a certain situation, Moses said: “The people are your people.” So he said: “I will go ahead of you.” So he said: “If you do not go ahead of us, otherwise no.” You take us up from here, and how will I and this people know that I have found such and such blessing before you except by your walking with us?

And in the fourth book of the thirteenth chapter: If you bring these people up from among them by your power, then they will say to the people of this land who They heard that you are God among these people. Eye for eye they see Him, and your clouds reside over them, and with a column of clouds He walks before them by day. And with a pillar of fire by night.
Also in the Torah: God says to Moses: (I am coming to you in the thick of the clouds so that the people can hear me speaking to you).
Then he said: Gather seventy men from the elders of the children of Israel and take them to the Arabs’ hideout to stand with you until I speak to them.

chapters.title: Chapter on the words of Zechariah: And he and they will dwell in you, and you will know that I am the powerful God who lives in you
paragraphs: [Chapter: The saying of Zechariah: And he and they will dwell in you, and you will know that I am the powerful God who dwells in you.]

They said: And the prophet Zechariah said: (Rejoice, O house of Zion, for I will come to you and dwell in you and I will see you.) God said: And he will believe in God on that day. many nations, and they will be one people to him, and he and they will dwell in you, and you will know that I am the strong God who dwells in you, and God will take On that day the kingdom will come from Judah, and he will reign over them forever.

It is said: Something like this was mentioned to them on the authority of Abraham and other prophets, that God appeared to him, was revealed to him, and appeared to him. And similar expressions, but this does not indicate his inclusion in it and his union with it.

And so is his coming. He did not say: I dwell in Christ and unite with him. Rather, he said about the House of Zion: (I come to you and dwell in you) as He said something similar to them other than that, and he did not indicate its permissibility in humans. Likewise his saying: (And you will know that I am God, the Strong, who dwells in In you) This word did not mean his dwelling in Christ, for Christ did not dwell in the Holy House while he was strong, but rather he entered it while he was defeated. He was oppressed to the point of being captured, crucified, or similar to him. By God, Glory be to Him, when knowledge of Him and belief in Him take place in the hearts, they will be reassured and at peace.
When the religion of Christ, peace be upon him, appeared in it after his elevation, there was faith in God and knowledge of Him that had not been the case in the Holy House. Before that.

The sum of this is that the previous prophecies and the divine books such as the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the rest of the prophecies of the prophets were not specific to Christ with something that necessitates his specificity through the union of divinity with him and his abiding in him, as the Christians say. The language of Muhammad in the words of God Almighty: {The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, is only a Messenger of God, and His word which He conveyed to Mary, and a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa: 171].

So the previous books of the prophets, and all the other prophecies agree with what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, told them, they confirm one another, and all that Christians use it as evidence of his divinity from the words of the prophets. Such words may be found regarding anyone other than the Messiah, so singling out the Messiah By divinity and without anything else is false, and that is like the name of the Son and Christ and like the descent of the Holy Spirit in it, and like calling Him a god, Such as the appearance of the Lord, or His dwelling in it, or His dwelling in it, or in His place.
These words and others like them are found in relation to anyone other than Christ among them, and they were not therefore gods.
But those who advocate solutions and unity against all the prophets and righteous people may use these words as evidence.

This doctrine is false, according to the agreement of Muslims, Jews, and Christians, and it is false in itself, both by reason and tradition, even if it is groups of people. Atheism and heresies attributed to Muslims, Jews, and Christians, you say it, for these are suspected of what happens in the hearts of those who know them. In Him, from those who believe in Him, know Him, His light, His guidance, and the Spirit from Him, and what is expressed by the highest ideal and the scientific example.

And they thought that this was the essence of the Lord, like someone who thinks that the exact wording of a name is the meaning that is in the heart, or the same handwriting is the same meaning. Speech, and whoever thinks that the essence of the beloved resides in the essence of the lover and is united with him, or that the essence of the known favor resides in the essence of the all-knowing world. With Him and united with Him, with the certain knowledge that the soul of the Known Beloved is distinct from the soul and body of the Lover, not one of them is permissible In the soul of the lover.
God Almighty said: “And to Him is the highest example in the heavens and the earth” [Al-Rum: 27].
And God Almighty said: {And it is He who is a God in the heaven and a God on earth} [Al-Zukhruf: 84].
And God Almighty said: {And He is God in the heavens and in the earth} [Al-An’am: 3].

The believers know God, love Him, worship Him, and remember Him, and it is said, “He is in their hearts,” and what is meant is knowing Him, loving Him, and worshiping Him. It is a scientific proverb and it is not intended in and of itself, as a person says to others: You are in my heart, and you are still in my heart and between my eyes, and it is said: It resides in the heart and lives in it... I do not forget it, so I remember it. It is said: A house you reside in... does not need a lamp. And from the saying of the one who said: It is amazing to me. I yearn for them...
And I ask about them whomever I meet while they are with me, and my eyes seek them while they are in its darkness, and my heart longs for them while they are between my ribs.
And he said: Your likeness is in my eyes and your remembrance is in my mouth... and your resting place is in my heart, so where will you disappear?

Mosques: They are the houses of God in which that is evident, and for this reason the Almighty said: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is like a niche in it. A lamp} [An-Nur: 35].
Ubayy ibn Ka’b said: Like his light in the hearts of believers.
Then he said: {Light upon Light} [An-Nour: 35].
Then he said: {In houses that God has permitted to be raised and for His name to be mentioned in them} [An-Nour: 36].
So, Glory be to Him, He mentioned His light in the hearts of the believers, then He mentioned that in His homes, and likewise what was mentioned in the earlier books.

As for the coming, the coming, and the manifestation, according to them in the Torah, God says to Moses: I will come to you in the thick of the clouds, so that the people will hear. My address to you, then his saying: Gather seventy men from the elders of the children of Israel, and take them to the Arabs’ hideout to stand with you until I speak to them.

And in the fourth book, when he spoke to Miriam and Aaron about Moses: “Then God appeared in a pillar of cloud, standing at the door of the tent, and called, O Aaron and O Maryam, so they both went out and he said: Listen to my words. Indeed, I am God among you.

And in the thirteenth chapter: “If you bring these people up from among them by your power, then they will say to the people of this land who have heard that you are God.” While among these people they will see it, eye for eye, with your clouds staying over them, and with a pillar of cloud moving before them by day, and with a pillar of fire by night.)
And in the fifth book, Moses said to the children of Israel: “Do not fear them, nor fear them, for God is your Lord, who goes before you. He fights against you.” About you).

And in another place, Moses said: “The people are your people.” So he said: “O Moses, I will go ahead of you, so I will depart.” He said: “If you do not go with us, otherwise So do not bring us up from here. How will I and this people know that I have found such-and-such blessing before you through your knowledge, except by your walking with us?)

And in the fourth Psalm of their Psalms it says: (And let those who trust in You rejoice forever and be glad; let it be well within them and be proud) So He told that He dwells in all the righteous, that is, knowing Him and loving Him, for they agreed that the essence of God did not dwell in the two righteous, and likewise in Epistles of John the Evangelist: (If we hide from one another, we know that God remains among us) meaning His love, and its counterparts are many.

chapters.title: Chapter on what Amos said: The sun will rise, and the lost will be guided by it, and the children of Israel will go astray from it
paragraphs: [Chapter: The saying of Amos: The sun will rise, and those who go astray will be guided by it, and the Children of Israel will go astray from it.]

They said: And the prophet Amos said: The sun will rise on the earth, and the lost will be guided by it, and the children of Israel will go astray from it. They said: The sun is The Lord Christ, and the misguided ones who were guided by him are the Christians whose tongues were different, who before him were idol worshipers and went astray. About knowing God. When the disciples came to them and warned them of what the Lord Christ had commanded them, they abandoned the worship of idols and were guided by following them. Lord Christ.

It is said: This is something that Muslims do not dispute, but what is disputed about such and similar things is the Jews who deny Christ, peace be upon him. He also disputes with the infidels of the People of the Book regarding Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.

As for Muslims, they believe in all the Books of God and His Messengers, and that Christ, peace and blessings be upon him, shone his light on earth! Just as the light of Moses, may God bless him and grant him peace, shone before him, and the light of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, shone after him.

God Almighty said to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good news and a warner} [Al-Ahzab: 45] (45) {And a caller to God. With His permission and an illuminating lamp} [Al-Ahzab: 46].

So God called it a luminous lamp, and He called the sun a luminous lamp, and a luminous lamp is more perfect than a blazing lamp, for the glowing lamp has heat that causes harm. And the luminous one is guided by its light without being harmed by its glow.

And God Almighty said to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {So those who believe in him and honor him and support him and follow the light that was sent down with him - those are the successful.} [Al-A'raf: 157].

And God Almighty said: {And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Book or faith is, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will. Of Our servants, and indeed you guide to a straight path} [Al-Shura: 52] (52) {The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. matters} [Al-Shura: 53]

Muslims acknowledge that everyone who followed the religion of Christ, peace be upon him, which was not changed or altered, was guided by Christ from Misguidance, and whoever of the Children of Israel disbelieves in him, then he is misguided, rather an unbeliever, as the Almighty said: {When God said, “O Jesus, indeed I will cause you to die and I will raise you up.” To Me is the one who will purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, so I will judge between you concerning Therein you differed.} [Al Imran:

55] (55) {But as for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.} [Al Imran: 56] (56) {And as for those who believe And they do righteous deeds, and He will give them their rewards in full. And God does not like wrongdoers.} [Al Imran: 57]

And God Almighty said: {O you who have believed, be helpers of God, as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples. “Who are my helpers to God?” The disciples said. We are the helpers of God, so a group of the Children of Israel believed and a group disbelieved, so we supported those who believed against their enemy and they became victorious} [As-Saff: 14] .

And his saying: The sun will rise on the earth, and the lost will be guided by it, and the Children of Israel will go astray from it - fits his saying in the Torah: God came from Sinai rose, rose from Seir, and was revealed from the mountains of Paran. Its rising from Seir is the manifestation of its light in Christ, just as its coming From Mount Sinai: It is the appearance of His light through Moses, and its manifestation from the mountains of Paran is the appearance of His light through Muhammad.
And by these three places God swore in the Qur’an, saying: {And the fig and the olive and Mount Sinai and this trustworthy city} [Al-Tin: 1].

The land of figs and olives is the Holy Land from which the Messiah was sent, and there were prophets of the Children of Israel, and Muhammad was taken captive. May God bless him and grant him peace, and his prophecy was revealed through her. Mount Sinai is the place where God spoke to Moses bin Imran, and this trustworthy city is the land of Mecca from which God sent Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. He greeted him and the Qur’an was revealed to him.

chapters.title: Chapter on his saying that God will dwell with people on earth
paragraphs: [Chapter: His statement that God will dwell with people on earth]

They said: And he said in the third book of Kings: “And now, O Lord God of Israel, let your word to David be fulfilled, for it is true that it should be God will dwell with the people on the earth. Listen, all you peoples, and let the earth listen, and all who are in it, and the Lord will be a witness over it. His holy house, and he will come out of his place and come down and tread on the easts of the earth because of all this sin of the children of Jacob.

It is said that this book needs to be proven that the one who spoke it was a prophet, and that its words were recorded and translated into Arabic. An identical translation, then after that what is said in it is said in similar words of the words they have, and there is nothing in it that indicates its unity. By Christ, because his saying: (God will dwell with the people on earth) does not refer to Christ, since Christ did not dwell with the people on earth,, Rather, when he announced the message, he did not remain on earth except for a short period.

He did not live in a specific place, and before that nothing of the claim to prophecy, let alone divinity, had emerged from him. Then after He was taken up to heaven and did not dwell with people on earth. Also, if they said: His dwelling means his appearance in Christ, peace be upon him, they would be told: As for the possible and reasonable appearance, such as the appearance of His knowledge, love, light, remembrance, and worship, there is no difference between Christ And others.

At that time, there is nothing in this word that indicates that this stillness was in Christ and not anyone else, and if it was in Christ, then this is not one of his characteristics. Peace be upon him, and there is nothing in his appearance in him or the emergence of his knowledge, love, or scientific example that requires his self to be united with him.

As for his saying: (Then the Lord will be a witness over it), it is said, firstly, that God’s witnesses over His servants do not require its solution, or its union with some His creatures. Rather, He is a witness over His servants by their deeds, as He said: {Then God is a witness of what they do} [Yunus: 46].

And the wording of the text: (And let the earth listen, and everyone in it, and the Lord will be a witness over it), and this is as in the Torah: when Moses spoke to the children of Israel is a witness against them, and likewise Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, used to say to his nation when he conveyed the message to the people, saying: “Have I not conveyed the message?” Then they say: Yes, so he says: Oh God, bear witness.

Then this does not affect the fact that Christ is God, and it may also be said: It does not mean that what is meant by the word “Lord” here is God, and the word “Lord” What is meant by it is the obedient master, and he changed the two words. He said there: God will dwell with the people, and he said: And the Lord will be a witness thereof. And the prophets bear witness over their nations, as Christ, peace be upon him, said: “And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them, but when you took me, you were the watcher.” upon them} [Al-Maeda: 117].
And God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger} [Al-Muzzammil: 15].
And God Almighty said: {How then when We bring from every nation a witness and bring you as a witness against these people} [An-Nisa: 41].
And God Almighty said: {And on the Day when We will raise into every nation a witness against them from among themselves, and We will bring you as a witness over these} [An-Nahl: 89].

Then the Lord, the martyr, will be the Messiah, who is humanity, and he is the one who came from the Holy House, and went out from his place, and descended and stepped on foot. On earth because of the sin of the children of Jacob, for when they sinned and changed, God sent to them Christ, peace be upon him, inviting them to worship God alone and obedience to Him, so whoever believes in Him is happy and deserving of reward, and whoever disbelieves in Him is wretched and deserving of punishment.

chapters.title: Chapter on the words of Micah: And you, Bethlehem, a town of Judah, Beth Ephrata, shall bring forth for me a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel
paragraphs: [Chapter: Saying of Micah: And you, O Bethlehem, a town of Judah, Beth Ephrata, a ruler will come out for me, who will shepherd my people Israel]

They said: And the prophet Micah said: “And you, O Bethlehem, town of Judah, Beth Ephratha, a ruler will come out for me who will shepherd my people Israel, and he is from before the world existed, but he does not appear except in the days in which the mother gives birth to him, and his authority extends from the ends of the earth to its furthest reaches).

The answer: Most of what they mention about the prophets, may blessings and peace be upon them, is evidence for them and not for them, just as they mentioned it about Christ. Peace be upon the matter of the trinity, for it is a proof against them, not for them, and thus we have generally contemplated the words of the people of heresy and misguidance as evidence. The Prophets, for if he reflects properly, he will find an argument against them and not for them, for the words of the Prophets, peace and blessings be upon them, are guidance. And clearly, they are infallible and do not speak falsehood.

Whoever uses their words as evidence against falsehood, there must be something in their words to show that they intended the truth and not falsehood, and this is like his saying In this prophecy: (A ruler will come out for me from you), this is clear in that this is the prince of God who is coming out. He is not God, but He A leader who is like all the princes who belong to God, and they are the obedient apostles and prophets, such as: David, Moses, and others.

That is why he said: (He who shepherds my people Israel), and if it were him, he would be the shepherd of his own people. As for his saying: (and he was before To be the world) This is like “the saying of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, in the hadith about the approaching dawn, and it was said to him: O Messenger of God, when did you A prophet?
