He said: “And Adam is between the spirit and the body.” And in another word: When were you written as a prophet? He said: “And Adam is between the soul and the body,” and in the Musnad of Imam Ahmad, on the authority of Al-Irbad bin Sariyah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that He said:

“Indeed, in the sight of God, I am written as the Seal of the Prophets, and indeed Adam is a manger in his clay, and I will inform you of the beginning of my matter. I am the call of my father Abraham. And the good news of Jesus, and the vision of my mother, when she gave birth to me, saw that a light came out of her and illuminated the palaces of the Levant. That he was a prophet, and it is written as a prophet, and Adam is between the spirit and the flesh, and that it is written in the sight of God, the Seal of the Prophets, and Adam is promiscuous in his clay.

What he meant, may God bless him and grant him peace, is that God wrote down his prophecy, revealed it, and mentioned his name, and that is why this was made at that time after the creation of Adam’s body before the soul was breathed into it, just as the newborn’s livelihood, lifespan, and work are written. Whether he was miserable or happy after his body was created, and before Breathing the spirit into him.
And likewise the saying of the one who said about Christ, peace be upon him, that he was before the world existed, for it is written and mentioned before it existed. The world.

It has been proven in the Sahih on the authority of Abdullah bin Amr, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, that he said: “God determined the destinies of the creatures before they He created the heavens and the earth in fifty thousand years, and His throne was upon the water.”

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Imran bin Husayn, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “There was God and nothing existed before Him, and there was His throne is on the water, and He wrote all things in the Qur’an, then He created the heavens and the earth.”

And he said: Before the world existed, and he did not say: He was ancient and eternal with God and did not cease, as the Christians say: He is an attribute of God. eternity, but He specified that by saying:

“Before the world came into being,” and it is not appropriate to say about the Lord of the worlds, “It was before the world came into being.” For He, Glory be to Him, is eternal and eternal, and there is no beginning for His existence, so He cannot be limited to this principle, especially if what is meant is that the world is built on it. With Adam and his descendants, the heavens and the earth may not enter into this world, but rather the Hereafter will be made, and the souls of the believers will be in Paradise in The heavens, and what is meant by this world is the life of this world or the abode of the world.
That is why he said: But he does not appear except in the days in which the mother gives birth to him, just as other prophets appear after she gives birth to him. His mother.

The Mother only gave birth to humanity, and as for divinity, it is, according to them, born of God, ancient and eternal, and if they say, she gave birth to divinity. With humanity, this corruption was known in many ways, and when it is said: Why was Jesus Christ, peace be upon him, singled out for mention? It was said: Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was singled out for mention, because the matter of the Messiah was clearer and greater than those of the prophets before him after him. Moses.

Likewise, the matter of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was clearer and greater than the matter of all the prophets before him, and if the matter was great, it was His appearance in the book is greater.

Some Christians thought that what was meant by that was the existence of the Messiah, which was similar to the belief of a group of extremists who affiliated with Islam and others. Those who say: The essence of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, existed before the creation of Adam, and they say:

He was created from the light of the Lord of the worlds, and he existed before the creation of Adam, and that things were created from him, to the extent that they might say about Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. It is similar to what the Christians say about Christ, to the point that they may make the entire world out of it, and they narrate hadiths about that, all of which are lies, even though these people They do not say that what precedes is theology, but rather they claim the precedence of its reality and itself, and they point to something that has no reality, as the Christians point to Presenting a theology that is united with Him and has no truth.

Among these extremists is the one who narrates on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “Whoever says: I am all human has disbelieved, and whoever says I am not He has disbelieved in good tidings.” “And they use as evidence the Almighty’s saying: {Muhammad is not the father of any of your men} [Al-Ahzab: 40].
They make some of the theology in it similar to that of the Christians.

This hadith is a lie according to the agreement of the scholars of the hadith, and it has been proven from him, may God bless him and grant him peace, in the hadith in the two Sahih books, that He said: “Do not praise me as the Christians praised Jesus, son of Mary, for I am only a servant (so say, ‘Abdullah and His Messenger).”
The Almighty said about him: {Say: Glory be to my Lord. Have I ever been but a human being and a messenger?} [Al-Isra: 93].

This is from the kind of extremists who say: The Lord dwells among the righteous, and speaks on their tongues, and that the one who speaks in one of them is God, not The same, and the saying of these people is similar to what the Christians say about Christ, and one of them says: The monotheist is the monotheist, and they chant: What is the monotheist One from One... since everyone who alone denies the monotheism of the one who speaks about His monotheism... is a shameful thing that the one has nullified by his monotheism... by his monotheism... And we described the one whom Lahid called, and it is of the same type as those who make the human soul ancient and eternal, and they say:

It is an attribute of God, so they make half of man divinity, and half of him humanity, but divinity to them is his spirit, not one divinity as This is what the Christians say, and according to what these people say, along with what the Christians say, there are two theologies in Christ and others like him in whom it is claimed that the unity of divinity is in him: his spirit. Theology, and the word is a second theology, and among these people are those who recite what Al-Hallaj is said to have recited:

Glory be to Him who has revealed His humanity... He has revealed the secret of His penetrating divinity and then made it apparent in His creation... in the form of the eater and the drinker, until His creation has seen it... Like the moment of the eyebrow to the eyebrow, even if it is assumed that his soul is what it was before the world existed, this does not indicate that he is God or an attribute. By God, but if someone who claims that his soul was present at that time says: what is meant is his soul, this is closer to what the Christians say, and in The sentence is what tells about the Messiah, that he was in a position before the world existed among the People of the Book, on the authority of Solomon, that he said:
(I was before the world existed) Then it was established

By the agreement of the creatures that Solomon was not united with divinity, he knew that such a statement does not necessitate divinity being united with it, but rather the Muslims They are just in what they say, and they interpret the words of God in His books one by another, and they make His words confirm one another and not contradict one another.

As for the misguided people among the Christians and others, they prefer what is better than what is better than it, and they deprive the virtuous of his due, and they go to extremes in They deprive the prophets of their rights, such as their disparagement of Solomon. Many Jews and Christians dispute this.
Some of them say: He was a magician, and that he bewitched the jinn with his magic.

Among them are those who say: He fell below the level of prophethood, so they make him a sage and not a prophet, and for this reason God mentioned in the Qur’an the acquittal of Solomon. About that, and that is because Solomon asked God for a kingdom that no one after him should have, so He subjected to Solomon the wind, which flowed freely at his command wherever it He struck down the devils, every builder and diver, and others were bound in shackles, so he subjected to him the wind, its beginning was a month, and its end was a month, and when he asked the The leaders asked them to bring him the throne of Bilqis, Queen of Yemen, and she was in the Levant. He said:

{O eminent ones, which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me submitting} [An-Naml: 38] (38) {An evil from the jinn said, ‘I will bring it to you before That you arise from your position, and indeed, I am strong and trustworthy over him.} [An-Naml: 39] (39) {The one who has knowledge of the Scripture said, ‘I will bring it to you before he backs away.’ Here's your end. When he saw it settled by him, he said, "This is from the bounty of my Lord, that He may test me as to whether I am grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful, it is only for himself." And whoever disbelieves, then indeed my Lord is Self-sufficient, Most Generous} [An-Naml: 40].

When Solomon died, the devils resorted to various kinds of polytheism, so they wrote them down and placed them under his throne, and said: Solomon was subjugating the jinn with this. So this became a temptation for those who believed in that, and they became two sects. One sect knew that this was polytheism and witchcraft, and that it was not permissible, so they challenged it. Solomon, as did many of the People of the Book, Jews and Christians.
And a group said:

Solomon is a prophet, and if he had subjected the jinn to this, this indicates that this is permissible, so they began to say and write some of the sayings in which Polytheism, incantation, and swearing by polytheism and devils - what the devils love and choose, and they help them for that on some demands. humans, either informing them of unseen matters in which they confuse a lot of lies, or the behavior of some people, just as a man is killed or falls ill. Through magic, or the devils stealing some of his money, and other things that involve the devils helping mankind with things that mankind desires. For the sake of mankind’s obedience and their agreement with the devils in what the devils want of disbelief, immorality and disobedience.

Many of them add this to Sulayman and to “Asif bin Barkhiya” and they depict Sulayman’s ring, and they may take the man who came from Their brothers went to places, and they saw him as a person, and they said: This is Solomon, son of David, as something similar happened to the sheikhs we know. Those who were accompanied by demons, and they had satanic supernatural powers similar to those of magicians and soothsayers.

So God Almighty delivered Solomon from the lies of these people, and those who made him subjugate the devils with a kind of polytheism and sorcery. These people wounded him. These people claimed that they were following him, and God Almighty said:

{And they followed what the devils recited to the king of Solomon, and Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved. They teach the people magic and what was revealed to the two angels in Babylon. Harut and Marut, and they did not teach anyone until they had said, “We are only a test, so do not disbelieve.” Then they learned from them what by which they divided people. And his wife, and they are not harmed by him except by God’s leave, and they learn what harms them and does not benefit them, and they know that whoever buys it does not He will have no share in the Hereafter, and evil is that for which they sold their souls, if they only knew.} [Al-Baqarah:
102] (102) {And if they had believed and feared Allah, a reward from Allah would have been better, if they had only known.} [Al-Baqarah: 103]

Many things like this are narrated about some prophets, or some people of knowledge and religion, about matters that are not from God’s law, and some people believe them. people, and it becomes a temptation for two sects who believe in it.
A sect slanders that prophet or righteous man because he is innocent.

And a group says: It follows him in what he says, and this is found in much of what the People of the Book narrate about the prophets, for the Jews You will mention about them what is discredited in their prophecy.

The Christians make this an example for themselves in what they innovate, and this is explained in another place. What is meant here is that the words that were described With it, the Messiah was either described by the prophets before him, or he told it about himself - someone like him exists in the same way as anyone else, and there was no One of them has divinity and humanity, but divinity and humanity are not united, and none of them deserves to be worshiped, prayed to, prostrated, and called as they are. He is called God, and to Him is added what is added to God of creation, resurrection, reward, and punishment. The Messiah, may God’s prayers be upon him, has no supernatural sign except There is something else like it and greater than it, and not a word was said about it, except that it was said about others like it and greater than it, except what the Qur’an has specifically mentioned about it.

chapters.title: Chapter on the words of the Prophet Habakkuk: God appears on earth, mixes with people, and walks with them
paragraphs: [Chapter: The saying of the Prophet Habakkuk: “Indeed, God appears on earth, mixes with people, and walks with them.”]
They said: And the Prophet Habakkuk said: (Indeed, God appears on earth, mixes with people, and walks with them).
The prophet Jeremiah said: (After this, God will appear on earth, and will turn with mankind, and say, “I am God, Lord of lords.”)

The answer is: This requires proving the prophethood of these two, proving the transmission from them, and proving the correct, matching translation. After this, the ruling on this speech will be the ruling on its counterparts. In the Torah, it is not of this type, and this is not proven by Muslim agreement. And the Jews, and Christians - given that God resided in Moses, nor in any other of the prophets of the Children of Israel, but rather His saying:

He appears - in the position of being revealed and appearing, and it was mentioned in the Torah that he was manifested, and appeared to Abraham and other of their prophets. Peace, without the fact that it itself has befallen any of them, and what is in the hearts of the scientific example, and with knowledge of Him, love and remembrance of Him - it is generalized. It is what is used to refer to what is known by itself. So that people know that what is meant is a scientific example.

And what is in the hearts of knowledge and love of what is good is not what is meant by what is good and beloved. If the one who says: You and God are in my heart, Or in the back of my heart, or he said to him: By God, you are still in my heart, and you are still in my eyes, and so on - all the people knew that he did not want himself. So if they see someone mentioning a famous scholar or a famous sheikh, mentioning his knowledge and work, and bringing that person to life among the people - they say: So-and-so has become. It means what is known and mentioned, with us and among us, because the addressees know what is meant.

And one of them says to someone whose father has died: I am your father. That is, he will take his place, and they say to the son who takes his father’s place: Whoever left behind someone like you would not have died, and when they saw Ikrimah, the servant of Ibn Abbas The one who has his knowledge, they say: Ibn Abbas came, and Ibn Abbas is among the people; Because his master is his representative and takes his place, and when the king sends a representative to take his place, they say that such-and-such king comes, because this The representative is in his place, announcing his orders, prohibitions, and conditions.

In the authentic hadith, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, God says: “My servant fell ill and you did not visit me, so the servant says: O Lord, how can I visit you when you Lord of the Worlds, He will say: Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine was sick and you did not visit him? Had you visited him, you would have found Me with him. My servant was hungry and you did not feed me. He will say: O Lord, how can I feed You when You are the Lord of the worlds? He will say: Did you not know that such-and-such servant of Mine was hungry? Had you fed him, you would have found him with Me. My servant, I was thirsty and you did not give me a drink. He will say: My Lord, how? Shall I give you something to drink, and You are the Lord of the worlds? And he says:
Did you not know that My servant asked you for water but you did not provide for him? But had you given it to him, you would have found him with Me.”

So He made His servant’s hunger his hunger, and his sickness his sickness, because the servant agrees with God in what He loves and is pleased with, and He commands and forbids. It is known that the Lord himself does not go hungry, nor is he sick.

It is known that describing it as hunger and illness is further removed from describing it as walking among people and mingling with them, and for this there are many existing counterparts. In the speech of the prophets and non-prophets, whether private or public, and no rational person would understand from that that the essence of what is mentioned is united with the other or It is permissible in it except for those who are ignorant, such as Christians.
People see the sun, the moon, the planets, and other things in clear water, in a clear mirror, and the like.

And one of them says: I saw the face of so-and-so in this mirror, and I saw the sun and the moon in the mirror or in the water, although every rational person knows that the same The sun, the moon, and others are not dissolved either in the mirror or in water, but this is a restricted vision that he saw through the example that was represented In a mirror or water, whether it is a reflected ray or something else, and from this section the speaker said:

If the stream appears clear, and avoids being moved by the breeze, you will see the sky without any obstruction. This is how the sun appears and the stars are like this. Hearts are like this. Lords of manifestation, God Almighty is seen in its clearness. He has told that God is seen in the hearts of those who know, just as the sun and stars are seen in clear water. One of them imagines the image of someone he knows as red, green, or black, and says:

By God, this is so-and-so in his own eyes, even though he and everyone who heard him knew that he was his likeness, identical to his image, not his eye, and that Because that image is similar to his image, he wants this to be a representation that is identical to him and not different from him.

From this is the saying of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Whoever sees me in a dream has truly seen me, for Satan does not appear in my form.” He did not mean that He saw my body, which is in the grave, and my soul, which is in Paradise - a state within itself, for this is impossible for many reasons, so he said: “For Satan does not take my image.”

When a group of companions entered upon Al-Muqawqis, the Christian king of Egypt, and inquired from them about their religion, they informed him of that. The likeness of the great quadrangle was gilded, and in it were small doors. He opened a door and took out from it a black silk cloth with an image in it. White, then there was a tall man with the hairiest of people, and he said: Do you know this? They said: We said no, so he said: This is Adam.

Then he opened another door again, and took out a black silk garment with a white picture on it, and there was a man with a huge head, with hair like the hair of a Nabataeans. His eyes turned red and he said: Do you know this? We said: No, and he said: This is Noah.

Then he opened another door and took out a black silk garment with a white picture on it, and there was a man with a white head and beard, as if he was smiling. He said, “Do you know this?” We said: No. He said: This is Abraham.
Then he opened another door again and took out a black silk garment with a white picture on it. He said: Do you know this? We said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace,
He said: By God, Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, is the Messenger of God.

He said: And God knows that he stood up, then sat down, then said: God is your religion, he is your prophet? We said: God is our religion. He is our Prophet, as if we were looking at him. Then he said: It was the last of the doors, but I hastened it for you so that you might see. What do you have?
Then he repeated, and opened one door after another, saying: This is Moses, this is Aaron, this is David, this is Solomon, this is Jesus.

All of this is so that what is meant becomes clear, and people know what the speaker means, just as it is said to someone whose name is written in a book: This is so-and-so and it is known that What is in the Book is His written name, not Himself that is on the outside. From this point of view is the Almighty’s saying: {And everything they did was in the Book} [Al-Qamar: 52]

The only thing in the Psalms is the mention of their deeds, and the writing of that, and it is said in the writing of documents: This is what so-and-so told the truth, and this is what so-and-so is suing for. And so-and-so, and it is said: This is a mention of what so-and-so has told the truth or what so-and-so has sued against, so the reference is sometimes made to the existing thing, and sometimes to its mention.
It is known that what is present in the book is its remembrance, not its essence, but rather the presence of the script in the minds that corresponds to its verbal remembrance.

A thing has existence in objects, existence in minds, existence in the tongue, existence in buildings, concrete existence, and scientific existence. And formal, and verbal, and in each of the four it is mentioned, and referred to with clues and pronouns that sometimes show that what is being referred to is The line that matches the word, and sometimes the reference is to the word that matches the meaning.

It is known that the meaning that is in the heart is closer to what is on the outside than speech and handwriting, so if what is in the heart of the knower is referred to with the eye of the knower The one who loves him and remembers him, because he is known and beloved, is especially close, and remembrance, knowledge, and love may prevail over The heart until its existence is absent from its presence, and its knowledge is absent from its knowledge, and its remembrance is absent from its remembrance until someone says about this The case: Glory be to Me, or there is no one in this robe but God.

It is known that the essence of God, Blessed and Most High, is not the one in his heart, but rather in his heart is his scientific ideal, his knowledge, and his love, so he disappeared. This is what he said about himself. Even if this was said by someone who was mistaken, then someone who is not mistaken would say:

God is in the heart of so-and-so, and so-and-so has no one but God, and whoever wants God should go to so-and-so. They do not mean that God is in his heart, but rather His scientific example, his knowledge, his remembrance, and his love, and that he worships none but God, and hopes for none but Him, and fears none but Him, and does not work Except for God, and he only commands obedience to Him, so his worship is consumed from the worship of anything else, and his obedience is from the obedience of anything else. And by loving Him more than loving anything else.
What was said about Christ, peace be upon him, and others like him are true, but Christ had no jurisdiction over this.

If such words are often found in the words of the prophets and others, rather it is well known in their words, and it is never found on anyone who The Prophets is that He placed the essence of God in the heart of one of the human beings. It is known that the Christians abandoned the decisive words of the Prophets, peace be upon them, and adhered to By the resemblance is like their misguidance, so what is known in the hearts and that which is mentioned in the tongues became suspicious of what is in itself, so they thought The same scientific ideal is the concrete thing, as many mistaken people think, and these people sometimes say that it is permissible. And by uniting others, and they do not differentiate between the solutions of faith, knowledge, love, and the scientific ideal in the heart, and the solutions of the known self. The beloved.

That is why many of these people believe that they are speaking to God, and He is speaking to them, and one of them says: He stopped me, and he told me, and I told him. Addressing him and conversing with him with this scientific example is according to the belief they have in God Almighty, and many of them take He has Satan and says: I am your Lord, so he addresses him and thinks that he is his Lord, but he is Satan.
Among them: whoever sees a throne with light on it, or sees what he thinks is angels and they are devils, and that is Satan.

Many of these people think that they are better than the prophets, and that they enter God without permission, contrary to the prophets, and that is The god he believes in is Satan, and for those for whom Satan does not appear, Satan speaks to one of them from his heart, and that image speaks to him. Scientific knowledge, and he believes that it speaks to him, and he thinks that this is the truth speaking to him.

This is like a man who remembers some of his companions and represents them in his heart and addresses them as he would address someone who rebukes him or apologizes to him, and appreciates the speech of That picture, and he says: I told you such-and-such, and you told me such-and-such.

The same person does not speak to him or hear his words, but rather he is an example, just as he may depict the image of a human being and the human being addresses it, and appreciates This is to address the owner of the photo.

Christians are more involved in this than others, for they address the images represented in churches, such as the image of Mary, Christ, and the saints. And they say: We only go to address the people of those images and seek their intercession.

This is what God forbade on the tongues of all the prophets, and He did not legislate for anyone to call upon the angels, nor the prophets, nor the righteous dead. So what about the images that represent them, as has been explained in another place.

What is meant here is that there is often mention of the appearance of God Almighty in the words of the people, the prophets and others, and what is meant by that is His appearance. In the hearts of His servants with knowledge, love, and remembrance.

For this reason, when he meant mentioning his name by mentioning the one named, he began to say - whoever says that the name is the name - that what is intended by the name is It is what is named, not that the word itself is what is named, for this is not what a rational person would say, and exalting the name and glorifying it is glorifying what is named and glorifying it. For him.
As the Almighty said: {Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High} [Al-Ala: 1], and He said: {So glorify the name of your Lord, the Great} [Al-Waqi’ah: 74].
And he said: {Blessed is the name of your Lord, Possessor of Majesty and Honor} [Al-Rahman: 78].

It was stated in the hadith: “The Resurrection will not take place until a name for God is not worshiped,” meaning that God is not worshiped by one of His names, for if it is said: I called God and I worshiped Him, for in the word the word is only the name, and what is meant is what is called.

This is what we mentioned as an explanation for the appearance of divinity in Christ and others, that what is meant is the appearance of what is in the hearts of the oneness of God. Knowing Him, His love, His remembrance, His light, His guidance, and His spirit - this is what many Christian scholars explain. The union of divinity and humanity with the appearance of divinity in him is like the appearance of the engraving of a signet in wax and clay.
It is known that the situation in wax and clay is an example of the engraving of a ring, not that there is any part of the ring in the wax and clay, but rather an inscription appears in it. The ring.

Likewise, the light and spirit of God appear in the prophets and the righteous, and this meaning is not specific to Christ, peace be upon him, but rather he is involved. In him and the rest of the messengers, and indeed every believer has a share of this according to his faith.

chapters.title: Chapter on what the prophet Isaiah said: “Behold, the virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and his name will be called Emmanuel.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: The words of the prophet Isaiah: Behold, the virgin will conceive and bear a son, and his name will be called Emmanuel]
They said: And the prophet Isaiah said: (Behold, the virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and his name will be called Immanuel).
Immanuel: a Hebrew word that is interpreted in Arabic (our God is with us). The Prophet testified that Mary gave birth to the divinity united with humanity. Both.

(It is said: This speech does not mean that Mary gave birth to the divinity united with humanity), and that she gave birth to the Creator of the heavens and the earth, but rather this The words indicate that the newborn is not the Creator of the heavens and the earth, for He said: She will give birth to a son.

This is indefinite in proving it, just as it is said about other women: So-and-so gave birth to a son, and this is evidence that he is one of the sons, not he. Creator of the heavens and the earths, then he said: And his name will be called (Emmanuel), thereby indicating that this is a name given to him, and he will be called by it as people are called. Their children by proper names, or the characteristics by which they call them.
Among those names are some that are improvised. They improvised.

Some of them are a sentence that they speak, and for this reason many of the People of the Book name his son Emmanuel, and then some of them say: The Virgin. What is meant by it is anything other than Mary, and they mention in that a story that happened.

And among them are those who say: Rather, what is meant by it is Mary, and according to this assessment, what is meant is one of two meanings: Either he means that our God is with us. With victory and assistance, for the children of Israel had been failed because of their change, so when Christ, peace be upon him, was sent in truth, God was with those who He followed Christ, and Christ himself did not remain with them, but was raised to heaven, but God was with those who followed him with victory and assistance.
As God Almighty said: {So We supported those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious} [As-Saff: 14].
And God Almighty said: {And I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection} [Al Imran: 55]

This is more apparent, or (it will be) that Christ will be called a god, as they say: He will be called Moses, the god of Pharaoh, that is, he is the one who commands, forbids, and has authority. On him.

Some of them distorted the meaning of this word, and said: It means: God is with us, and he said: Whoever of their scholars responds to them, it will be said to them: Is this it? Is it the one who says: I am the Lord, there is no God besides me? I die and I make alive. Or is it he who says to God: You are the only true God and you sent Jesus? Christ?

If the first is false, and the second is what the Gospel testified to, then the Gospel must be believed, and those who wrote in the Gospel must be disbelieved. (Emmanuel) and its interpretation - (God is with us), rather the interpretation of Emmanuel (with us is a God), and Christ is not specific to this name, but rather Emmanuel is a name It is called by Christians, and Jews by Christians.
This is found in our time, among the People of the Book, whom his father named Emmanuel, meaning (the Honorable of Destiny), and likewise the Syriacs, most of them. They name their children Emmanuel.

I said: It is known that God is with the pious, the doers of good, and the just, with guidance, victory, and assistance, and it is said to the man in supplication: God With you, if a man is named by saying: (God is with you) this is a blessing in the meaning of this name, and if it is said that Christ was named God with us or Our God is with us, and so on - this was evidence that God is with those who follow Christ and believe in Him, so God will be their guide, helper, and helper.

chapters.title: A chapter on the words of Isaiah giving good tidings to the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: In the words of Isaiah there is good news about the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.]

They said: And Isaiah also said: A boy has been born to us, and a son to us has been given to him, whose government is on his shoulders and between his shoulders, and his name will be called King. Great is his walk, a wondrous ruler, a strong and authoritative God, the prince of peace throughout all ages, and his authority is complete and has no end.

It is said: There is no clear indication in this good news that what is meant by it is the Messiah, peace be upon him, even if what is meant by it is the Messiah, it does not indicate What they are seeking. It may even be said that what is meant by it is Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, for he is the one whose leadership is upon his shoulders, and between his shoulders from two sides: from In the direction of the seal of prophecy on one of his shoulders, which is one of the signs of prophecy that was told by the prophets, and a sign of their seal.

On the one hand, he was sent with the sword that he drapes over his shoulder and raises it to his shoulder when he strikes with it, and this is indicated by his saying: (an authoritative leader with strong integrity).

This is the characteristic of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, Al-Mu’ayyad Al-Mansour Al-Muslim, the Leader of Peace, for his religion is Islam, and whoever follows him will be safe from The shame of this world and the torment of the hereafter, and from his enemy taking control of him.

Christ, peace be upon him, was not empowered over his enemies, as Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was empowered. Rather, his enemies were able to crucify him. According to the Christians, they crucified him, and according to the Muslims, God cast his likeness on someone else, so the one who looked like him was crucified. In this way, God removed the crucifixion. Not by conquering his enemies, destroying them, or humiliating them before him, just as God gave victory to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, over his enemies.

He said: (In all ages, His dominion is complete and has no end), and this is the characteristic of the Seal of the Messengers, after whom no prophet will come to abrogate His law. His authority, with proof and hand, is complete and does not require the assistance of any other law, and his law is fixed and will remain until the end of time.

chapters.title: Chapter of Isaiah’s words: In it will dwell the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of God, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of cunning and power, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of God
paragraphs: [Chapter: The words of Isaiah: And the Holy Spirit will dwell in him, the Spirit of God, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of cunning and might, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of God]

They said: And Isaiah also said: His staff will come out of the house of Jesse, and light will grow from it, and the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of God, the Spirit of wisdom, will dwell within it. And understanding, the spirit of resourcefulness and strength, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of God.
And in those days the root of Jesse will be a sign to the nations, and they will believe in him and put their trust in him, and they will have the crown and honor forever. (of the ages).

The answer: This speech, after demanding the authenticity of its transmission from the Prophet, and the correct translation of it in the Arabic language, is evidence for Christians do not, for it does not indicate that Christ is the creator of the heavens and the earth. Rather, it indicates, as the Qur’an indicates, that Christ He, peace be upon him, was supported by the Holy Spirit, for he said:

And the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of God, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of cunning and power, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of God will dwell in him. He did not say it is permissible In him is the life of God - in addition to saying that God dwelt in him or was united with him, but he made the Holy Spirit the Spirit of God, which is the spirit of wisdom and understanding. And knowledge, which is the spirit of resourcefulness and power.
Just as they have it in the Torah (Indeed, among those who worked during the dome of time was the spirit of wisdom, the spirit of understanding, the spirit of knowledge).
It is what leads to guidance and victory, as God Almighty said: {And remember Our servants Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of hands and eyes} [p. 45] .
He said: It is the spirit of God, and this is like the Almighty’s saying: “Those are He who wrote in their hearts faith and supported them with a spirit from Him” [Al-Mujadila: 22].

And God Almighty says: {And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Scripture or faith is, but We have made it a light by which we guide whomever. We choose from among Our servants} [Al-Shura: 52].
And God Almighty said: {He sends down the angels with the Spirit at His command} [An-Nahl: 2].
What He sent down is called the guidance of God, the spirit of God, the revelation of God, the light of God, and the like.

And God Almighty said, when He mentioned His prophets among the descendants of Abraham, and He said: {And among his descendants are David, and Solomon, and Job, and Joseph, and Moses, and Aaron. And thus do We reward the doers of good.} [Al-An’am: 84] (84) {And Zachariah, and John, and Jesus, and Elijah, each of the righteous} [Al-An’am: 85] (85) {And Ishmael. And Elisha, and Yunus, and Lot, and each of them We have favored over the worlds} [Al-An’am: 86] (86) {And from their fathers and their descendants and their brothers, and We chose them and guided them to A straight path} [Al-An’am: 87] (87) {This is the guidance of God; He guides thereby whomsoever He wills from among His servants} [Al-An’am: 88].
And God Almighty said: {Then when guidance comes to you from Me, then whoever follows My guidance will never go astray, nor will he be miserable.} [Ta-ha: 123].

And he called it the Light of God, as God Almighty says: {Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is like a niche in which is a lamp. The lamp is in a bottle. The bottle It is as if it were a pearly star kindled from a blessed tree, an olive tree neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost shine even if no fire touched it. Light: God guides to His light whom He wills, and God sets forth parables for people, and God is All-Knowing of all things. [An-Nour: 35]

This is the guidance of God, and the light of God is the Spirit of God, as the Almighty said: {And thus have We revealed to you a spirit of Our command. You did not know what the Book was. Nor faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whomsoever We will of Our servants} [Al-Shura: 52].
And God Almighty said: {Those are He who wrote in their hearts faith and sustained them with a spirit from Him} [Al-Mujadila: 22].

chapters.title: The chapter on Isaiah’s statement, one of the most amazing marvels, is that the Lord of angels will be born from humans
paragraphs: [Chapter: Isaiah’s statement is one of the most amazing of miracles that the Lord of angels will be born of humans]
They said: Isaiah also said: “Among the most wondrous of miracles is that the Lord of the angels will be born of humans.”

It is said: Such a speech must have a speech before it and a speech after it, and it is transferred from one language to another, and we know Certainly, he did not want the Lord of the worlds to be born from humans, and if he had wanted that, he would not have only said, “Lord of the angels,” for God is the Lord of everything, but He may want to be born of mankind who will be the master of the angels, whom the angels will serve and honor, just as the angels prostrated themselves to the father of mankind, Adam.

Christians acknowledge that divinity is not generated by humans, but rather what is generated from humans is humanity, and not He is the Lord of the worlds. By agreement, it is known that they have no argument on the surface of the word if it is assumed that it is safe from change.

A parallel to this is what they have in the Gospel of Matthew: “The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will gather all the kings as Lord over the nations, and they will meet them.” In the furnace of fire) Some scholars of the People of the Book said: This does not mean that Christ is the Lord of lords, nor that He is the Creator of the angels, but rather the Lord The angels commanded the angels to protect Christ based on the testimony of the Prophet, who said: (Indeed, God commands his angels about you to protect you).

Then the testimony of (Luke) that God sent him an angel from heaven to strengthen him, saying: “And when the Gospel testified by the agreement of the prophets and apostles, That God commands Christ to his angels, so they protect him. It is known that the angels obey Christ by command, and he and the angels are in the service of the Lord. "
Christ said to his disciples: “Whoever welcomes you welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes him who sent me.”
Christ said: “Whoever denies Me before men, I will deny him before the angels of God.”

And he said to him who smote the servant of the high priest, “Sheath your sword, and do not think that I will not be able to call upon God the Father, and he will give me more than Twelve choirs of angels.”

chapters.title: A chapter on responding to their words, and such sayings in the books of God revealed to the mouths of the prophets and messengers are many things
paragraphs: [Chapter: Responding to what they say, and there are many things like this in the books of God revealed on the mouths of the prophets and messengers]

They said: And such a saying is in the Books of God revealed on the mouths of the prophets and messengers - a lot of things according to all the different Christians. Their tongues were dispersed into seven regions of the world, adhering to the religion of Christianity - one word and one text, according to what they received from The disciples, when they warned them and turned them away from the worship of idols to the knowledge of God Almighty, they delivered it to them, each nation with its own language, and it is according to Its form continues to this day.

The answer to this is in a number of ways: One of them is that the statement is in all the texts they mention, as mentioned above, and whoever spoke has spoken about this. He was among the Christian scholars whom God guided, and they explained what had occurred in that of their distortion of the meanings of the books that they had, and they mentioned of what They have clear texts that the Messiah, the servant of God, is not God - which shows the falsehood of their statement, and that they are among those who abandoned the decisive of the verses and they followed the similar ones, and for this reason God revealed concerning them:

{But as for those in whose hearts there is deviation, they follow that which is similar, seeking temptation and seeking its interpretation, and no one knows its interpretation except Allah. And those who are firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it. It is all from our Lord.” But none remember except those of understanding.} [Al Imran: 7].

This is like the words of Christ - peace be upon him - when he was asked about the knowledge of the Hour, and he said: (Neither man nor the angels in heaven nor the Son know it. Except the father only.) So he denied knowledge of the Hour, and this indicates two things:

Given that the name of the Son applies to humanity and not to divinity, the divinity cannot be denied the knowledge of the present time, and it indicates that the Son was not He knows what God knows, and this invalidates their statement about unity, for if union were true as they claim, the son would know what God knows him, and He is able to do what He is able to do, for he is God to them, and humanity is not distinguished from divinity in their view in what is described by it. Christ is all-knowing and able to give life and cause death.

And Christ said to his disciples: (Believe in God and believe in me) and he also said: (Whoever believes in me believes not only in me but in him who sent me), and they They remember that Christ - peace be upon him - cried out to God, saying: (My God, my God, see why you have forsaken me and turned away from my salvation).

The second aspect: Their saying: These are the books that are in their hands from the Torah and the Gospel, and all the other prophecies. They received it from the disciples, each nation with its own language, and it is in its own form - a saying for which they did not establish evidence for its authenticity, but rather claimed it as an abstract claim.

Such a transmission, if it is not proven by transmission, cannot be used as evidence in scientific issues, especially when it is said in the third aspect: This An apparent lie, for many tongues do not have an ancient Bible among their people, and among that is the tongue of the Arabs, for the Christian Arabs are many. Before Islam, you do not know the Torah, the Gospel, or the Arabic prophecies, except for the Arabized versions of the Hebrew, Romans, and Syriac. And we ask them for these books that are in Arabic at the time of the Apostles. Where are they? And who saw it?
Even if it was assumed that it was in Arabic,

These Arabic copies today that are in the hands of people are Arabized from what is in their hands, and then their authenticity is not known if they are not known. The validity of the translation, and it is proven that it was transmitted from Christ, peace be upon him, and this is the saying in all tongues.

The fourth aspect: The Torah and the prophecies that were transferred from Jewish copies and the Gospels are four books after Christ, peace be upon him. Two of those who wrote it had not seen Christ, namely Luke and Mark, and two had seen Him, namely John and Matthew.

The number of copies was only transmitted by four people, and what was transmitted by the four people does not have to be known and frequent. If the tongues are many, With it, after the four, because those who heard it from Christ, peace be upon him, spoke with seventy-two tongues, for this is not what he said. One, and no rational person would say that, since the disciples were twelve and not seventy-two, so if it is said: It was transmitted by seventy-two, They transmitted it from the disciples who transmitted it to them, and they only attribute its transmission to four.

The fifth aspect: that the disciples are not infallible, but rather it is permissible for one of them to make mistakes in some of what he transmits, and what is transmitted of their miracles. For customs, some people deny it, and some believe it, and there is no indication in it of their infallibility, unless it is proven that they claimed prophethood. And they performed miracles that indicated their prophecy, but this was not the case. Otherwise, the righteous are righteous if they have miracles that do not indicate Their dignity is that they are infallible like the prophets. Rather, it is permissible for them to make mistakes even though their dignity is proven.
The disciples, according to them, are not prophets, and if they call them messengers, then they are messengers of Christ, not messengers of God, Blessed and Most High.

The sixth aspect: That in these books that are in their hands there are many clear sayings that contradict their statement, which are more and clearer. From what they used as evidence for what they said.
It is then necessary to adhere to what is clear and precise, and return what is similar to it. It is not permissible to adhere to what is similar, and return what is decisive to it.
The seventh aspect: It is destined that there should be on earth these books in seventy-two languages, all of them transmitted from The disciples are quoted correctly,
Or most of it was transferred or most of it was translated from one language to another.

It is known that every language has several versions, even if there is only one language, despite the many copies of it in the east and west of the earth, No one could be certain that all versions are of one word and one text, as these people claimed in the Seventy-Two Languages, where They said:

(And there are many sayings like this in the books of God revealed on the mouths of the prophets and messengers, according to all the different Christians. Their tongues were dispersed in seven regions of the world, adhering to the religion of Christianity - one word and one text based on what they received from The disciples, and they turned them away from the worship of idols, so they handed them over to each nation with its own language, and it remains in its form to this day.)

This speech includes several claims in which there is nothing that the person who said it could be aware of, so it is known that these people spoke these words. Without knowledge, but through ignorance and misguidance, as is their custom, for it is said to them: Who has collected every copy in the world of all the Torah? The Gospel, the Psalms, and all the twenty-four prophecies are in one language, like the Arabic, for example. Did he distinguish all the versions and did not find a copy? More than one copy or less than that?

It is known that if this were possible, it could be said: someone combined it together and changed some of its words, so they cannot claim that it remained without Change, and if that is not possible, no one can say: I know the agreement of each copy of these books with every copy that exists. In seven regions of the world with that tongue, in addition to seventy-two tongues, in addition to it being said: I know that these tongues All of them were spoken by the apostles, and they remain in their word to this day.

It is known that if a person is able to collect copies of one book from all the arts, including books on medicine, arithmetic, engineering, and grammar, And jurisprudence and hadith. The possibility of changing some of the words of those versions was easier for them than replacing the words of each version with the words of those versions. Like her.

This is not usually possible, but rather it is impossible or difficult, especially when the interview is between two people, each of whom conveys For the other, he pronounced his version, so the focus of the interview is on one piece of news, not linked to his story by which it is known to be true. He may make a mistake or They all lie.

And if it is among a number through whom knowledge is acquired, then each version in every language needs to be witnessed by a plural through whom knowledge is acquired, with its wording. And those with their own eyes bear witness to the utterance of every version in every tongue, and they bear witness to the utterance of every version, and He who is bears witness to them. Like them in the wording of the other version (and agreeing with it, and these or like them in agreeing with the second version).

It is known that no one has done this, and no one can do it. Rather, if all the Christian kings had gathered on that (and the scholars of their countries on That) they were not able to do it, for some of the abrogations are among the Muslims, and some of them are in countries over which they have no rule, and also they were lost. There will be copies in their country unless their owners authenticate them.

Every Christian and others who testified that every copy of these books in the world agrees with all versions is a false witness who testifies to something that is not He knows, but he testified to what he knew that he was lying about it.

Likewise, if he testified like this, any book would be abrogated, because the well-known custom is that the abrogation of books differs, and some add more. Some of them are missing, and the Qur’an that was transmitted with frequent transmission did not rely on copying copies of the Qur’an, but rather on the memorization of the people of The frequency of it in their hearts.

For this reason, if a Qur’an is found that is inconsistent with people’s memorization, they will correct it, and there may be a mistake in some copies of the Qur’an, so no attention should be paid to it even though the Qur’an Which were written by the Companions. People recorded the form and drawing of the calligraphy, and this also became transmitted through the Mutawatir, so they transmitted through the Mutawatir the wording of the Qur’an. Preservation, and they also transferred the drawing of the Qur’an repeatedly.

We do not claim that all versions of the Qur’an agree, just as we do not claim that everyone who memorizes the Qur’an does not make mistakes. Rather, its words are transmitted through transmission. memorized and prescribed, so whoever deviates from that, the people know that he has made a mistake because he contravened the frequent transmission, other than these books, for the Christians did not They memorize it all in their hearts after receiving it from the disciples in a way that was transmitted by transmission through transmission. Rather, none of them memorized it all, let alone That all of it is memorized by the people of the Mutawatir, as well as that every tongue of it is memorized by those with whom that language was transmitted.

This is a matter known to all Christians and others, that he did not memorize it all in every tongue from the time of the disciples, as many times as the number of times. A long time ago, but after the spread of Christians, their number, and their dispersion in the seven regions, there was hardly anyone among them who had memorized them. It is all from his heart, just as the children of the Muslim schools memorize the Qur’an, so how can the people of Tawar memorize it at all times? So how do each of the seventy-two people of the Tawaatir tongues memorize each tongue?

And if their reliance is only on the books, and they are not able to know the agreement of all versions in one language, let alone all Tongues, know that their claim is that they still agree on one text and one word, and that all their versions agree in this time, And what came before it - he spoke with a risky speech without knowledge, but rather he spoke what he knew was false.

The eighth aspect: If this is estimated to be possible, then it would only be transmitted if it was not known that it was a lie, so how about knowing that it is a lie? In this era, there are different and contradictory versions of the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the prophecies.

The versions that the Christians have are different, and they also differ from the versions of the Jews and Samaria in places. At that time, if the Christians said: We abrogated It is the correct one - this was not the first time the Jews said: Our versions are the correct ones.

Rather, it is known that the Jews’ care for the Torah is greater than the Christians’ care. (Then after this, what they mentioned is not enough if it is not known that Their versions agree with the versions among the Jews as far as Samaria, and this is unknown.)

And if they say: If the Jewish narration contradicts the narration of the Apostles - no attention will be paid to it because they are infallible. All of this is based on the claim of their infallibility, and its corruption is known. And if the Christians say: We quote it from the infallible disciples, The Jews said:

We transmit it from the infallible Moses, according to the agreement of the people of religion, or from the infallible gnostic, according to the agreement of the Jews and Christians, and many Muslims, for the Torah, by agreement of creation, is taken from Moses ibn Imran, and he is infallible. He only challenges those who challenge the transmission of some of it. Because of the cessation of continuity during the period when the Holy House was destroyed, and no resident remained there for more than seventy years, some people say: Some of its words were changed at that time, and some of them say:
The wording of all versions was not changed, but the wording of some versions was changed, and the changed versions spread among many people so that they did not know Change it.

Then the children of Israel did not cease to exist among them, prophet after prophet, until the Messiah came, and after the Messiah, they did not cease to exist many creatures that could not Their collusion in the east and west of the earth to change the versions of the Torah, in contrast to the Gospel, for it was only transmitted by four people, and whoever wrote The Torah, the Psalms, and the prophecies are among the followers of Christ, but they wrote them from copies that were in the hands of the Jews.

And if they say: They were infallible, then this is forbidden among Muslims and Jews, and if it is accepted, the Jews transmit it as well. On the authority of the infallible before these people, so it is not possible for anyone to claim that the prophecies of the Christians that were narrated on behalf of the infallible are greater than It has been repeated among the Jews, and even wise and just people do not doubt that transmitting the letters of the Torah is more correct than transmitting the letters of the Gospel.

This matter is known from several aspects, as the Torah was taken from the infallible by the agreement of the people of the religion, and it was transmitted before Christ among The prophets and the Children of Israel were the greatest transmitters of the Gospel, and after Christ the Jews and Christians transmitted it.

And if that was the case, then if there were found abrogations of the prophecies among the Jews and Samaria that differed from what the Christians had in some wording - it would be This is evidence that the words of these books are not copied from a single text, and that not every word of them is repeated, by God. I know.

The ninth aspect: that all the authentic texts they have do not indicate their doctrine at all in text, but rather the goal of what they claim to be apparent is. They are disputing about this to the extent that it is said: Rather, what they are using as evidence is apparently contrary to what they say.

It is known that the foundations of faith in which people of faith believe and declare disbelief to those who violate them must be known to them about... The prophets, and knowledge is not achieved with a possible word, so it is known that they have no knowledge of the prophets, peace be upon them, and this is the subject of the dispute.

The tenth aspect: The most clear statement of what they have regarding the Trinity is his saying: (Baptize people in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit), and based on this They based their statement on the Trinity, and established that God has three persons.

The word hypostases was not uttered by any of the prophets, nor by any of the disciples, according to their agreement. Rather, it is something they invented. It was said: It is A Roman word that means: the origin, then the hypostasis of the Son. Sometimes they say: “It is the knowledge of God,” and sometimes they say: “It is the wisdom of God,” and sometimes They say: “It is the word of God,” and sometimes they say: “It is the utterance of God.”
And the Holy Spirit, sometimes they say: “He is the life of God,” and sometimes they say: “He is the power of God.”

And the books transmitted by their prophets do not contain any name of the attributes of God, neither in the name of the Son nor in the name of the Holy Spirit, so there is no That one of the prophets called the knowledge, wisdom, and words of God - the Son, and did not call the life or power of God the Holy Spirit, but rather the Holy Spirit in The words of the prophets are intended to mean something that is not the life of God, as is meant by the kingdom of God or what He sends down in the hearts of the prophets and the righteous. His guidance, light, and support, and so on.
If that is the case, then it is known that what they interpreted as the saying of Christ, peace be upon him:

(Baptize people in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit) - a clear lie about it, and this is also how they interpreted the words of the prophets regarding the confirmation of the hypostases. The three are an outright lie against them, just as they said, “The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob,” by which they intended to prove three gods. For this Of what is known of necessity is their misguidance regarding it and their slander against the prophets, and it is known that the God of the three is one God, not the God of Abraham. A god other than the God of Isaac, even if it is said about the hypostases, so no rational person would say:
One of the hypostases is the God of this, and the other hypostasis is the God of the other, so this

None of the wise people said this, neither the Christians, nor anyone else. They do not say: The father is the God of Abraham, for example, and the Son is the God of Isaac, and the Holy Spirit. The God of Jacob. Rather, they agree with their statement of the Trinity that all are one God for all messengers. This God is not a hypostasis or a God. The other is another hypostasis, so it is known that what they interpret the words of the prophets with is a lie, and it is not valid, neither their trinity that they invented, nor the saying of the people of Monotheists who follow the Messengers of God Almighty.

chapters.title: Detailing the opinion of the Christians regarding the Jews’ lack of belief in Christ, despite the prophecies mentioned by them about his appearance
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Christians’ opinion regarding the Jews’ lack of belief in Christ, despite the prophecies mentioned to them about his appearance.]

The narrator said about them: So I said to them: If these prophecies are among the Jews, and they acknowledge and acknowledge that they are true, and that they It will be fulfilled at the coming of Christ. What argument will they have for believing in Him?
They answered, saying:

God chose the children of Israel and chose them among the people as His own people at that time, and while they were in the land of Egypt in servitude to Pharaoh, he sent To them, Moses the Prophet guided them to the knowledge of God, and promised them that God would save them from the slavery of Pharaoh, bring them out of Egypt, and show them the land of The appointed time, which is the land of the Holy House. So Moses asked God, and he did wonders before their eyes, and he struck the people of Egypt with ten plagues, and they They will all see it, and they know that God is doing it for them. And he brought them out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and divided the sea for them, and brought them in. And the water became a wall for them on their right and a wall on their left, and Pharaoh and all his soldiers entered the sea, and the children of Israel They see that when Moses and the children of Israel emerged from the sea, and Pharaoh succeeded them with his soldiers in it - God commanded Moses to return his staff. To the water, and the water returned to how it was, and Pharaoh and all his soldiers drowned in the sea, and the children of Israel witnessed that.

When Moses departed from them to the mountain to commune with his Lord, and he received for them the Torah from the hand of God, they abandoned the worship of God and forgot all of His deeds. And they disbelieved in him and worshiped the head of the calf after that, then they worshiped idols many times, not just once, and they sacrificed to them sacrifices not animals, but rather their sons and daughters, as was mentioned before, and all their deeds are written in the records of the children of Israel. And when he saw God hardened their hearts and hardened their necks and their disbelief in Him, and when He saw their unclean and wicked deeds, He became angry with them and made them detestable. And He has sealed their hearts so that they will not believe, and He has made them disgraced among all nations, and they will have neither king nor country nor prophet nor priest forever. Just as the prophets prophesied against them, as we mentioned before, and to which their books that are in their hands bear witness to this day.

Thus God said to Isaiah: “Go to this people and tell them: ‘You hear with hearing but do not understand; they look at you but do not see. For the heart of this people has become hardened, and they have heard grievously with their understanding, and they have closed their eyes so that they might not see them, and they have heard With their ears, and they do not understand with their hearts, but they return to Me, and I will have mercy on them.)

And Isaiah said: “God said, ‘Thus my soul hates your sabbaths, and the beginnings of your new moons have become an abomination to me.’ And he said, ‘And in that day he says God: I will abolish all the sabbaths and feasts and give you a new year, chosen, not like the year that I gave to Moses my servant (the day of Horeb). A great multitude, but a new chosen year which he commanded and brought out of Zion. Zion is Jerusalem, and the new chosen year:

This is the Sunnah that we Christians received from the hands of the pure Apostles of the Apostles who left Jerusalem and traveled around the world in seven days. regions of the world and warned of this new year. What statement can be clearer and more correct than this statement, since we have cited it from the word of God, especially from our Jewish enemies? Those who oppose our religion have testified to us that all of this is true.

As for the Jews’ argument for these prophecies, they say and believe that they are true, and that it is the word of God, but they say: It is coming. (For these prophecies are just as they are with the Jews, so they are with us, the Christians, in seventy-two languages, so that all the nations will see them.) One word, and that it is the word of God, and the Jews said, “We believe in it,” to be completed and completed at the coming of the Messiah, but the Messiah did not He is yet to come, and the one who came is not the Christ. This is what they say, and it is enough for them that they disbelieve and commit ungodliness along with disbelief, and they say:

Indeed, the Messiah was lost and led astray, but as for the true Messiah, he is about to come and fulfill the prophecies of the prophets when he comes, and when he comes we will follow him. We were his supporters, and this is their opinion and belief in the Lord Christ. What could be greater than this disbelief upon which they are?

And because of (that in this Book He called them the One with whom He was angry, because of) their disagreement with the word of God, whose utterance He sent upon the mouths of the prophets. And since we Christians were adhering to what the pure messengers commanded us to do, we mentioned it in this book that was bestowed upon them, and as for our saying about God: Three Persons of One God, for God spoke it and made it clear in the Torah, and in the books of the Prophets, and from that is what came in the Book. The first of the Torah says: (Where God willed to create Adam, He said:

Let us create a creation in our likeness and likeness. Who is there in His likeness and likeness except His Word and His Holy Spirit? And when Adam disobeyed and disobeyed his Lord (Behold, Adam has become like one of us.)

(This is clear that God said this saying to His Son, that is, His Word and His Holy Spirit, and He said this saying to mock Adam, that is, He asked that He will become like one of us. He became naked and exposed.
And God said when He destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, He said in the Torah: (And the Lord rained down from the sky fire and brimstone on Sodom and Gomorrah),
He thus explained the lordship of the Father and the Son by mentioning a third.

The answer: It is to be said that all the Jews disbelieved when the Messiah, peace be upon him, was sent to them, and they did not believe in him, and those of them who disbelieved before disbelieved. That is, either by killing the prophets, or by denying them, or by polytheism, or by something else in which they disbelieved in what God revealed - this is true.

This is the counterpart of the disbelief of all Christians to whom the call of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, reached them. They believe in it, and those of them who disbelieved before that disbelieved in what God revealed, either by denying some of what He revealed, or by replacing it with something else. Either by making what God did not reveal as a revelation of his own, or by anything other than that, which involves disbelief in what God Almighty has revealed.

Likewise, what was mentioned about God establishing a new law and a new covenant, which is what Christ, peace be upon him, was sent with from the law with which he was sent. It contains the permissibility of some of what God has forbidden in the Torah, as He said in the Qur’an about the Messiah: “And to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you” [Al Imran: 50].
This too is true.

chapters.title: The chapter on responding to them in their statement: The chosen new year is the year that we received from the hands of the pure messengers
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to them in their saying: The chosen new year is the year which we received from the hands of the pure apostles]
As for your saying: The new chosen year is the year which we received from the hands of the pure apostles, according to what they themselves received from Christ. Peace be upon him.

It will be said: If you had followed that Sunnah and had not changed it, standing on it would not have benefited you if you denied the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, who was sent to you. And to the rest of creation with another Sunnah that was more perfect than the Sunnahs that were before it, just as it did not benefit the Jews, even if they adhered to the Sunnah of the Torah, and it did not benefit the Jews. They follow the Sunnah of the Messiah who was sent to them. Rather, whoever denies one Messenger is an unbeliever.

As God Almighty said: {Indeed, those who disbelieve in God and His Messengers and want to make a distinction between God and His Messengers and say, “We believe in part, and we disbelieve in part.” And they want to take a path between that} [An-Nisa: 150].

For, if the Sunnah that Christ, peace be upon him, brought was true, and everyone who followed it is a believer and a Muslim among God’s saints, Among the people of Paradise are those upon whom there is no fear, nor do they grieve, as God Almighty says: {Indeed, those who believe, and those who are Jews, and the Christians, and the Sabians, Whoever believes in God and the Last Day and does righteousness - they will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear upon them, nor will they grieve.} [Al-Baqarah: 62].

And God Almighty said: {Just as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, “Who are my helpers to God?” The disciples said, “We are helpers of God.” So a group of them believed. The Children of Israel, and a group disbelieved, so We supported those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious.} [As-Saff: 14].
Whoever follows Christ is a believer, and whoever disbelieves in him is an unbeliever.

And the Almighty said: {O Jesus, indeed I have caused you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection, then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that wherein you differed.} [Al Imran: 55] (55) {But as for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a torment. severe in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.} [Al Imran: 56] (56) {And as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full. And God will not He loves the wrongdoers} [Al Imran: 57].

But you changed it and changed it before the sending of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, (so you became infidels by changing the law of Christ and denying the law of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace), just as the Jews disbelieved in changing the law of the Torah and denying the law of the Gospel, then they disbelieved in denying the law of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and all of God’s messengers.

For Christ did not decree for you the trinity and the belief in hypostases, nor did he decree for you that he is Lord of the worlds, nor did he decree for you the permissibility of pigs. And other forbidden things, not abandoning circumcision, not praying to the east, not taking their rabbis and monks as lords other than God, and not polytheism. And taking statues and the cross, and praying for the dead and those who are absent among the prophets, the righteous and others, and asking them for their needs, and not monasticism, And other than that of the abominations which you have committed, and which Christ did not establish for you, nor what you are following. It is the law which you received from the apostles. Christ.

Rather, most of the Sunnahs that you follow are newly invented matters after the disciples, such as your fasting for fifty days during the spring, and your taking A feast on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, for this was not instituted by Christ nor any of the apostles, nor were the feasts of Christmas and the Epiphany. And other than that is one of your holidays.

Rather, the Feast of the Cross was invented by Helena, the Harranite woman of Canadia, the mother of Constantine. You say: She is the one who appeared. The cross was made and a feast was made for its appearance, and that was a long time after Christ and the Apostles, at the time of King Constantine after Christ. More than three hundred years.

At that time, you were faithful to the texts of the prophets in more than one place, and you demonstrated the permissibility of pigs and the punishment of those who did not. He eats it, and you invented in that time the glorification of the cross, and other innovations of yours, and likewise the books of laws that you have made them sunnah. And a law that contains something from the prophets and apostles, and much of what is in it was invented by those after them who did not transmit it, neither from Christ nor from The disciples, how can you claim that you are following the Sunnah and the Sharia that Christ, peace be upon him, was upon? And this is something that is known by necessity and frequency. A clear lie.

chapters.title: A chapter on the response of their reasoning from what was stated in the Torah regarding the creation of Adam to their opinion of Christ
paragraphs: [Chapter: Their reasoning based on what was stated in the Torah regarding the creation of Adam, based on their opinion of the Messiah] [His saying in the Torah, “Let us create people in our likeness.” And our example]

They said: As for our saying about God: Three Persons of One God, it is that God spoke it and made it clear in the Torah, and in the books of the Prophets. And from that is what came in the first book of the Torah, which says - since God willed to create Adam - God said: (Let us create a creation in our likeness. And our likeness), who is His likeness and likeness but His Word and His Spirit?
And when Adam disobeyed his Lord, God Almighty said: (Behold, Adam has become like one of us), and it is a clear statement that God said this. Of His Son and His Holy Spirit.

The answer is: Their evidence for this, based on their statement about the Messiah, is the utmost corruption and misguidance, for the word of the Torah: (We will make Adam in Our image and likeness), and some of them translate it (We create human beings in Our image and likeness).
The meaning is one, and this is as the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: (Indeed, God created Adam in His image), and in a narration: (In the image of

chapters.title: His saying in the Torah: “Let us create a creation in our likeness and likeness.”
paragraphs: The Most Gracious) So their saying: Who is like Him or His likeness except His Word and His Spirit - is among the most invalidating of falsehood in many ways: one of which is: that God is not Something like it, not the word of the text: like our example.

Second: That Christ has no special jurisdiction over what was mentioned regarding the determination of right and wrong. By what interpretation was his saying: (We will create human beings) interpreted? We were made in our likeness.) This was not specific to the Messiah.

Third: If they mean by the word, which is his likeness and likeness, his attribute, which is the knowledge that is based on him, and the life that is based on him, for example, The attribute is not an example of the thing described, since the thing described is the entity that exists by itself, and the attribute exists in it, and the one who exists in something else does not He will be like the one who rises up by himself.
And if they meant by it something other than His attributes, such as the body and spirit of Christ,
That is a creation created for Him, and a created being is not like the Creator. Likewise, the Holy Spirit - whether it means kingship or guidance and support - is not An example to God Almighty.

Fourth: He said (Let us create a creation) or He said: (We create Adam or We create human beings in our image and likeness) and according to what they said: (We create a creation In our likeness and example), and in any case, this and the Word of God and His Spirit are not created to them, so it is impossible for what is meant by that to be His Word. And his spirit.
